When on, new booking alerts play audio i.af: Wanneer aan, speel nuwe besprekingswaarskuwings oudio as jou mark 'n normale besprekingsluitoon in Control Plane stel; andersins vibrasie (mobiel).
When on, new booking alerts play audio i.zu: Uma kuvuliwe, izexwayiso zokubhukha ezintsha zidlala umsindo uma imakethe yakho isetha iringithoni yokubhukha evamile ku-Control Plane; uma kungenjalo ukudlidliza (iselula).
When on, new booking alerts play audio i.xh: Xa ivuliwe, izilumkiso zokubhukisha ezintsha zidlala isandi ukuba imakethi yakho imisela iringithoni yokubhukisha eqhelekileyo kwiPlane yoLawulo; kungenjalo ukungcangcazela (mobile).
When on, new booking alerts play audio i.st: Ha o bula, litlhokomeliso tse ncha tsa ho boloka li bapala molumo haeba 'maraka oa hau o seta molumo o llang oa ho boloka o tloaelehileng ho Control Plane; ho seng joalo vibration (mobile).
When on, new booking alerts play audio i.nso: Ge e butšwe, ditemošo tše mpsha tša go beakanya di bapala modumo ge mmaraka wa gago o bea modumo wa go lla wa go beakanya wo o tlwaelegilego ka go Control Plane; go sego bjalo thothomelo (sellathekeng).
When on, new booking alerts play audio i.tn: Fa e tobeditswe, ditsiboso tse dišwa tsa go buka di tshameka modumo fa mmaraka wa gago o seta modumo o o tlwaelegileng wa go buka mo Control Plane; go seng jalo thoromo (selulafouno).
When on, new booking alerts play audio i.ts: Loko yi pfuriwile, switsundzuxo leswintshwa swa ku bukuta swi tlanga mpfumawulo loko makete wa wena wu veka mpfumawulo wa ku bukuta lowu tolovelekeke eka Control Plane; handle ka sweswo ku rhurhumela (mobile).
When on, new booking alerts play audio i.ve: Musi yo vulea, nḓivhadzo ntswa dza u buka dzi tamba zwipfi arali makete waṋu u tshi vhea thoni ya u buka yo ḓoweleaho kha Control Plane; nga nnḓa ha zwenezwo u dzinginyea (mobiḽele).
When on, new booking alerts play audio i.ss: Uma kuvuliwe, tecwayiso letinsha tekubhuka tidlala umsindvo nangabe imakethe yakho isetha umsindvo wekubhukha lowetayelekile ku-Control Plane; ngaphandle kwaloko kudvudvuta (selula).

Shown to customers on the plan page. Onl.af: Shown to kliënte on the Plan page. Only the afslag % above is applied automatibely at afhandeling; ander Voordele are display-only.
Shown to customers on the plan page. Onl.zu: Shown to amakhasimende on the Uhlelo page. Only the isaphulelo % above is applied automatishayelay at ukukhokha; okunye Izinzuzo are display-only.
Shown to customers on the plan page. Onl.xh: Iboniswe kubathengi kwiphepha lesicwangciso. Kuphela isaphulelo se-% esingentla sisetyenziswa ngokuzenzekelayo ekuphumeni; ezinye izibonelelo ziboniswa kuphela.
Shown to customers on the plan page. Onl.st: E bontšoa ho bareki leqepheng la moralo. Ke theolelo feela % e ka holimo e sebelisoang ka bo eona ha u lefa; melemo e meng e bontšoa feela.
Shown to customers on the plan page. Onl.nso: E bontšhitšwe bareki letlakaleng la leano. Ke feela phokoletšo % ka holimo e sebediswa ka tsela e iketsang ka checkout; mehola e mengwe ke ya pontšho feela.
Shown to customers on the plan page. Onl.tn: E bontshitswe bareki mo tsebeng ya thulaganyo. Ke phokoletso fela ya % e e fa godimo e e dirisiwang ka go itirisa fa o reka; melemo e mengwe ke ya go bontshiwa fela.
Shown to customers on the plan page. Onl.ts: Yi kombisiwile eka vaxavi eka tluka ra pulani. I ntsena nhlawulo wa % lowu nga laha henhla lowu tirhisiwaka hi ku tisungulela loko u xava; mimpfuno yin’wana i ya ku kombisiwa ntsena.
Shown to customers on the plan page. Onl.ve: I sumbedzwa vharengi kha siaṱari ḽa pulane. Ndi % ya u fhungudzwa fhedzi i re afho nṱha ine ya shumiswa nga vhuḓiitisi musi hu tshi bviswa; dziṅwe mbuelo ndi dza u sumbedza fhedzi.
Shown to customers on the plan page. Onl.ss: Kukhonjiswe emakhasimende ekhasini leluhlelo. Kuphela isaphulelo % ngenhla kusetjentiswa ngekuzenzakalelayo ekuphumeni; letinye tinzuzo tikhonjiswa kuphela.

Beautonomi Ops will create your Virtual.af: Beautonomi Ops sal jou virtuele terminaal in Paystack skep en die terminaalkode, betalingskakel, QR en plakkaat hier byvoeg sodra dit gereed is.
Beautonomi Ops will create your Virtual.zu: Beautonomi I-Ops izodala i-Virtual Terminal yakho Paystack futhi yengeze ikhodi yetheminali, isixhumanisi sokukhokha, i-QR, kanye nephosta lapha uma isilungile.
Beautonomi Ops will create your Virtual.xh: Beautonomi I-Ops izakwenza iTheminali yakho eyiNqobo kwi- Paystack kwaye yongeze ikhowudi yesiphelo, ikhonkco lentlawulo, QR, kunye nepowusta apha xa sele ilungile.
Beautonomi Ops will create your Virtual.st: Beautonomi Ops e tla theha Virtual Terminal ea hau ka Paystack mme e kenye khoutu ea ho qetela, sehokelo sa tefo, QR, le poster mona hang ha e se e lokile.
Beautonomi Ops will create your Virtual.nso: Beautonomi Ops e tla hlama Theminali ya gago ya Virtual ka Paystack gomme ya oketša khoutu ya theminali, kgokagano ya tefelo, QR, le phoustara mo ge e šetše e lokile.
Beautonomi Ops will create your Virtual.tn: Beautonomi Ops e tla tlhama Theminale ya gago ya Sebele mo Paystack mme e tsenye khoutu ya theminale, kgokagano ya tuelo, QR, le phousetara fano fa e sena go siama.
Beautonomi Ops will create your Virtual.ts: Beautonomi Ops yi ta tumbuluxa Virtual Terminal ya wena hi Paystack yi engetela khodi ya theminali, xihlanganisi xa hakelo, QR, na phositara laha loko se yi lunghekile.
Beautonomi Ops will create your Virtual.ve: Beautonomi Ops i ḓo sika Theminala yaṋu ya Vhukuma kha Paystack na u engedza khoudu ya theminala, vhuṱumani ha mbadelo, QR, na phosiṱara hafha musi zwo no lugela.
Beautonomi Ops will create your Virtual.ss: Beautonomi I-Ops itawudala iTheminali yakho Lebonakalako ku Paystack bese yengeta ikhodi yetheminali, sixhumanisi sekukhokha, i-QR, nephosta lapha uma seyilungile.

Request Now is currently disabled. Enabl.tn: Kopo Jaanong e thibetswe ga jaana. E kgontsha mo diseting tsa polatefomo le mo diseting tsa gago tsa go buka mo inthaneteng pele ga o amogela dikopo tsa ka bonako.

Request Now is currently disabled. Enabl.ss: Sicelo Nyalo asikhubatekile njengamanje. Yinikete emandla kumasethingi epulatifomu kanye nemasethingi akho ekubhukha ku-inthanethi ngaphambi kwekwemukela ticelo letisheshako.

When your preferred time isn't available.af: Wanneer jou voorkeurtyd nie beskikbaar is nie, kan jy by 'n waglys op die verskaffer se besprekingsbladsy aansluit. Ons sal jou in kennis stel wanneer 'n gleuf oopmaak.
When your preferred time isn't available.zu: Uma isikhathi osincamelayo singatholakali, ungajoyina uhlu lokulinda ekhasini lokubhukha lomhlinzeki. Sizokwazisa uma kuvulwa indawo.
When your preferred time isn't available.xh: Xa ixesha olithandayo lingafumaneki, ungajoyina uluhlu lokulinda kwiphepha lokubhukisha lomboneleli. Siza kukwazisa xa isithuba sivuleka.
When your preferred time isn't available.st: Ha nako eo u e ratang e le sieo, u ka ingolisa lethathamong la batho ba letileng leqepheng la peeletso la mofani oa litšebeletso. Re tla u tsebisa ha slot se buloa.
When your preferred time isn't available.nso: Ge nako yeo o e ratago e sa hwetšagale, o ka tsenela lenaneo la go leta letlakaleng la go beakanya la moabi. Re tla go tsebiša ge sekotwana se bulega.
When your preferred time isn't available.tn: Fa nako e o e ratang e seyo, o ka tsenela lenaane la go leta mo tsebeng ya go buka ya motlamedi. Re tla go itsise fa go bulega sebaka.
When your preferred time isn't available.ts: Loko nkarhi lowu u wu tsakelaka wu nga ri kona, u nga joyina nxaxamelo wo rindza eka tluka ro bukuta ra muphakeri. Hi ta ku tivisa loko ku pfuriwa slot.
When your preferred time isn't available.ve: Musi tshifhinga tshine na tshi takalela tshi siho, ni nga dzhena kha mutevhe wa u lindela kha siaṱari ḽa u buka ḽa muṋetshedzi. Ri do vha divhadza musi hu tshi vula tshikhala.
When your preferred time isn't available.ss: Uma sikhatsi sakho lositsandzako singatfolakali, ungajoyina luhlu lwekulindza ekhasini lekubhuka lemhlinzeki. Sitakwatisa uma kuvulwa slot.

You're verifying your own identity as th.af: Jy verifieer tans jou eie identiteit as die eienaar of verteenwoordiger. Besigheidsuitbetalingsrekeninge kan jou salonnaam gebruik – dit word verwag.
You're verifying your own identity as th.zu: Uqinisekisa ubuwena njengomnikazi noma ummeleli. Ama-akhawunti enkokhelo yebhizinisi angasebenzisa igama lakho lesaluni — kulindelekile lokho.
You're verifying your own identity as th.xh: Uqinisekisa isazisi sakho njengomnini okanye ummeli. Iiakhawunti zentlawulo yeshishini zinokusebenzisa igama lakho lesalon - kulindelekile oko.
You're verifying your own identity as th.st: U ntse u netefatsa boitsebiso ba hau joalo ka mong'a kapa moemeli. Liakhaonto tsa tefo ea khoebo li ka sebelisa lebitso la hau la salon - ho lebelletsoe.
You're verifying your own identity as th.nso: O netefatša boitšhupo bja gago bjalo ka mong goba moemedi. Diakhaonto tša tefo ya kgwebo di ka šomiša leina la gago la salon — seo se letetšwe.
You're verifying your own identity as th.tn: O netefatsa boitshupo jwa gago jaaka mong kgotsa moemedi. Diakhaonto tsa tuelo tsa kgwebo di ka dirisa leina la gago la salon — seo se solofetswe.
You're verifying your own identity as th.ts: U tiyisisa vutitivisi bya wena tani hi n’wini kumbe muyimeri. Tiakhawunti ta ku hakela bindzu ti nga tirhisa vito ra wena ra salon — sweswo swi languteriwile.
You're verifying your own identity as th.ve: U khwaṱhisedza vhuṋe hawe sa muṋe kana muimeleli. Akhaunthu dza u badela dza mabindu dzi nga shumisa dzina ḽaṋu ḽa salon — zwenezwo zwo lavhelelwa.
You're verifying your own identity as th.ss: Ucinisekisa bunjalo bakho njengemnikati noma ummeleli. Ema-akhawunti ekukhokha ebhizinisi angasebentisa ligama lakho le-salon — loko kulindzelekile.

These hours determine when customers can.af: Hierdie ure bepaal wanneer klante by hierdie ligging kan bespreek. Personeel sonder gepasmaakte werksure sal hierdie ure outomaties volg.
These hours determine when customers can.zu: Lawa mahora anquma ukuthi amakhasimende angabhukha nini kule ndawo. Abasebenzi abangenawo amahora okusebenza angokwezifiso bazolandela lawa mahora ngokuzenzakalelayo.
These hours determine when customers can.xh: Ezi yure zichaza ukuba abathengi banokubhukisha nini kule ndawo. Abasebenzi ngaphandle kweeyure zomsebenzi eziqhelekileyo baya kulandela ezi yure ngokuzenzekelayo.
These hours determine when customers can.st: Lihora tsena li bontša hore na bareki ba ka ingolisa neng sebakeng sena. Basebetsi ba se nang lihora tsa mosebetsi ba tla latela lihora tsena ka bohona.
These hours determine when customers can.nso: Diiri tše di laola gore bareki ba ka beakanya neng lefelong le. Bašomi bao ba se nago diiri tša mošomo tša tlwaelo ba tla latela diiri tše ka go itiragalela.
These hours determine when customers can.tn: Diura tseno di laola gore bareki ba ka buka leng mo lefelong leno. Badiri ba ba senang diura tsa tiro tse di rulagantsweng ba tla latela diura tseno ka go itirisa.
These hours determine when customers can.ts: Tiawara leti ti kombisa leswaku vaxavi va nga bukuta rini endhawini leyi. Vatirhi lava nga riki na tiawara ta ntirho ta ntolovelo va ta landzelela tiawara leti hi ku tisungulela.
These hours determine when customers can.ve: Awara idzi ndi dzone dzine dza sumbedza uri vharengi vha nga buka lini fhethu uhu. Vhashumi vha si na awara dza mushumo dzo ḓoweleaho vha ḓo tevhela awara idzi nga vhuḓiitisi.

Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.af: Geboortedatum vir geverifieerde identiteit (KYC) geniet voorrang bo die datum wat jy by aansluiting ingevoer het wanneer jy jou ouderdomsgroep vir voldoening bepaal.

Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.xh: Isazisi esiqinisekisiweyo (i-KYC) umhla wokuzalwa ubaluleke ngaphezu komhla owufakileyo ekubhaliseni xa umisela ibhendi yeminyaka yakho yokuthobela.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.st: Letsatsi la tsoalo la Verified identity (KYC) le tla pele ho letsatsi leo u le kentseng ha u ingolisa ha u etsa qeto ea lilemo tsa hau bakeng sa ho e latela.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.nso: Letšatšikgwedi la matswalo la boitšhupo bjo bo netefaditšwego (KYC) le tla pele go feta letšatšikgwedi leo o le tsentšego ge o saena ge o laetša sehlopha sa gago sa mengwaga bakeng sa kobamelo.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.tn: Letlha la matsalo la boitshupo jo bo netefaditsweng (KYC) le tla pele ga letlha le o le tsentseng fa o ikwadisa fa o tlhomamisa setlhopha sa gago sa dingwaga tsa go ikobela melao.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.ts: Siku ra ku velekiwa ra vutitivisi lebyi tiyisisiweke (KYC) ri rhangela ku tlula siku leri u ri ngheniseke loko u tsarisa loko u kumisisa ntlawa wa malembe ya wena ku landzelela.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.ve: Ḓuvha ḽa mabebo ḽa vhuḓiṱalusi ho khwaṱhisedzwaho (KYC) ḽi dzhia vhuimo ha nṱha u fhira ḓuvha ḽe na ḽi ṅwala musi ni tshi saina musi ni tshi ṱola tshigwada tsha miṅwaha yaṋu u itela u tevhedza.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.ss: Lusuku lwekutalwa lwebunikati lobucinisekisiwe (KYC) lutsatsa kucala kunelilanga lowalifaka ngesikhatsi ubhalisa uma uncuma iminyaka yakho yekulandzela.

To update locations, operating hours, on.af: Om liggings, bedryfsure, aanlyn bespreking, spantoestemmings of kennisgewings op te dateer, gebruik die Settings & Rekening-afdelings in hierdie toepassing.
To update locations, operating hours, on.zu: Ukuze ubuyekeze izindawo, amahora okusebenza, ukubhukha ku-inthanethi, izimvume zeqembu, noma izaziso, sebenzisa Settings izigaba ze-Akhawunti kulolu hlelo lokusebenza.
To update locations, operating hours, on.xh: Ukuhlaziya iindawo, iiyure zokusebenza, ukubhukisha kwi-intanethi, iimvume zeqela, okanye izaziso, sebenzisa i Settings & Akhawunti amacandelo kule app.
To update locations, operating hours, on.st: Ho nchafatsa libaka, lihora tsa ts'ebetso, ho buella inthaneteng, litumello tsa sehlopha, kapa litemoso, sebelisa Settings & likarolo tsa Akhaonto ho app ena.
To update locations, operating hours, on.nso: Go mpshafatša mafelo, diiri tša go šoma, go beakanya inthaneteng, ditumelelo tša sehlopha, goba ditsebišo, šomiša dikarolo tša Settings & Akhaonto mo tirišong ye.
To update locations, operating hours, on.tn: Go tlhabolola mafelo, diura tsa tiro, go buka mo inthaneteng, ditetlelelo tsa setlhopha, kgotsa dikitsiso, dirisa dikarolo tsa Settings & Akhaonto mo tirisweng eno.
To update locations, operating hours, on.ts: Ku pfuxeta tindhawu, tiawara ta ntirho, ku bukuta eka inthanete, mpfumelelo wa xipano, kumbe switiviso, tirhisa swiyenge swa Settings & Akhawunti eka app leyi.
To update locations, operating hours, on.ve: U itela u khwinisa fhethu, awara dza u shuma, u buka kha inthanethe, thendelo dza tshigwada, kana nḓivhadzo, shumisani zwipiḓa zwa Settings & Akhaunthu kha ino app.
To update locations, operating hours, on.ss: Kuze uvuselele tindzawo, ema-awa ekusebenta, kubhuka nge-inthanethi, timvume telicembu, nobe tatiso, sebentisa tincenye te-Settings & te-Akhawunti kule-app.

\"All Locations\" marks this device as p.af: "Alle liggings" merk hierdie toestel as draagbaar – word by verstek gebruik vir tuisbesprekings en oral waar 'n salon nog nie sy eie toestel het nie.
\"All Locations\" marks this device as p.zu: "Zonke Izindawo" zimaka le divayisi njengephathekayo — isetshenziswa ngokuzenzakalela ekubhukheni kwasekhaya nanoma yikuphi indawo yokucwala izinwele ingakabi nayo eyayo idivayisi.
\"All Locations\" marks this device as p.xh: "Zonke iiNdawo" ziphawula esi sixhobo njengesiphathekayo - sisetyenziswa ngokuzenzekelayo kubhukisho lwasekhaya kwaye naphi na isaluni ingekabinaso isixhobo sayo.
\"All Locations\" marks this device as p.st: "Libaka Tsohle" li tšoaea sesebelisoa sena e le se nkehang habonolo - se sebelisoa ka mokhoa oa kamehla bakeng sa lipehelo tsa lapeng le kae kapa kae moo salon e se nang sesebelisoa sa eona.
\"All Locations\" marks this device as p.nso: "Mafelo ka moka" e swaya sedirišwa se bjalo ka se se rwalago — se šomišwa ka go ikemela bakeng sa dipeeletšo tša ka gae le kae goba kae moo salon e sešo ya ba le sedirišwa sa yona.
\"All Locations\" marks this device as p.tn: "Mafelo Otlhe" e tshwaya sediriswa seno jaaka se se rwalelwang — se dirisiwa ka thulaganyetsoruri go dira dipeeletso kwa gae le gongwe le gongwe kwa salon e iseng e nne le sediriswa sa yone.
\"All Locations\" marks this device as p.ts: "Tindhawu Hinkwato" yi fungha xitirhisiwa lexi tanihi lexi rhwalekaka — lexi tirhisiwaka hi ku tiyimisela eka ku bukuta ekaya na kun'wana na kun'wana laha salon yi nga si vaka na xitirhisiwa xa yona.
\"All Locations\" marks this device as p.ve: "Fhethu Hoṱhe" i swaya tshishumiswa itshi sa tshi hwaleaho — tshi shumiswa nga nḓila yo ḓoweleaho kha u buka hayani na fhethu hoṱhe hune salon ya vha i sa athu vha na tshishumiswa tshayo.
\"All Locations\" marks this device as p.ss: "Tonkhe Tindzawo" timaka le divayisi njengalephatsekako — isetjentiswa ngekujwayelekile ekubhukheni ekhaya nanoma ngukuphi lapho i-salon ingakabi nayo idivayisi yayo.

All settings for {{name}} are available.af: Alle instellings vir {{name}} is in die toepassing beskikbaar. Gaan na Meer → Settings & rekening om hierdie en ander instellings te bestuur sonder om die toepassing te verlaat.
All settings for {{name}} are available.zu: Zonke izilungiselelo ze-{{name}} ziyatholakala ngaphakathi nohlelo. Iya kokuthi Okuningi → Settings & akhawunti ukuze uphathe lokhu nezinye izilungiselelo ngaphandle kokushiya uhlelo lokusebenza.
All settings for {{name}} are available.xh: Zonke iisetingi ze {{name}} ziyafumaneka kwi-app. Yiya kuNgakumbi → Settings & akhawunti ukulawula oku kunye nezinye iisetingi ngaphandle kokushiya i-app.
All settings for {{name}} are available.st: Litlhophiso tsohle tsa {{name}} lia fumaneha ka har'a app. Eya ho Tse ling → Settings & ak'haonte ho laola sena le litlhophiso tse ling ntle le ho siea sesebelisoa.
All settings for {{name}} are available.nso: Dipeakanyo ka moka tša {{name}} di hwetšagala ka gare ga tirišo. Eya go Tse dingwe → Settings & akhaonto go laola se le dipeakanyo tše dingwe ntle le go tlogela tirišo.
All settings for {{name}} are available.tn: Diseting tsotlhe tsa {{name}} di teng mo tirisong. Eya go Tse dingwe → Settings & akhaonto go laola diseting tseno le tse dingwe ntle le go tswa mo tirisong.
All settings for {{name}} are available.ts: Switirhisiwa hinkwaswo swa {{name}} swi kumeka eka app. Yana eka Swin’wana → Settings & akhawunti ku lawula swiyimiso leswi na swin’wana handle ko huma eka app.
All settings for {{name}} are available.ve: Zwishumiswa zwoṱhe zwa {{name}} zwi a wanala kha app. Iyani kha Zwiṅwe → Settings & akhaunthu u itela u langa hezwi na zwiṅwe zwishumiswa ni sa bvi kha app.
All settings for {{name}} are available.ss: Onkhe emasethingi e-{{name}} ayatfolakala ku-app. Iya ku- More → Settings & i-akhawunti kute ulawule loku kanye naletinye tilungiselelo ngaphandle kwekuphuma ku-app.

After you book while signed in, turn on.af: Nadat jy bespreek het terwyl jy aangemeld is, skakel "Herhaal hierdie bespreking" aan by die betaalpunt (program of web). Jy kan ook jou verskaffer vra om 'n reeks op te stel.
After you book while signed in, turn on.zu: Ngemuva kokuthi ubhukhe ngesikhathi ungene ngemvume, vula okuthi "Phinda lokhu kubhuka" ekuphumeni (uhlelo lokusebenza noma iwebhu). Ungaphinda ucele umhlinzeki wakho ukuthi asethe uchungechunge.
After you book while signed in, turn on.xh: Emva kokuba ubhukishe ngelixa ungene, vula "Phinda oku kubhukisha" xa uphuma (usetyenziso okanye iwebhu). Ungaphinda ucele umboneleli wakho ukuba asete uthotho.
After you book while signed in, turn on.st: Ka mor'a hore u kope ha u ntse u itlalehile, laeta "Pheta kopo ena" ha u lefa (app kapa web). U ka boela ua kopa mofani oa hau ho theha letoto.
After you book while signed in, turn on.nso: Ka morago ga ge o beakanya ge o saennwe, bulela "Boeletša go beakanya mo" ge o tšhela (app goba wepe). O ka kgopela gape moabi wa gago go hloma lelokelelo.
After you book while signed in, turn on.tn: Fa o sena go buka fa o saenetse go tsena, tobetsa "Boeletsa peeletso eno" fa o tswa (tiriso kgotsa webo). Gape o ka kopa moabi wa gago go rulaganya motseletsele.
After you book while signed in, turn on.ts: Endzhaku ka loko u bukutile loko u nghenile, pfula "Pheta ku bukuta loku" loko u hakela (app kumbe webu). U nga ha tlhela u kombela muphakeri wa wena ku veka nxaxamelo.
After you book while signed in, turn on.ve: Nga murahu ha musi no buka musi no dzhena, vulani "Dovhololani u buka uhu" musi ni tshi bva (app kana web). Ni nga dovha na humbela muṋetshedzi waṋu uri a vhee mutevhe.
After you book while signed in, turn on.ss: Ngemuva kwekubhukha ngesikhatsi ungene ngemvume, vula "Phindza lokubhuka" nawuphuma (i-app nobe iwebhu). Ungaphindze ucele umhlinzeki wakho kutsi asethe uchungechunge.

Your professional travels to the address.af: Jou professionele reis na die adres hieronder. Nasporing en aankomsverifikasie (wanneer jou verskaffer arriveer) verskyn op die Nasporing-oortjie.
Your professional travels to the address.zu: Uchwepheshe wakho uya ekhelini elingezansi. Ukulandelela nokuqinisekisa ukufika (uma umhlinzeki wakho efika) kuvela kuthebhu yokulandelela.
Your professional travels to the address.xh: Ingcali yakho ihambela kule dilesi ingezantsi. Ukulandelela kunye nokuqinisekiswa kokufika (xa umboneleli wakho efika) kubonakala kwithebhu yokuKhangela.
Your professional travels to the address.st: Setsebi sa hau se etela atereseng e ka tlase. Netefatso ya ho latedisa le ho fihla (ha mofani wa hao a fihla) e hlaha tabeng ya Tracking.
Your professional travels to the address.nso: Setsebi sa gago se sepela go ya atereseng ye e lego ka mo tlase. Go latela le netefatšo ya go fihla (ge moabi wa gago a fihla) di tšwelela go thepo ya Go Latela.
Your professional travels to the address.tn: Moitseanape wa gago o tsamaya go ya kwa atereseng e e fa tlase. Go latedisa le netefatso ya go goroga (fa motlamedi wa gago a goroga) go tlhagelela mo thebong ya Go latedisa.
Your professional travels to the address.ts: Xiphurofexinali xa wena xi famba eka adirese leyi nga laha hansi. Ku landzelerisa na ku tiyisisiwa ka ku fika (loko muphakeri wa wena a fika) swi humelela eka thebhu ya Ku Landzelerisa.
Your professional travels to the address.ve: Muḓivhi waṋu u tshimbila a tshi ya kha ḓiresi i re afho fhasi. U tevhela na u khwaṱhisedza u swika (musi muṋetshedzi waṋu a tshi swika) zwi vhonala kha thebu ya U tevhela.
Your professional travels to the address.ss: Uchwepheshe wakho uya kulelikheli lelingezansi. Kulandzela kanye nekucinisekisa kufika (nakufika umhlinzeki wakho) kuvela kuthebhu yekulandzelela.

Use {{label}} to unlock the app when you.af: Gebruik {{label}} om die toepassing te ontsluit wanneer jy terugkeer. Jou sessie bly aangemeld – jy hoef nie 'n kode in te voer elke keer as jy die program oopmaak nie.
Use {{label}} to unlock the app when you.zu: Sebenzisa {{label}} ukuvula uhlelo lokusebenza uma ubuya. Isikhathi sakho sihlala singenile — ngeke udinge ukuthi ufake ikhodi njalo uma uvula uhlelo lokusebenza.
Use {{label}} to unlock the app when you.xh: Sebenzisa {{label}} ukuvula i-app xa ubuya. Iseshoni yakho ihlala ingenile - akusayi kufuneka ufake ikhowudi ngalo lonke ixesha uvula usetyenziso.
Use {{label}} to unlock the app when you.st: Sebelisa {{label}} ho notlolla sesebelisoa ha u khutla. Seboka sa hau se tla lula u saena - ha ho hlokahale hore u kenye khoutu nako le nako ha u bula sesebelisoa.
Use {{label}} to unlock the app when you.nso: Šomiša {{label}} go notlolla tirišo ge o boa. Sešene ya gago e dula e saennwe — o ka se hloke go tsenya khoutu nako le nako ge o bula tirišo.
Use {{label}} to unlock the app when you.tn: Dirisa {{label}} go lotlolola tiriswa fa o boa. Sešene sa gago se nna se saenilwe — ga o kitla o tlhoka go tsenya khoutu nako le nako fa o bula tiriswa.
Use {{label}} to unlock the app when you.ts: Tirhisa {{label}} ku pfula app loko u vuya. Seshini ya wena yi tshama yi nghenile — a wu nge lavi ku nghenisa khodi nkarhi wun’wana na wun’wana loko u pfula app.
Use {{label}} to unlock the app when you.ve: Shumisani {{label}} u vula app musi ni tshi vhuya. Sesheni yaṋu i dzula yo dzhena — a ni nga ḓo ṱoḓa u ṅwala khoudu tshifhinga tshoṱhe musi ni tshi vula app.
Use {{label}} to unlock the app when you.ss: Sebentisa {{label}} kute uvule i-app nawubuya. Session yakho ihlala ibhalisiwe — ngeke kudzingeke kutsi ufake ikhodi ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi nawuvula i-app.

Beautonomi offers parental controls and.af: Beautonomi bied ouerkontroles en ouderdomsversekering sodat gesinne kan kies hoe sosiale kenmerke, boodskappe en inhoud in die toepassing verskyn.
Beautonomi offers parental controls and.zu: Beautonomi inikeza izilawuli zabazali nesiqiniseko sobudala ukuze imindeni ikwazi ukukhetha ukuthi izici zomphakathi, imiyalezo, nokuqukethwe kuvela kanjani kuhlelo lokusebenza.
Beautonomi offers parental controls and.xh: Beautonomi ibonelela ngolawulo lwabazali kunye nesiqinisekiso seminyaka yobudala ukuze iintsapho zikwazi ukukhetha indlela iimpawu zasekuhlaleni, imiyalezo, kunye nomxholo ovela ngayo kwi-app.
Beautonomi offers parental controls and.st: Beautonomi e fana ka litaolo tsa batsoali le tiisetso ea lilemo hore malapa a tsebe ho khetha hore na likarolo tsa sechaba, melaetsa, le litaba li hlaha joang ho app.
Beautonomi offers parental controls and.nso: Beautonomi e fana ka taolo ya batswadi le kgonthišišo ya mengwaga gore malapa a kgone go kgetha ka moo diponagalo tša leago, melaetša, le diteng di tšwelelago ka gona mo tirišong.
Beautonomi offers parental controls and.tn: Beautonomi e fana ka ditaolo tsa batswadi le netefatso ya dilemo e le hore malapa a kgone ho kgetha kamoo dikarolo tsa setjhaba, melaetsa, le dikahare di hlahang kateng app.
Beautonomi offers parental controls and.ts: Beautonomi yi nyika vulawuri bya vatswari na xitiyisekiso xa malembe leswaku mindyangu yi ta hlawula ndlela leyi swihlawulekisi swa ntshamiseko, marungula, na nhundzu swi humelelaka ha yona eka app.
Beautonomi offers parental controls and.ve: Beautonomi i ṋetshedza ndaulo ya vhabebi na khwaṱhisedzo ya miṅwaha u itela uri miṱa i kone u nanga nḓila ine zwishumiswa zwa matshilisano, milaedza, na zwi re ngomu zwa vhonala ngayo kha app.
Beautonomi offers parental controls and.ss: Beautonomi iniketa kulawula kwebatali kanye nekucinisekisa iminyaka kute imindeni ikhetse kutsi timphawu tetenhlalo, imilayeto, kanye nekucuketfwe kuvela njani ku-app.

The secret key enables Yoco hosted check.af: Die geheime sleutel maak Yoco gehuisvestde betaalpuntskakels en QR-betalings moontlik. Web POS kaartterminale vereis steeds die Connect Yoco OAuth-knoppie hierbo.
The secret key enables Yoco hosted check.zu: Ukhiye oyimfihlo uvumela Yoco izixhumanisi zokuphuma ezisingethwe nezinkokhelo ze-QR. Web POS amatheminali ekhadi asadinga inkinobho ethi Xhuma Yoco OAuth ngenhla.
The secret key enables Yoco hosted check.xh: Isitshixo esiyimfihlo senza ukuba Yoco kubanjwe amakhonkco okuphuma kunye neentlawulo ze-QR. Web POS iitheminali zekhadi zisafuna iqhosha elithi Qhagamshela Yoco OAuth ngasentla.
The secret key enables Yoco hosted check.st: Senotlolo sa lekunutu se thusa Yoco lihokelo tsa ho tsoa le litefo tsa QR. Web POS li-terminals tsa likarete li ntse li hloka konopo ea Connect Yoco OAuth ka holimo.
The secret key enables Yoco hosted check.nso: Senotlelo sa sephiri se kgontšha Yoco dikgokagano tša go tšhela tšeo di amogetšwego le ditefelo tša QR. Web POS ditheminali tša dikarata di sa nyaka konope ya Kgokaganya Yoco OAuth ka godimo.
The secret key enables Yoco hosted check.tn: Senotlolo sa sephiri se kgontsha Yoco dikgokagano tsa go reka tse di amogetsweng le dituelo tsa QR. Ditheminale tsa dikarata tsa Web POS di sa ntse di tlhoka konopo ya Golaganya Yoco OAuth e e fa godimo.
The secret key enables Yoco hosted check.ts: Xilotlelo xa xihundla xi endla leswaku Yoco swihlanganisi swa ku xava leswi khomiweke na ku hakela ka QR swi tirha. Web POS titheminali ta khadi ta ha lava buti ya Connect Yoco OAuth laha henhla.
The secret key enables Yoco hosted check.ve: Khii ya tshiphiri i konisa Yoco vhuṱumani ha u bvisa ho ṱanganedzwaho na mbadelo dza QR. Web POS theminala dza khadi dzi kha ḓi ṱoḓa gunubu ya Connect Yoco OAuth i re afho nṱha.
The secret key enables Yoco hosted check.ss: Sihluthulelo semfihlo siniketa emandla Yoco tikhonjiso tekukhipha imali letisingatsiwe kanye netinkhokhelo te-QR. Web POS ematheminali emakhadi asadzinga inkinobho yekuxhumana Yoco OAuth lengetulu.

This booking has an unpaid balance of {{.af: Hierdie bespreking het 'n onbetaalde balans van {{currency}} {{amount}}. Neem betaling vas voordat jy dit voltooi of kies "Voltooi in elk geval" om later te vereffen.
This booking has an unpaid balance of {{.zu: Lokhu kubhuka kunebhalansi engakhokhiwe {{currency}} {{amount}}. Thwebula inkokhelo ngaphambi kokuqeda noma khetha okuthi "Qedela Noma Kunjalo" ukuze ukhokhe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
This booking has an unpaid balance of {{.xh: Olu bhukisho lunebhalansi engahlawulwanga ye {{currency}} {{amount}}. Thatha intlawulo ngaphambi kokugqiba okanye ukhethe u-"Gcwalisa Nokuba Sekunjalo" ukuze uhlawule kamva.
This booking has an unpaid balance of {{.st: Pehelo ena e na le tekanyo e sa lefshoeng ea {{currency}} {{amount}}. Tšoara tefo pele o tlatsa kapa khetha "Fetsa Leha ho le joalo" ho lefa hamorao.
This booking has an unpaid balance of {{.nso: Peeletšo ye e na le mašaledi ao a sa lefelwago a {{currency}} {{amount}}. Gapa tefo pele o fetša goba o kgethe "Feletša Le ge go le bjalo" go rarolla ka morago.
This booking has an unpaid balance of {{.tn: Peeletso eno e na le balanse e e sa duelwang ya {{currency}} {{amount}}. Tsaya tuelo pele o feleletsa kgotsa tlhopha "Fetsa Le fa go ntse jalo" go duela moragonyana.
This booking has an unpaid balance of {{.ts: Ku bukuta loku ku na mali leyi saleke leyi nga hakeriwangiki ya {{currency}} {{amount}}. Khoma hakelo u nga si hetisa kutani u hlawula "Complete Anyway" ku lulamisa endzhaku.
This booking has an unpaid balance of {{.ve: U buka uhu hu na tshivhalo tshi songo badelwaho tsha {{currency}} {{amount}}. Kha vha fare mbadelo vha sa athu fhedza kana vha khethe "Fhedzani Naho zwo ralo" u itela u dzudzanya nga murahu.
This booking has an unpaid balance of {{.ss: Lokubhukha kunebhalansi lengakakhokhwa lengu {{currency}} {{amount}}. Bamba inkhokhelo ngaphambi kwekutsi ugcwalise noma ukhetse "Gcwalisa Noma Kunjalo" kute ukhokhe kamuva.

The weekly schedule stores one slot per.af: Die weeklikse skedule stoor een gleuf per dag. Vir skofte wat middernag oorsteek, voeg 'n datumspesifieke skof hieronder by - dié ondersteun oornagtye.
The weekly schedule stores one slot per.zu: Uhlelo lwamasonto onke lugcina indawo eyodwa ngosuku. Kumashifu awela phakathi kwamabili, engeza i-shift eqondene nedethi ngezansi - lezo zisekela izikhathi zasebusuku.
The weekly schedule stores one slot per.xh: Ishedyuli yeveki igcina indawo enye ngosuku. Kwiishifti eziwela ezinzulwini zobusuku, yongeza ishifti ethile engezantsi - ezo zixhasayo ngamaxesha obusuku.
The weekly schedule stores one slot per.st: Lenaneo la beke le beke le boloka sekotjana se le seng ka letsatsi. Bakeng sa lichifi tse fetang har'a mp'a mp'a bosiu, eketsa phetoho e ikhethileng ea letsatsi ka tlase - ts'ehetso eo ea bosiu bo le bong.
The weekly schedule stores one slot per.nso: Lenaneo la beke le beke le boloka sekotwana se tee ka letšatši. Bakeng sa diphetogo tšeo di tshelago bošegogare, oketša phetogo ye e itšego ya letšatšikgwedi ka fase — tšeo di thekgago dinako tša bošego.
The weekly schedule stores one slot per.tn: Thulaganyo ya beke le beke e boloka sebaka se le sengwe ka letsatsi. Bakeng sa dishifiti tse tshelang bosiu bohareng, eketsa shifiti e itseng ya letsatsi ka tlase — tseo di tshehetsa dinako tsa bosiu.
The weekly schedule stores one slot per.ts: Xiyimiso xa vhiki na vhiki xi hlayisa xilotlelo xin’we hi siku. Eka ku cinca loku tsemakanyaka exikarhi ka vusiku, engetela ku cinca loku kongomeke ka siku laha hansi — sweswo swi seketela minkarhi ya vusiku.
The weekly schedule stores one slot per.ve: Mbekanyamushumo ya vhege i vhulunga tshikhala tshithihi nga ḓuvha. Kha zwifhinga zwine zwa pfuka vhukati ha vhusiku, engedzani tshifhinga tsho khetheaho tsha ḓuvha afho fhasi — zwenezwo zwi tikedza zwifhinga zwa vhusiku.
The weekly schedule stores one slot per.ss: Luhlelo lwamaviki onkhe lugcina sikhala sinye ngelilanga. Kumashifu lawela ekhatsi nalamabili, faka ishifu lekhetsekile yelusuku ngezansi — lawo asekela tikhatsi tebusuku.

Beautonomi does not provide medical advi.af: Beautonomi verskaf nie mediese advies nie. Diensbeskrywings word deur onafhanklike professionele persone gedeel en is nie geverifieerde mediese eise nie.
Beautonomi does not provide medical advi.zu: Beautonomi ayinikezi iseluleko sezokwelashwa. Izincazelo zesevisi zabelwa ochwepheshe abazimele futhi akuzona izimangalo zezokwelapha eziqinisekisiwe.
Beautonomi does not provide medical advi.xh: Beautonomi ayinikezi iingcebiso zonyango. Iinkcazo zenkonzo zabelwana ngazo ngabasebenzi abazimeleyo kwaye aziqinisekiswanga amabango ezonyango.
Beautonomi does not provide medical advi.st: Beautonomi ha e fane ka keletso ea bongaka. Litlhaloso tsa lits'ebeletso li arolelanoa ke litsebi tse ikemetseng mme ha se likopo tse netefalitsoeng tsa bongaka.
Beautonomi does not provide medical advi.nso: Beautonomi ga a nee keletšo ya tša kalafo. Ditlhalošo tša tirelo di abelanwa ke ditsebi tše di ikemetšego gomme ga se ditleleimi tša kalafo tše di netefaditšwego.
Beautonomi does not provide medical advi.tn: Beautonomi ga e neele kgakololo ya kalafi. Ditlhaloso tsa tirelo di abelanwa ke baitseanape ba ba ikemetseng mme ga se ditleleimi tsa kalafi tse di netefaditsweng.
Beautonomi does not provide medical advi.ts: Beautonomi a nga nyiki switsundzuxo swa vutshunguri. Tinhlamuselo ta vukorhokeri ti averiwa hi tiphurofexinali leti tiyimeleke naswona a hi swikoxo swa vutshunguri leswi tiyisisiweke.
Beautonomi does not provide medical advi.ve: Beautonomi a i ṋei nyeletshedzo ya zwa ngalafho. Ṱhalutshedzo dza tshumelo dzi kovhelwa nga vhaḓivhi vho ḓiimisaho nga vhoṱhe nahone a si mbilaelo dza zwa ngalafho dzo khwaṱhisedzwaho.
Beautonomi does not provide medical advi.ss: Beautonomi ayiniketi seluleko sekwelashwa. Tincazelo tetinsita tabelwana ngetingcweti letitimele futsi akusito timangalo tekwelashwa leticinisekisiwe.

These group your services on your bookin.st: Tsena li kopanya lits'ebeletso tsa hau leqepheng la hau la peeletso. Li rehe mabitso bocha, u kenye tsa hau, kapa u tlose tseo u sa li hlokeng - u tla abela tšebeletso e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ho e latelang.
These group your services on your bookin.nso: Tše di hlopha ditirelo tša gago letlakaleng la gago la go beakanya. Di reele leina lefsa, oketša tša gago, goba o tloše efe goba efe yeo o sa e hlokego — o tla abela tirelo ye nngwe le ye nngwe go ye nngwe ye e latelago.
These group your services on your bookin.tn: Tseno di kgobokanya ditirelo tsa gago mo tsebeng ya gago ya go buka. Di reye leina le lesha, tsenya tsa gago, kgotsa tlosa epe e o sa e tlhokeng — o tla abela tirelo nngwe le nngwe e e latelang.
These group your services on your bookin.ts: Leswi swi hlengeleta vukorhokeri bya wena eka tluka ra wena ro bukuta. Va thye mavito, engetela ya wena, kumbe u susa yin’wana na yin’wana leyi u nga yi laviki — u ta avela vukorhokeri byin’wana na byin’wana eka byin’wana lebyi landzelaka.
These group your services on your bookin.ve: Hezwi zwi ṱanganya tshumelo dzaṋu kha siaṱari ḽaṋu ḽa u buka. Dzi dzi ṋeeni dzina ḽiswa, ni engedze dzaṋu, kana ni bvise dziṅwe na dziṅwe dzine na sa dzi ṱoḓe — ni ḓo ṋea tshumelo iṅwe na iṅwe kha iṅwe i tevhelaho.
These group your services on your bookin.ss: Leti tihlanganisa tinsita takho ekhasini lakho lekubhuka. Tibite kabusha, wengete lakho, noma ususe noma nguyiphi longayidzingi — utawubela insizakalo ngayinye kulenye lelandzelako.

Your order {{orderNumber}} has been plac.af: Jou bestelling {{orderNumber}} is geplaas. Betaling is hangende – voeg 'n e-pos by rekeninginstellings om aanlyn te betaal, of voltooi betaling vanaf Bestellings.
Your order {{orderNumber}} has been plac.zu: I-oda lakho {{orderNumber}} selifakiwe. Inkokhelo ilindile — engeza i-imeyili kuzilungiselelo ze-akhawunti ukuze ukhokhe ku-inthanethi, noma uqedele inkokhelo evela kuma-oda.
Your order {{orderNumber}} has been plac.xh: Iodolo yakho {{orderNumber}} ifakiwe. Intlawulo isalindiwe — yongeza i-imeyile kwiisetingi zeakhawunti ukuze uhlawule kwi-Intanethi, okanye ugqibezele intlawulo evela kwiiOdolo.
Your order {{orderNumber}} has been plac.st: Odara ya hao {{orderNumber}} e kentswe. Tefo e ntse e emetse - eketsa lengolo-tsoibila ho litlhophiso tsa ak'haonte ho lefa inthaneteng, kapa ho tlatsa tefo ho tsoa ho Orders.
Your order {{orderNumber}} has been plac.nso: Taelo ya gago {{orderNumber}} e beilwe. Tefo e sa eme — oketša imeile ka dipeakanyo tša akhaonto go lefa inthaneteng, goba tefo e feletšego go tšwa go Ditaelo.
Your order {{orderNumber}} has been plac.tn: Otara ya gago {{orderNumber}} e tsentswe. Tuelo e santse e letile — tsenya imeile mo diseting tsa akhaonto go duela mo inthaneteng, kgotsa wetsa tuelo go tswa mo Ditaelong.
Your order {{orderNumber}} has been plac.ts: Odara ya wena {{orderNumber}} yi endliwile. Ku hakela ku yimisiwile — engetela imeyili eka swiletelo swa akhawunti ku hakela eka inthanete, kumbe ku hetisa hakelo ku suka eka Tioda.
Your order {{orderNumber}} has been plac.ve: Oda yavho {{orderNumber}} yo vhewa. Mbadelo yo lindela — engedzani imeiḽi kha zwishumiswa zwa akhaunthu u itela u badela kha inthanethe, kana ni ḓadze mbadelo u bva kha Oda.
Your order {{orderNumber}} has been plac.ss: I-oda lakho {{orderNumber}} selifakiwe. Inkhokhelo ilindzelwe — faka i-imeyili kumasethingi e-akhawunti kute ubhadale ku-inthanethi, nobe uphelele kukhokha kusuka ku-Oda.

The repeat plan only remembers your pref.af: Die herhalingsplan onthou net jou voorkeur. Elke toekomstige bespreking bly hangende totdat jy betaal (of by die salon betaal) soos enige ander afspraak.
The repeat plan only remembers your pref.zu: Uhlelo oluphindayo lukhumbula kuphela okuncamelayo. Ukubhukha ngakunye okuzayo kuhlala kulindile uze ukhokhe (noma ukhokhe esaluni) njenganoma iyiphi enye i-aphoyintimenti.
The repeat plan only remembers your pref.xh: Isicwangciso sokuphinda sikhumbula kuphela ukhetho lwakho. Ukubhukisha ngakunye kwixa elizayo kuhlala kulindile de uhlawule (okanye uhlawule esaluni) njengalo naliphi na elinye idinga.
The repeat plan only remembers your pref.st: Morero oa ho pheta-pheta o hopola feela seo u se ratang. Peheletso e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea nakong e tlang e ntse e emetse ho fihlela u lefa (kapa u lefa salon) joalo ka kopano efe kapa efe.
The repeat plan only remembers your pref.nso: Leano la go boeletša le gopola feela kgetho ya gago. Peeletšo ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya ka moso e dula e sa eme go fihlela o lefa (goba o lefa salon) go swana le peeletšo efe goba efe ye nngwe.
The repeat plan only remembers your pref.tn: Leano la go boeletsa le gakologelwa fela se o se ratang. Peeletso nngwe le nngwe ya isagwe e nna e letile go fitlha o duela (kgotsa o duela kwa salong) jaaka peelanonako epe e nngwe.
The repeat plan only remembers your pref.ts: Pulani yo phindha-phindha yi tsundzuka ntsena leswi u swi tsakelaka. Ku bukuta kun’wana na kun’wana ka nkarhi lowu taka ku tshama ku yimerile ku kondza u hakela (kumbe u hakela esalonini) ku fana na ku hlangana kun’wana na kun’wana.
The repeat plan only remembers your pref.ve: Pulane ya u dovholola i humbula fhedzi zwine na zwi takalela. Booking inwe na inwe ya tshifhingani tshi daho i dzula yo lindela u swika ni tshi badela (kana u badela salon) sa dzinwe appointment.
The repeat plan only remembers your pref.ss: Luhlelo lwekuphindzaphindza lukhumbula kuphela lokukhetsako. Kubhuka ngamunye esikhatsini lesitako kuhlala kulindzelwe uze ubhadale (noma ubhadale e-salon) njenganoma ngukuphi lokunye ku-aphoyintimenti.

The payment window closed before we coul.af: Die betalingsvenster het gesluit voordat ons kon bevestig. As jy betaling voltooi het, sal jou bespreking binne 'n oomblik verskyn — anders tik Betaal om weer te probeer.
The payment window closed before we coul.zu: Iwindi lokukhokha livaliwe ngaphambi kokuthi siqinisekise. Uma uqedele ukukhokha, ukubhukha kwakho kuzovela maduzane — ngaphandle kwalokho thepha okuthi Khokha ukuze uzame futhi.
The payment window closed before we coul.xh: Ifestile yentlawulo ivaliwe phambi kokuba siqinisekise. Ukuba uyigqibile intlawulo, ukubhukisha kwakho kuya kubonakala ngephanyazo — kungenjalo cofa Hlawula ukuze uzame kwakhona.
The payment window closed before we coul.st: Fesetere ea ho lefa e ile ea koaloa pele re ka netefatsa. Haeba u qetile ho lefa, peeletso ea hau e tla hlaha ka mor'a nakoana — ho seng joalo tlanya Lefa ho leka hape.
The payment window closed before we coul.nso: Lefasetere la tefo le ile la tswalelwa pele re ka kgonthišetša. Ge o phethile tefo, peeletšo ya gago e tla tšwelela ka motsotswana — go sego bjalo kgotla Lefa go leka gape.
The payment window closed before we coul.tn: Lefensetere la tuelo le ne la tswalwa pele ga re ka tlhomamisa. Fa o weditse go duela, peeletso ya gago e tla tlhagelela mo nakong e khutshwane — go seng jalo tobetsa Duela go leka gape.
The payment window closed before we coul.ts: Fasitere ro hakela ri pfariwile hi nga si tiyisisa. Loko u hetile ku hakela, ku bukuta ka wena ku ta humelela hi nkarhinyana — handle ka sweswo khoma Hakela ku ringeta nakambe.
The payment window closed before we coul.ve: Fasitere ḽa mbadelo ḽo vala ri sa athu u khwaṱhisedza. Arali no fhedza u badela, u buka haṋu hu ḓo vhonala nga tshifhinganyana — arali zwi songo ralo, kha vha ṋaṋise Pay u itela u lingedza hafhu.
The payment window closed before we coul.ss: Lifasitelo lekukhokha livaliwe ngaphambi kwekutsi sicinisekise. Uma ngabe sewucedzile kukhokha, kubhuka kwakho kutawuvela ngesikhashana — ngaphandle kwaloko thepha Khokha kute uphindze uzame.

Use your real legal name and details exa.af: Gebruik jou regte wettige naam en besonderhede presies soos dit op jou ID of paspoort verskyn. Byname of nie-ooreenstemmende besonderhede sal veroorsaak dat verifikasie misluk.
Use your real legal name and details exa.zu: Sebenzisa igama lakho langempela elisemthethweni kanye nemininingwane njengoba ivela ku-ID noma kupasipoti yakho. Iziteketiso noma imininingwane engafani izodala ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kuhluleke.
Use your real legal name and details exa.xh: Sebenzisa igama lakho lokwenyani elisemthethweni kunye neenkcukacha kanye njengoko zivela kwisazisi sakho okanye ipaspoti. Iziteketiso okanye iinkcukacha ezingahambelaniyo ziya kubangela ukuba ukuqinisekiswa kusilele.
Use your real legal name and details exa.st: Sebelisa lebitso la hau la 'nete la molao le lintlha hantle joalo ka ha li hlaha ho ID kapa phasepoto ea hau. Mabitso kapa lintlha tse sa tsamaisaneng li tla etsa hore netefatso e hlolehe.
Use your real legal name and details exa.nso: Diriša leina la gago la nnete la molao le dintlha tlwaa bjalo ka ge di tšwelela ka go ID goba phasepoto ya gago. Maina a sereto goba dintlha tšeo di sa swanego di tla dira gore netefatšo e palelwe.
Use your real legal name and details exa.tn: Dirisa leina la gago la mmatota la semolao le dintlha tsa gago fela jaaka di tlhagelela mo ID kgotsa phaseporotong ya gago. Maina a botsalano kgotsa dintlha tse di sa tshwaneng di tla dira gore netefatso e palelwe.
Use your real legal name and details exa.ts: Tirhisa vito ra wena ra xiviri ra le nawini na vuxokoxoko hi ku kongoma hilaha byi humelelaka hakona eka ID kumbe pasi ra wena. Mavito ya xirhangiso kumbe vuxokoxoko lebyi nga fambelaniki byi ta endla leswaku ku tiyisisiwa ku tsandzeka.
Use your real legal name and details exa.ve: Shumisani dzina ḽaṋu ḽa vhukuma ḽa mulayo na zwidodombedzwa nga nḓila ine zwa vha ngayo kha ID kana phasipoto yaṋu. Madzina a u ḓihudza kana zwidodombedzwa zwi sa fani zwi ḓo ita uri khwaṱhisedzo i kundelwe.
Use your real legal name and details exa.ss: Sebentisa ligama lakho sibili lelisemtsetfweni kanye nemininingwane yakho njengobe ivela kumazisi wakho nobe kupasipoti yakho. Emagama esiteketiso noma imininingwane lengahambisani itawenta kutsi kucinisekisa kwehluleke.

Deactivating disables your account. Your.af: Deaktiveer jou rekening. Jou data word bewaar. Jy kan enige tyd heraktiveer deur weer aan te meld of die heraktiveerbladsy in die webtoepassing oop te maak.
Deactivating disables your account. Your.zu: Ukuvalwa kukhubaza i-akhawunti yakho. Idatha yakho igcinwa. Ungaphinda wenze kusebenze noma nini ngokungena futhi noma ngokuvula ikhasi lenze lisebenze kuhlelo lokusebenza lwewebhu.
Deactivating disables your account. Your.xh: Ukucima kucima iakhawunti yakho. Idatha yakho igciniwe. Unokwenza kwakhona nangaliphi na ixesha ngokungena kwakhona okanye uvule iphepha lokuvuselela kwi-app yewebhu.
Deactivating disables your account. Your.st: Ho tima ho thibela akhaonto ea hau. Lintlha tsa hau li bolokiloe. O ka bula hape neng kapa neng ka ho kena hape kapa ka ho bula leqephe la ho kenya ts'ebetsong ea tepo hape.
Deactivating disables your account. Your.nso: Go tima go šitiša akhaonto ya gago. ya data ya gago e bolokwa. O ka tsenya tirišong gape nako efe goba efe ka go tsena gape goba go bula letlakala la go tsenya tirišong gape ka go tirišo ya wepe.
Deactivating disables your account. Your.tn: Go tima go thibela akhaonto ya gago. Tshedimosetso ya gago e bolokilwe. O ka simolola gape nako nngwe le nngwe ka go tsena gape kgotsa go bula tsebe ya go simolola gape mo tirisong ya webo.
Deactivating disables your account. Your.ts: Ku tshika ku tirha swi tshikisa akhawunti ya wena. Data ya wena yi hlayisiwile. U nga ha tlhela u tirha nkarhi wihi na wihi hi ku nghena nakambe kumbe u pfula tluka ra ku tlhela u tirha eka app ya webu.
Deactivating disables your account. Your.ve: U dzima zwi thivhela akhaunthu yaṋu. Data yanu yo vhulungwa. Ni nga vusuludza tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe nga u dzhena hafhu kana u vula siaṱari ḽa u vusuludza kha web app.
Deactivating disables your account. Your.ss: Kucisha kucisha i-akhawunti yakho. Idatha yakho iyagcinwa. Ungaphindze uvule noma nini ngekuphindze ungene ngemvume nobe uvule likhasi lekuphindze uvule ku-web app.

Reviews are linked to a completed appoin.af: Resensies is gekoppel aan 'n voltooide afspraak. Bespreek eers 'n diens, gradeer dan jou ervaring vanaf Rekening → Besprekings of die besprekingsbesonderhedeskerm.
Reviews are linked to a completed appoin.zu: Izibuyekezo zixhunywe ku-aphoyintimenti eqediwe. Bhukha isevisi kuqala, bese ulinganisela okwenzayo ku-Akhawunti → Ukubhuka noma isikrini semininingwane yokubhuka.
Reviews are linked to a completed appoin.xh: Uphononongo lunxulunyaniswe nedinga eligqityiweyo. Bhukisha inkonzo kuqala, wandule ukale amava akho kwiAkhawunti → Ukubhukisha okanye isikrini seenkcukacha zokubhukisha.
Reviews are linked to a completed appoin.st: Maikutlo a amahanngoa le kopano e phethiloeng. Beha tšebeletso pele, ebe u fana ka lintlha tsa boiphihlelo ho tsoa ho Akhaonto → Lipehelo kapa skrineng sa lintlha tsa peheletso.
Reviews are linked to a completed appoin.nso: Ditshekatsheko di kgokagantšwe le peeletšo yeo e phethilwego. Beakanya tirelo pele, ke moka o lekanyetše maitemogelo a gago go tšwa go Akhaonto → Dipeeletšo goba skrine sa dintlha tša go beakanya.
Reviews are linked to a completed appoin.tn: Ditshekatsheko di golaganngwa le peelanonako e e weditsweng. Buka tirelo pele, o bo o lekanya maitemogelo a gago go tswa mo Akhaontong → Dipeeletso kgotsa mo sekirining sa dintlha tsa go buka.
Reviews are linked to a completed appoin.ts: Tinhlamuselo ti hlanganisiwa na nkarhi lowu hetisisiweke. Bukula vukorhokeri ku sungula, kutani u pima ntokoto wa wena ku suka eka Account → Bookings kumbe xikirini xa vuxokoxoko bya ku bukuta.
Reviews are linked to a completed appoin.ve: U vusuludzwa hu ṱumana na u tholwa ho fhelelaho. Bukani tshumelo phanḓa, nga murahu ni ṱolisise tshenzhelo yaṋu u bva kha Akhaunthu → U Buka kana kha tshikirini tsha zwidodombedzwa zwa u buka.
Reviews are linked to a completed appoin.ss: Kubuyeketwa kuhlobene nekubekwa lokugcwalisiwe. Bhukha insita kucala, bese ulinganisa lokuhlangenwe nako kwakho kusuka ku-Akhawunti → Kubhukha nobe esikrinini semininingwane yekubhuka.

under Account is the main place to set.af: onder Rekening is die hoofplek om taal, geldeenheid en tydsone in te stel. Hierdie skerm is slegs die taallys (vir kortpaaie); dit skryf dieselfde
under Account is the main place to set.zu: ngaphansi kwe-Akhawunti iyindawo eyinhloko yokusetha ulimi, uhlobo lwemali, nendawo yesikhathi. Lesi sikrini siwuhlu lolimi kuphela (lwezinqamuleli); ibhala okufanayo
under Account is the main place to set.xh: phantsi kweAkhawunti yeyona ndawo iphambili yokuseta ulwimi, imali, kunye nexesha lendawo. Esi sikrini luluhlu lweelwimi kuphela (yeendlela ezimfutshane); ibhala ngokufanayo
under Account is the main place to set.st: tlas'a Account ke sebaka sa mantlha sa ho beha puo, chelete, le sebaka sa nako. Skrine sena ke lenane la lipuo feela (bakeng sa likhaoletso); e ngola jwalo feela
under Account is the main place to set.nso: ka tlase ga Akhaonto ke lefelo le legolo la go beakanya polelo, tšhelete, le lefelo la nako. Skrine se ke lenaneo la polelo fela (bakeng sa dikgaoletšo); e ngwala se se swanago
under Account is the main place to set.tn: ka fa tlase ga Akhaonto ke lefelo le legolo la go seta puo, madi, le kgaolo ya nako. Sekerini sena ke feela lenane la puo (bakeng sa dikgaoletso); e kwala fela jalo
under Account is the main place to set.ts: ehansi ka Account i ndhawu leyikulu yo veka ririmi, mali, na nkarhi. Xikirini lexi i nxaxamelo wa tindzimi ntsena (wa switshunxo); yi tsala leswi fanaka
under Account is the main place to set.ve: fhasi ha Akhaunthu ndi fhethu huhulwane ha u vhea luambo, tshelede, na tshifhinga. Tshikirini itshi ndi mutevhe wa luambo fhedzi (wa zwipfufhi); ri nwala zwi fanaho .
under Account is the main place to set.ss: ngaphansi kwe-Akhawunti yindzawo leyinhloko yekubeka lulwimi, imali, kanye nesikhatsi. Lesi sikrini siluhlu lwelulwimi kuphela (lwetincutfu); libhala lokufanako .

Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.af: Geboortedatum vir geverifieerde identiteit (KYC) geniet voorrang bo die datum wat jy by aansluiting ingevoer het wanneer jy jou ouderdomsgroep vir uitbetalings en voldoening bepaal.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.zu: Idethi yokuzalwa yobunikazi obuqinisekisiwe (i-KYC) iza kuqala kunedethi oyifakile lapho ubhalisa lapho unquma ibhendi yakho yeminyaka yezinkokhelo nokuhambisana nayo.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.xh: Umhla wokuzalwa oQinisekisiweyo (KYC) wokuzalwa ubaluleke ngaphezu komhla owufakileyo ekubhaliseni xa umisela umda weminyaka yakho yeentlawulo kunye nokuthotyelwa.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.st: Letsatsi la tsoalo la Verified identity (KYC) le tla pele ho letsatsi leo u le kentseng ha u ingolisa ha u ne u etsa qeto ea lilemo tsa hau bakeng sa litefo le ho li latela.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.nso: Letšatšikgwedi la matswalo la boitšhupo bjo bo netefaditšwego (KYC) le tla pele go feta letšatšikgwedi leo o le tsentšego ge o saena ge o laetša sehlopha sa gago sa mengwaga bakeng sa ditefelo le kobamelo.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.tn: Letlha la matsalo la boitshupo jo bo netefaditsweng (KYC) le tla pele ga letlha le o le tsentseng fa o ikwadisa fa o tlhomamisa setlhopha sa dingwaga tsa gago tsa dituelo le go ikobela melao.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.ts: Siku ra ku velekiwa ra vutitivisi lebyi tiyisisiweke (KYC) ri rhangela siku leri u ri ngheniseke loko u tsarisa loko u kumisisa ntlawa wa malembe ya wena eka ku hakela na ku landzelela.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.ve: Ḓuvha ḽa mabebo ḽa vhuḓiṱalusi ho khwaṱhisedzwaho (KYC) ḽi dzhia vhuimo ha nṱha u fhira ḓuvha ḽe na ḽi ṅwala musi ni tshi ṅwalisa musi ni tshi tiwa tshigwada tsha miṅwaha yaṋu ya mbadelo na u tevhedza.
Verified identity (KYC) date of birth ta.ss: Lusuku lwekutalwa lwe-Verified ID (KYC) lutsatsa kucala kunelilanga lowalifaka ngesikhatsi ubhalisa uma uncuma iminyaka yakho yekukhokha kanye nekulandzela.

This account is registered as a provider.af: Hierdie rekening is geregistreer as 'n verskaffer. Tik hieronder om by die Beautonomi Partner-toepassing in te spring, of gaan voort op die webkliënteportaal om dienste te bespreek.
This account is registered as a provider.zu: Le akhawunti ibhaliswe njengomhlinzeki. Thepha ngezansi ukuze ugxumele kuhlelo lokusebenza lukazakwethu Beautonomi, noma uqhubeke kuphothali yekhasimende yewebhu ukuze ubhukhe amasevisi.
This account is registered as a provider.xh: Le akhawunti ibhalisiwe njengomboneleli. Cofa ngezantsi ukutsibela Beautonomi I-app yeqabane, okanye uqhubeke kwiwebhu yomthengi portal ukubhukisha iinkonzo.
This account is registered as a provider.st: Ak'haonte ena e ngolisitsoe joalo ka mofani oa thepa. Tobetsa ka tlase ho tlolela ka har'a app ea Beautonomi Partner app, kapa tsoelapele ho web moreki portal ho kopa lits'ebeletso.
This account is registered as a provider.nso: Akhaonto ye e ngwadišitšwe bjalo ka moabi. Kgwatha ka fase go tlolela ka gare ga tirišo ya Beautonomi Molekane, goba o tšwele pele go kgoro ya bareki ya wepe go ya ditirelo tša dipuku.
This account is registered as a provider.tn: Akhaonto eno e kwadisitswe jaaka moabi. Konya fa tlase go tsena mo tirisweng ya Beautonomi Partner, kgotsa tswelela mo kgorong ya khasetomara ya webo go beeletsa ditirelo.
This account is registered as a provider.ts: Akhawunti leyi yi tsarisiwile tanihi muphakeri. Thepha laha hansi ku tlula eka app ya Beautonomi Partner, kumbe u ya emahlweni eka web customer portal ku bukuta vukorhokeri.
This account is registered as a provider.ve: Akhaunthu iyi yo ṅwaliswa sa muṋetshedzi. Kha vha ṋaṋise afho fhasi u itela u dzhena kha Beautonomi app ya Mufarisani, kana vha bvele phanḓa kha porthaḽa ya vharengi ya webusaithi u itela u buka tshumelo.
This account is registered as a provider.ss: Le akhawunti ibhalisiwe njengemhlinzeki. Thepha ngetansi kute ungene ku-app ye-Beautonomi Partner, nobe uchubeke ku-web portal yemakhasimende kute ubhukhe tinsita.

Metrics show pending bookings that may i.af: Metrieke wys hangende besprekings wat groepversoeke of 'n ander datumreeks kan insluit. Trek om te verfris, of maak Groepbesprekings oop om partytjieversoeke na te gaan.
Metrics show pending bookings that may i.zu: Amamethrikhi abonisa ukubhukha okulindile okungase kuhlanganise izicelo zeqembu noma elinye ibanga ledethi. Donsa ukuze uvuselele, noma uvule ukubhukha kweqembu ukuze ubuyekeze izicelo zeqembu.
Metrics show pending bookings that may i.xh: Iimetrics zibonisa ukubhukisha okulindileyo okunokubandakanya izicelo zeqela okanye olunye uluhlu lomhla. Tsala ukuze uhlaziye, okanye uvule ubhukisho lweQela ukuze uphonononge izicelo zeqela.
Metrics show pending bookings that may i.st: Metrics e bonts'a lipehelo tse emetseng tse ka kenyelletsang likopo tsa sehlopha kapa matsatsi a mang. Hula ho nchafatsa, kapa bula peeletso ea Sehlopha ho hlahloba likopo tsa mokha.
Metrics show pending bookings that may i.nso: Dimetriki di bontšha dipeeletšo tše di sa emetšego tšeo di ka akaretšago dikgopelo tša sehlopha goba tekanyo ye nngwe ya matšatšikgwedi. Goga go hlabolla, goba bula dipeeletšo tša Sehlopha go sekaseka dikgopelo tša monyanya.
Metrics show pending bookings that may i.tn: Dimeteriki di bontsha dipeeletso tse di letisitsweng tse di ka akaretsang dikopo tsa setlhopha kgotsa mofuta o mongwe wa matlha. Goga go ntšhwafatsa, kgotsa bula dipeeletso tsa Setlhopha go sekaseka dikopo tsa phathi.
Metrics show pending bookings that may i.ts: Timetriki ti kombisa ku bukuta loku yimeleke loku nga katsa swikombelo swa ntlawa kumbe nxaxamelo wun’wana wa masiku. Koka ku pfuxeta, kutani u pfula tibuku ta Ntlawa ku kambisisa swikombelo swa nkhuvo.
Metrics show pending bookings that may i.ve: Methiki dzi sumbedza u buka ho lindelaho hune ha nga katela khumbelo dza tshigwada kana muṅwe muelo wa ḓuvha. Hudzani u itela u vusuludza, kana ni vule vhupo ha Tshigwada u itela u sedzulusa khumbelo dza phathi.
Metrics show pending bookings that may i.ss: Emamethrikhi akhombisa kubhukha lokulindzelwe lokungafaka ekhatsi ticelo telicembu noma lelinye libanga lelusuku. Dvonsa kute uvuselele, nobe uvule kubhukha kweLicembu kute ubuyekete ticelo telicembu.

Add your bank account so finance can pay.af: Voeg jou bankrekening by sodat finansies platformverdienste aan die regte rekening kan betaal. Jy kan met Paystack verifieer of die rekeningnaam handmatig invoer.
Add your bank account so finance can pay.zu: Engeza i-akhawunti yakho yasebhange ukuze ezezimali zikhokhe izinzuzo eziphethwe yinkundla ku-akhawunti efanele. Ungaqinisekisa nge-Paystack noma ufake igama le-akhawunti mathupha.
Add your bank account so finance can pay.xh: Yongeza iakhawunti yakho yebhanki ukuze imali ikwazi ukuhlawula umvuzo ogcinwe kwiqonga kwiakhawunti elungileyo. Ungaqinisekisa nge Paystack okanye ufake igama le-akhawunti ngesandla.
Add your bank account so finance can pay.st: Kenya ak'haonte ea hau ea banka hore lichelete li khone ho lefa meputso ea sethala ho akhaonto e nepahetseng. O ka netefatsa ka Paystack kapa kenya lebitso la akhaonto ka bowena.
Add your bank account so finance can pay.nso: Oketša akhaonto ya gago ya panka gore ditšhelete di kgone go lefa mogolo wo o swerwego ke sefala go akhaonto ye e nepagetšego. O ka netefatša ka Paystack goba wa tsenya leina la akhaonto ka seatla.
Add your bank account so finance can pay.tn: Tsenya akhaonto ya gago ya banka gore matlole a kgone go duela moputso o o tshwerweng ke polatefomo mo akhaontong e e siameng. O ka netefatsa ka Paystack kgotsa wa tsenya leina la akhaonto ka seatla.
Add your bank account so finance can pay.ts: Engetelani akhawunti ya wena ya le bangi leswaku timali ti ta hakela miholo leyi khomiweke eka pulatifomo eka akhawunti leyi faneleke. U nga tiyisisa hi Paystack kumbe u nghenisa vito ra akhawunti hi voko.
Add your bank account so finance can pay.ve: Engedzani akhaunthu yaṋu ya bannga uri masheleni a kone u badela miholo yo farwaho nga pulatifomo kha akhaunthu yo teaho. Ni nga khwaṱhisedza nga Paystack kana na ṅwala dzina ḽa akhaunthu nga tshanḓa.
Add your bank account so finance can pay.ss: Ngeta i-akhawunti yakho yasebhange kute timali tikhone kukhokha imali lephethwe yipulatifomu ku-akhawunti lefanele. Ungacinisekisa nge Paystack noma ufake ligama le-akhawunti ngesandla.

Some team members were deactivated after.af: Sommige spanlede is gedeaktiveer ná 'n planafgradering. Genade duur tot {{date}}. Gradeer op of hou die rooster by die nuwe limiet om hulle te heraktiveer.
Some team members were deactivated after.zu: Amanye amalungu eqembu enziwe angasebenzi ngemva kokwehliswa kwepulani. Umusa uhlala kuze kube {{date}}. Thuthukisa noma gcina uhlu emkhawulweni omusha ukuze uphinde uwasebenzise.
Some team members were deactivated after.xh: Amanye amalungu eqela aye acinywa emva kokuthotywa kwesicwangciso. Ubabalo luhlala kude kube {{date}}. Hlaziya okanye ugcine uluhlu lwamagama kumda omtsha ukuze uphinde uwavule.
Some team members were deactivated after.st: Litho tse ling tsa sehlopha li ile tsa koalloa ka mor'a hore moralo o fokotsehe. Mohau o nka ho fihlela {{date}}. Ntlafatsa kapa u boloke lenane moeling o mocha ho li bula hape.
Some team members were deactivated after.nso: Maloko a mangwe a sehlopha a ile a kgaotša go šoma ka morago ga go theošwa ga maemo a leano. Mogau o swarelela go fihla {{date}}. Ntlafatša goba o boloke lenaneo la lenaneo le le moeding o mofsa go di dira gore di šome gape.
Some team members were deactivated after.tn: Maloko mangwe a setlhopha a ne a timiwa morago ga go fokodiwa ga thulaganyo. Mohau o dula ho fihlela {{date}}. Ntšhwafatsa kgotsa boloka lenaane mo tekanyetsong e ntšhwa go di dira gape.
Some team members were deactivated after.ts: Swirho swin’wana swa ntlawa swi herisiwile endzhaku ka ku hungutiwa ka pulani. Tintswalo ti tshama ku fikela {{date}}. Ndlandlamuxa kumbe ku hlayisa roster eka mpimo lowuntshwa ku va tlhela va tirha.
Some team members were deactivated after.ve: Vhaṅwe miraḓo ya thimu vho vha vho dzimiwa nga murahu ha u fhungudzwa ha pulane. Tshilidzi tshi dzula u swika {{date}}. U khwinisa kana u vhulunga roster kha limit ntswa u itela u dzi vusuludza.
Some team members were deactivated after.ss: Lamanye emalunga elicembu acinywe ngemuva kwekwehliswa kweluhlelo. Umusa uhlala kuze kube ngu {{date}}. Tfutfukisa noma ugcine luhlu emkhawulweni lomusha kute ubaphindze basebente.

You must be at least 13 to use social fe.af: Jy moet ten minste 13 wees om sosiale kenmerke soos Explore, opmerkings, laaiks en boodskappe te gebruik. Ouderdom word geverifieer met jou geboortedatum na aanmelding.
You must be at least 13 to use social fe.zu: Kufanele okungenani ube neminyaka eyi-13 ukusebenzisa izici zomphakathi ezifana Explore, ukuphawula, ukuthanda, kanye nemiyalezo. Ubudala buqinisekiswa kusetshenziswa idethi yakho yokuzalwa ngemva kokungena ngemvume.
You must be at least 13 to use social fe.xh: Kufuneka ube neminyaka eli-13 ubuncinane ukusebenzisa iimpawu zentlalo ezifana Explore, izimvo, ukuthanda, kunye nemiyalezo. Ubudala buqinisekiswa kusetyenziswa umhla wakho wokuzalwa emva kokungena.
You must be at least 13 to use social fe.st: O tlameha ho ba bonyane lilemo tse 13 ho sebelisa likarolo tsa sechaba joalo ka Explore, maikutlo, lintho tseo u li ratang, le melaetsa. Lilemo li netefatsoa ho sebelisoa letsatsi la tsoalo ka mor'a ho kena.
You must be at least 13 to use social fe.nso: O swanetše go ba le bonnyane bja mengwaga ye 13 go šomiša dikarolo tša leago tša go swana le Explore, ditshwayotshwayo, go rata, le melaetša. Mengwaga e netefatšwa ka go šomiša letšatšikgwedi la gago la matswalo ka morago ga go tsena.
You must be at least 13 to use social fe.tn: O tshwanetse go nna le dingwaga di le 13 go dirisa ditiriso tsa botsalano tse di jaaka Explore, ditshwaelo, go rata, le go romela melaetsa. Dingwaga di netefadiwa ka go dirisa letlha la gago la matsalo morago ga go saenela go tsena.
You must be at least 13 to use social fe.ts: U fanele ku va na kwalomu ka 13 ku tirhisa switirhisiwa swa ntshamisano swo fana na Explore, mavonelo, ku tsakela, na ku rhumela marungula. Malembe ya tiyisisiwa hi ku tirhisa siku ra wena ro velekiwa endzhaku ko nghena.
You must be at least 13 to use social fe.ve: U fanela u vha na miṅwaha i si fhasi ha 13 u itela u shumisa zwishumiswa zwa matshilisano zwi ngaho Explore, vhupfiwa, u takalela, na milaedza. Miṅwaha i khwaṱhisedzwa hu tshi shumiswa ḓuvha ḽa mabebo nga murahu ha musi no dzhena.
You must be at least 13 to use social fe.ss: Kufanele ube neminyaka lengu-13 budzala kute usebentise tintfo tetenhlalo letifana ne-Explore, kuphawula, kutsandza, kanye nemilayeto. Iminyaka icinisekiswa kusetjentiswa lilanga lakho lekutalwa ngemuva kwekungena ngemvume.

Turn on notifications so you never miss.af: Skakel kennisgewings aan sodat jy nooit besprekings, boodskappe en uitbetalingopdaterings mis nie. Ligging- en fototoegang word later versoek wanneer jy daardie kenmerke gebruik.
Turn on notifications so you never miss.zu: Vula izaziso ukuze ungaphuthelwa ukubhukha, imilayezo, nezibuyekezo zenkokhelo. Ukufinyelela kwendawo nesithombe kucelwa kamuva uma usebenzisa lezo zici.
Turn on notifications so you never miss.xh: Layita izaziso ukuze ungaphoswa kukubhukisha, imiyalezo, kunye nohlaziyo lwentlawulo. Indawo kunye nofikelelo lweefoto zicelwa kamva xa usebenzisa ezo mpawu.
Turn on notifications so you never miss.st: Laeta litemoso hore o seke oa fetoa ke lipehelo, melaetsa le ditsebiso tsa ho lefa. Sebaka le linepe li kopuoa hamorao ha u sebelisa likarolo tseo.
Turn on notifications so you never miss.nso: Bulela ditsebišo gore o se ke wa foša dipeeletšo, melaetša, le diapdeite tša tefo. Phihlelelo ya lefelo le ya diswantšho di kgopelwa ka morago ge o šomiša dikarolo tšeo.
Turn on notifications so you never miss.tn: Tobetsa dikitsiso gore o se ka wa fetwa ke dipeeletso, melaetsa, le dintšhwafatso tsa tuelo. Phitlhelelo ya lefelo le senepe di kopiwa moragonyana fa o dirisa ditiriso tseo.
Turn on notifications so you never miss.ts: Vulavula hi switiviso leswaku u nga tshuki u pfumala ku bukuta, marungula, na ku pfuxetiwa ka ku hakela. Ndhawu ni ku nghena eka swifaniso swa komberiwa endzhaku loko u tirhisa swilo sweswo.
Turn on notifications so you never miss.ve: Kha vha vule nḓivhadzo uri vha si vhuye vha xelelwa nga u buka, milaedza, na mvelaphanḓa ya mbadelo. Fhethu na u swikelela zwifanyiso zwi humbelwa nga murahu musi ni tshi shumisa zwenezwo zwishumiswa.
Turn on notifications so you never miss.ss: Vula tatiso kute ungaphutselwa kubhukha, imilayeto, kanye netibuyeketo tekukhokha. Indzawo kanye nekufinyelela titfombe kuyacelwa kamuva nawusebentisa leto tici.

Add this code to your website to embed t.af: Voeg hierdie kode by jou webwerf om die besprekingslegstuk in te sluit. Kaartbetaling en Google of Apple-aanmelding maak oop op Beautonomi sodat die kliënt veilig kan klaarmaak.
Add this code to your website to embed t.zu: Engeza le khodi kuwebhusayithi yakho ukuze ushumeke iwijethi yokubhuka. Inkokhelo yekhadi kanye Google noma Apple ukungena ngemvume kuvuliwe ku Beautonomi ukuze ikhasimende liqede ngokuphepha.
Add this code to your website to embed t.xh: Yongeza le khowudi kwiwebhusayithi yakho ukuze uzinzise iwijethi yokubhukisha. Intlawulo yekhadi kunye Google okanye Apple ukungena vula ku Beautonomi ukuze umthengi agqibe ngokukhuselekileyo.
Add this code to your website to embed t.st: Kenya khoutu ena sebakeng sa hau sa Marang-rang ho kenya widget ea ho beeletsa. Tefo ea karete le Google kapa Apple ho kena ho butsoe ho Beautonomi hore moreki a qete a sireletsehile.
Add this code to your website to embed t.nso: Oketša khoutu ye wepsaeteng ya gago go tsenya sedirišwa sa go beakanya. Tefo ya karata le Google goba Apple go tsena di bulegile ka Beautonomi gore moreki a kgone go fetša ka polokego.
Add this code to your website to embed t.tn: Tsenya khoutu eno mo webosaeteng ya gago go tsenya sediriswa sa go buka. Tuelo ya karata le Google kgotsa Apple go saena go bulwa mo Beautonomi gore khasetomara e kgone go fetsa ka pabalesego.
Add this code to your website to embed t.ts: Engetelani khodi leyi eka webusayiti ya wena ku nghenisa xitirhisiwa xo bukuta. Ku hakela khadi na Google kumbe Apple ku nghena swi pfulekile hi Beautonomi leswaku khasimende yi ta kota ku heta hi ku hlayiseka.
Add this code to your website to embed t.ve: Engedzani khoudu iyi kha webusaithi yaṋu u itela u dzhenisa tshishumiswa tsha u buka. Mbadelo ya khadi na Google kana Apple u dzhena zwi vula kha Beautonomi uri khasiṱama i kone u fhedza yo tsireledzea.
Add this code to your website to embed t.ss: Ngeta lekhodi kuwebhusayithi yakho kute ufake iwijethi yekubhuka. Kukhokha ngelikhadi kanye ne Google nobe Apple kungena kuvulwa ku Beautonomi kute likhasimende likhone kucedza ngekuphepha.

This build is missing a required setting.af: Hierdie gebou ontbreek 'n vereiste instelling (EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL). Herinstalleer asseblief die nuutste toepassing vanaf die winkel, of kontak ondersteuning indien die probleem voortduur.
This build is missing a required setting.zu: Lesi sakhiwo sishoda ngesilungiselelo esidingekayo (EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL). Sicela ufake kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza lwakamuva esitolo, noma uthinte abosekelo uma inkinga iqhubeka.
This build is missing a required setting.xh: Olu lwakhiwo luswele useto olufunekayo (EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL). Nceda ufake kwakhona usetyenziso lwamva nje olusuka evenkileni, okanye uqhagamshelane nenkxaso ukuba ingxaki iyaqhubeka.
This build is missing a required setting.st: Moaho ona ha o na litlhophiso tse hlokahalang (EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL). Ka kopo, kenya sesebelisoa sa morao-rao ho tsoa lebenkeleng, kapa ikopanye le tšehetso haeba bothata bo phehella.
This build is missing a required setting.nso: Kago ye e hlaelelwa ke peakanyo ye e nyakegago (EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL). Hle tsenya tirišo ya moragorago gape go tšwa lebenkeleng, goba ikgokaganye le thekgo ge e ba bothata bo phegelela.
This build is missing a required setting.tn: Kago eno ga e na seting e e tlhokegang (URL ya_PONTSO_PUBLIC_APP). Tsweetswee tsenya gape tiriswa ya bosheng go tswa mo lebentleleng, kgotsa ikgolaganye le tshegetso fa bothata bo tswelela.
This build is missing a required setting.ts: Ku aka loku ku kayivela xiyimiso lexi lavekaka (EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL). Hi kombela u tlhela u nghenisa app ya sweswinyana ku suka exitolo, kumbe u tihlanganisa ni nseketelo loko xiphiqo xi nga heli.
This build is missing a required setting.ve: U fhaṱa uhu hu khou shaya nzudzanyo i ṱoḓeaho (EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL). Kha vha dzhenise hafhu app ya zwenezwino u bva vhengeleni, kana vha kwame thikhedzo arali thaidzo i tshi kha ḓi vha hone.
This build is missing a required setting.ss: Lokwakha kushoda kusetha lokudzingekako (EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_URL). Sicela ufake kabusha i-app yakamuva esitolo, nobe utsintse lusekelo nangabe lenkinga ichubeka.

Apple manages this subscription. Cancel.af: Apple bestuur hierdie intekening. Kanselleer ten minste 24 uur voor die tydperk eindig in Apple ID → Intekeninge. Jy behou toegang tot die huidige tydperk eindig.
Apple manages this subscription. Cancel.zu: Apple iphethe lokhu kubhalisa. Khansela okungenani amahora angama-24 ngaphambi kokuthi isikhathi siphele Apple ID → Okubhaliselwe. Ugcina ukufinyelela kuze kuphele isikhathi samanje.
Apple manages this subscription. Cancel.xh: Apple ilawula lo mrhumo. Rhoxisa ubuncinane kwiiyure ezingama-24 phambi kokuba ixesha liphele Apple ID → Imirhumo. Ugcina ukufikelela kude kube lixesha langoku.
Apple manages this subscription. Cancel.st: Apple e laola phaliso ena. Hlakola bonyane lihora tse 24 pele nako e fela ka Apple ID → Lipehelo. U boloka phihlello ho fihlela nako ea hajoale e fela.
Apple manages this subscription. Cancel.nso: Apple o laola peeletšo ye. Khansela bonnyane diiri tše 24 pele nako e fela ka Apple ID → Dipeeletšo. O boloka phihlelelo go fihlela nako ya bjale e fela.
Apple manages this subscription. Cancel.tn: Apple e laola peeletso eno. Khansela bonnye diura di le 24 pele ga nako e fela mo Apple ID → Dipeeletso. O boloka phitlhelelo go fitlha paka ya ga jaana e fela.
Apple manages this subscription. Cancel.ts: Apple u lawula xikhokhelo lexi. Khansela kwalomu ka tiawara ta 24 nkarhi wu nga si hela hi Apple ID → Swikhokhelo. U hlayisa mfikelelo ku kondza nkarhi wa sweswi wu hela.
Apple manages this subscription. Cancel.ve: Apple i langa u ṅwalisa uhu. Khansela hu sa athu fhela awara dza 24 tshifhinga tshi sa athu fhela kha Apple ID → U ḓiṅwalisa. U dzula u tshi swikelela u swika tshifhinga tsha zwino tshi tshi fhela.
Apple manages this subscription. Cancel.ss: Apple ulawula lokubhalisa. Khansela lokungenani emahora langu-24 ngaphambi kwekutsi sikhatsi siphelele ku Apple ID → Kubhalisa. Ugcina kufinyelela kuze kube ngulapho sikhatsi lesikhona nyalo sesiphelile.

This will delete the entire recurring se.af: Dit sal die hele herhalende reeks vir {{name}} uitvee. Toekomstige outo-geskepte besoeke sal stop; bestaande besprekings wat reeds op die kalender is, bly soos dit is.
This will delete the entire recurring se.zu: Lokhu kuzosusa lonke uchungechunge oluqhubekayo lwe-{{name}}. Ukuvakasha okuzenzakalelayo okuzayo kuzoma; ukubhuka okukhona kakade ekhalendeni kuhlala njengoba kunjalo.
This will delete the entire recurring se.xh: Oku kuyakucima lonke uthotho oluqhubekayo lwe- {{name}}. Utyelelo lwexesha elizayo olwenziwe ngokuzenzekelayo luya kuyeka; ubhukisho olusele lukhona kwikhalenda luhlala njengoko lunjalo.
This will delete the entire recurring se.st: Sena se tla hlakola letoto lohle le hlahang khafetsa bakeng sa {{name}}. Maeto a tlang a iketselitsoeng a tla emisa; libuka tse seng li ntse li le teng almanakeng lula li le joalo.
This will delete the entire recurring se.nso: Se se tla phumola lelokelelo ka moka leo le ipoeletšago bakeng sa {{name}}. Diketelo tša ka moso tšeo di hlotšwego ka go itiriša di tla ema; dipeeletšo tše di lego gona tšeo di šetšego di le almanaka di dula bjalo ka ge di le bjalo.
This will delete the entire recurring se.tn: Se se tla phimola motseletsele otlhe o o ipoeletsang wa {{name}}. Diketelo tsa isagwe tse di tlhamilweng ka go itirisa di tla ema; dipeeletso tse di setseng di le mo khalentareng di nna jaaka di ntse.
This will delete the entire recurring se.ts: Leswi swi ta susa nxaxamelo hinkwawo lowu vuyeleriwaka wa {{name}}. Maendzo ya nkarhi lowu taka lama endliweke hi ku tisungulela ma ta yima; tibuku leti nga kona leti se ti nga eka khalendara ti tshama tanihi leswi ti nga xiswona.
This will delete the entire recurring se.ve: Izwi zwi ḓo phumula mutevhe woṱhe une wa dovholola wa {{name}}. Madalo a tshifhingani tshi ḓaho o ḓiitelaho a ḓo ima; bookings dzine dza vha hone dzine dza vha kha khalenda dzi dzule nga nḓila ine dza vha ngayo.
This will delete the entire recurring se.ss: Loku kutawususa lonkhe luchungechunge loluphindzaphindvwako lwe {{name}}. Kuvakasha lokudalwe ngekuzenzakalela kwesikhatsi lesitako kutawuma; kubhuka lokukhona vele kukhalenda kuhlala njengobe kunjalo.

Ask the customer to scan this QR or use.af: Vra die kliënt om hierdie QR te skandeer of gebruik die skakel om te betaal. Paystack genereer die transaksieverwysing; sodra dit aankom, ken dit toe vanaf jou terminale inkassie.
Ask the customer to scan this QR or use.zu: Cela ikhasimende ukuthi liskene le-QR noma lisebenzise isixhumanisi ukuze likhokhe. Paystack ikhiqiza ireferensi yetransekshini; uma isifikile, yabele ebhokisini lakho lokungenayo letheminali.
Ask the customer to scan this QR or use.xh: Cela umthengi ukuba askene le QR okanye asebenzise ilinki ukuhlawula. Paystack yenza ireferensi yentengiselwano; nje ukuba ifikile, yabele kwibhokisi yakho yangaphakathi yesiphelo.
Ask the customer to scan this QR or use.st: Kopa moreki hore a hlahlobe QR ena kapa a sebelise sehokelo ho lefa. Paystack e hlahisa tšupiso ea transaction; hang ha e fihla, e abele ho inbox ea hau ea terminal.
Ask the customer to scan this QR or use.nso: Kgopela moreki go skena QR ye goba o šomiše kgokagano go lefa. Paystack e tšweletša tšhupetšo ya kgwebišano; ge e fihlile, e aba go tšwa go lepokisi la gago la go tsena la terminal.
Ask the customer to scan this QR or use.tn: Kopa khasetomara go sekaseka QR eno kgotsa go dirisa kgokagano go duela. Paystack e tlhagisa tshupiso ya kgwebisano; fa e sena go goroga, e abe go tswa mo lebokosong la gago la theminale.
Ask the customer to scan this QR or use.ts: Kombela muxavi ku skena QR leyi kutani u tirhisa link ku hakela. Paystack ku tumbuluxa xikombo xa ntirhisano; loko yi fika, yi avela ku suka eka inbox ya wena ya theminali.
Ask the customer to scan this QR or use.ve: Humbelani khasiṱama uri i scan QR iyi kana ni shumise link u itela u badela. Paystack i bveledza ṱhalutshedzo ya thengiselano; musi yo no swika, i kovheleni u bva kha inbox yaṋu ya theminala.
Ask the customer to scan this QR or use.ss: Cela likhasimende kutsi liskene le-QR nobe lisebentise le-link kute libhadale. Paystack ikhicita ireferensi yekutsengiselana; uma seyifikile, yabela kusuka ebhokisini lakho le-inbox le-terminal.

Automated business verification is not a.af: Outomatiese besigheidsverifikasie is nie vir jou registrasieland beskikbaar nie. Kontak ondersteuning met jou maatskappy se registrasiedokumente vir 'n handmatige hersiening.
Automated business verification is not a.zu: Ukuqinisekiswa kwebhizinisi okuzenzakalelayo akutholakali ezweni lakho lokubhalisa. Xhumana nosekelo ngamadokhumenti okubhaliswa kwenkampani yakho ukuze ubuyekeze mathupha.
Automated business verification is not a.xh: Ukuqinisekiswa kweshishini okuzenzekelayo akufumaneki kwilizwe lakho lokubhalisa. Qhagamshelana nenkxaso kunye namaxwebhu obhaliso lwenkampani yakho ukuze uphonononge ngesandla.
Automated business verification is not a.st: Netefatso ea khoebo ha e fumanehe naheng eo u ingolisang eona. Ikopanye le tšehetso le litokomane tsa hau tsa ngoliso ea khamphani bakeng sa tlhahlobo ea matsoho.
Automated business verification is not a.nso: Netefatšo ya kgwebo ya go itiriša ga e hwetšagale bakeng sa naga ya gago ya ngwadišo. Ikgokaganye le thekgo ka ditokomane tša gago tša ngwadišo ya khamphani bakeng sa tshekatsheko ya seatla.
Automated business verification is not a.tn: Netefatso ya kgwebo e e itirisang ga e yo mo nageng ya gago ya ikwadiso. Ikgolaganye le tshegetso ka ditokomane tsa kwadiso ya khamphani ya gago go bona tshekatsheko ya seatla.
Automated business verification is not a.ts: Ku tiyisisiwa ka bindzu hi xiothomethi a ku kumeki eka tiko ra wena ro tsarisa. Tihlanganisi na nseketelo na matsalwa ya ntsariso wa khamphani ya wena ku kuma nkambisiso wa manual.
Automated business verification is not a.ve: U khwaṱhisedzwa ha bindu nga vhuḓiitisi a hu wanali kha shango ḽaṋu ḽa u ṅwalisa. Kha vha kwame thikhedzo nga maṅwalo a u ṅwalisa khamphani yavho u itela u sedzulusa nga manyuala.
Automated business verification is not a.ss: Kucinisekiswa kwebhizinisi lokuzenzakalelayo akutfolakali eveni lakho lekubhalisa. Tihlanganise nekusekelwa ngemibhalo yakho yekubhaliswa kwenkampani kute ubuyeketwe ngesandla.

Beautonomi uses your date of birth to ap.af: Beautonomi gebruik jou geboortedatum om ouderdomsgeskikte kenmerke, ouerkontroles en verifikasievereistes toe te pas. Jou huidige ouderdomsgroep word hieronder getoon.
Beautonomi uses your date of birth to ap.zu: Beautonomi isebenzisa usuku lwakho lokuzalwa ukuze isebenzise izici ezifanele iminyaka yobudala, izilawuli zabazali, kanye nezimfuneko zokuqinisekisa. Ibhendi yeminyaka yakho yamanje iboniswa ngezansi.
Beautonomi uses your date of birth to ap.xh: Beautonomi isebenzisa umhla wakho wokuzalwa ukusebenzisa iimpawu ezifanelekileyo ubudala, ulawulo lwabazali, kunye neemfuno zokuqinisekisa. Ibhendi yeminyaka yakho yangoku iboniswe ngezantsi.
Beautonomi uses your date of birth to ap.st: Beautonomi sebelisa letsatsi la tsoalo ho sebelisa likarolo tse tsamaellanang le lilemo, taolo ea batsoali, le litlhoko tsa netefatso. Sehlopha sa lilemo tsa hau hajoale se bonts'itsoe ka tlase.
Beautonomi uses your date of birth to ap.nso: Beautonomi o šomiša letšatšikgwedi la gago la matswalo go diriša diponagalo tše di swanetšego mengwaga, ditaolo tša batswadi, le dinyakwa tša netefatšo. Sehlopha sa gago sa mengwaga ya bjale se bontšhitšwe ka mo tlase.
Beautonomi uses your date of birth to ap.tn: Beautonomi e dirisa letlha la gago la matsalo go dirisa dikarolo tse di tshwanelang dingwaga tsa gago, ditaolo tsa botsadi, le ditlhokego tsa netefatso. Setlhopha sa dingwaga tsa gago tsa ga jaana se bontshiwa fa tlase.
Beautonomi uses your date of birth to ap.ts: Beautonomi u tirhisa siku ra wena ra ku velekiwa ku tirhisa swihlawulekisi leswi faneleke malembe, vulawuri bya vatswari, na swilaveko swa ku tiyisisa. Ntlawa wa malembe ya wena ya sweswi wu kombisiwile laha hansi.
Beautonomi uses your date of birth to ap.ve: Beautonomi i shumisa ḓuvha ḽaṋu ḽa mabebo u shumisa zwidodombedzwa zwo teaho miṅwaha, ndaulo ya vhabebi, na ṱhoḓea dza u khwaṱhisedza. Miṅwaha yaṋu ya zwino yo sumbedzwa afho fhasi.
Beautonomi uses your date of birth to ap.ss: Beautonomi usebentisa lilanga lakho lekutalwa kusebentisa timphawu letifanele iminyaka yakho, kulawula kwebatali, kanye netidzingo tekucinisekisa. Ibhendi yakho yeminyaka yamanje ikhonjisiwe lapha ngentasi.

After setup, you can complete full ident.tn: Morago ga go rulaganya, o ka feleletsa netefatso e e feletseng ya boitshupo (tokomane ya ID) go bona betšhe ya mmaraka o o Netefaditsweng. Se ke sa boikgethelo mme se oketsa tshepo ya bareki.
