After setup, you can complete full ident.ve: Nga murahu ha u dzudzanya, vha nga ḓadza khwaṱhisedzo yo fhelelaho ya vhuḓiṱalusi (ḽiṅwalo ḽa ID) u itela u wana bege ya makete yo Ṱanganedzwaho. Hezwi ndi zwa u ḓikhethela fhedzi zwi engedza fulufhelo ḽa vharengi.
After setup, you can complete full ident.ss: Ngemuva kwekusetha, ungagcwalisa kucinisekiswa lokuphelele kwemazisi (idokhumenti ye-ID) kute utfole libheji lemakethe lecinisekisiwe. Loku kuyakhetfwa kepha kukhulisa kwetsemba kwemakhasimende.

Save into your phone’s calendar app (App.ss: Gcina ku-app yekhalenda yefoni yakho (Apple Ikhalenda, Google kudivayisi yakho, iKhalenda ye-Samsung, njll.), vula ikhalenda yewebhu, noma wabelane ngelifayela lekungenisa noma ngukuphi.

Weekly schedules define normal availabil.af: Weeklikse skedules definieer normale beskikbaarheid. Datumspesifieke skofte hieronder ondersteun gesplete skofte en eenmalige vervangings vir besige dae, geleenthede of alternatiewe roosters.
Weekly schedules define normal availabil.zu: Amashejuli amasonto onke achaza ukutholakala okuvamile. Amashifu aqondene nedethi angezansi asekela amashifu okuhlukanisa kanye nokukhipha okukodwa kwezinsuku ezimatasa, imicimbi, noma ezinye izinhlelo.
Weekly schedules define normal availabil.xh: Iishedyuli zeveki zichaza ukufumaneka okuqhelekileyo. Ukutshintsha okuthe ngqo kumhla ngezantsi kwenkxaso yokwahlula iishifti kunye nokukhutshwa okukodwa kweentsuku ezixakekileyo, imicimbi, okanye iirosta ezitshintshanayo.
Weekly schedules define normal availabil.st: Mananeo a beke le beke a hlalosa ho fumaneha ho tloaelehileng. Lichifi tse ikhethileng ka letsatsi tse ka tlase ho tšehetso ea lichifi tse arohaneng le ho feta hanngoe bakeng sa matsatsi a maphathaphathe, liketsahalo, kapa manane a mang.
Weekly schedules define normal availabil.nso: Dipeelano tša beke le beke di hlaloša go hwetšagala mo go tlwaelegilego. Diphetogo tše di itšego tša letšatšikgwedi ka fase di thekga diphetogo tša go arogana le go phaela ka thoko ga tee bakeng sa matšatši a swaregilego, ditiragalo, goba mananeo a mangwe.
Weekly schedules define normal availabil.tn: Dithulaganyo tsa beke le beke di tlhalosa go nna teng go go tlwaelegileng. Dishifiti tse di rileng tsa letlha tse di fa tlase di tshegetsa dishifiti tse di kgaogantsweng le go phimolwa gangwe fela ga malatsi a a tlhanaselang, ditiragalo, kgotsa manaane a mangwe.
Weekly schedules define normal availabil.ts: Swiyimiso swa vhiki na vhiki swi hlamusela ku kumeka loku tolovelekeke. Ku cinca loku kongomisiweke hi siku laha hansi ku seketela ku cinca loku avaneke na ku tlula ka nkarhi wun’we eka masiku yo khomeka, swiendlakalo, kumbe nxaxamelo wun’wana.
Weekly schedules define normal availabil.ve: Mbekanyamushumo dza vhege dzi ṱalusa u vha hone ho ḓoweleaho. Tshifhinga tsho khetheaho tsha ḓuvha tshi re afho fhasi tshi tikedza tshifhinga tsho fhandekanaho na u fhirisa lwa luthihi lwa maḓuvha o farakaneaho, zwiitea, kana dziṅwe rosiṱere.
Weekly schedules define normal availabil.ss: Emashejuli eliviki achaza kutfolakala lokujwayelekile. Emashifu lakhetsekile elusuku langentansi asekela emashifu lahlukene kanye nekucitsa lokukodwa kwemalanga lamatasatasa, imicimbi, noma lamanye ema-rosters.

Earnings appear here once payments are r.af: Verdienste verskyn hier sodra betalings in jou finansiële grootboek aangeteken is (aanlyn- en platformbetalings). Kontant wat direk ingesamel word, mag nie in hierdie totaal wys nie.
Earnings appear here once payments are r.zu: Izinzuzo zivela lapha uma izinkokhelo sezirekhodwe ebhukwini lakho lezezimali (izinkokhelo eziku-inthanethi neziphethwe yinkundla). Imali eqoqwe ngokuqondile ingase ingabonisi kuleli nani.
Earnings appear here once payments are r.xh: Imivuzo ibonakala apha xa iintlawulo zirekhodwa kwileja yakho yezemali (kwi-intanethi kunye neentlawulo ezibanjwa eqongeni). Imali eqokelelwe ngokuthe ngqo isenokungabonakali kweli nani lilonke.
Earnings appear here once payments are r.st: Meputso e hlaha mona hang ha litefo li tlalehiloe bukeng ea hau ea lichelete (litefo tsa inthaneteng le tse tšoaroang sethaleng). Chelete e bokelletsoeng ka kotloloho e kanna ea se hlahe kakaretsong ena.
Earnings appear here once payments are r.nso: Meputso e tšwelela mo ge ditefelo di šetše di ngwadilwe ka pukung ya gago ya ditšhelete (ditefelo tša inthaneteng le tšeo di swerwego ke sefala). Tšhelete yeo e kgobokeditšwego thwii e ka no se bontšhe ka palomoka ye.
Earnings appear here once payments are r.tn: Dituelo di tlhagelela fano fa dituelo di setse di kwadilwe mo bukeng ya gago ya matlole (dituelo tsa mo inthaneteng le tse di tshwerweng mo polatefomong). Madi a a kokoantsweng ka tlhamalalo a ka nna a se ka a bontshiwa mo palogotlheng eno.
Earnings appear here once payments are r.ts: Miholo yi humelela laha loko tihakelo ti rhekhodiwile eka buku ya wena ya swa timali (tihakelo ta inthanete na leti khomiweke eka pulatifomo). Mali leyi hlengeletiweke hi ku kongoma yi nga ha va yi nga kombisi eka ntsengo lowu.
Earnings appear here once payments are r.ve: Miholo i vhonala hafha musi mbadelo dzo no rekhodiwa kha bugu yaṋu ya masheleni (mbadelo dza inthanethe na dza pulatifomo). Tshelede yo kuvhanganywaho thwii i nga kha ḓi sa sumbedza kha ṱhanganyelo iyi.
Earnings appear here once payments are r.ss: Imali leholwako ivela lapha uma tinkhokhelo setibhalwe encwadzini yakho yetimali (tinkhokhelo letiku-inthanethi naletibanjwe yipulatifomu). Imali lebutfwe ngco ingahle ingabonakali kulesamba.

“—” for occupancy means no scheduled ava.af: “—” vir okupansie beteken geen geskeduleerde beskikbaarheid vir daardie ry nie, maar besprekings bestaan. Persentasies bo 100% beteken bespreekte diensminute oorskry die som van skofvensters.
“—” for occupancy means no scheduled ava.zu: “—” yokugcina indawo kusho ukuthi ayikho ukutholakala okuhleliwe kulelo qembu kodwa kukhona ukubhuka. Amaphesenti angaphezu kuka-100% asho ukuthi imizuzu yesevisi ebhukiwe idlula amafasitela eshift abalwe.
“—” for occupancy means no scheduled ava.xh: “—” yokugcinwa kwindawo kuthetha ukuba akukho ukufumaneka okucwangcisiweyo kule ngqungquthela kodwa kukho iibhukisho. Iiphesenti ngaphezu kwe-100% zithetha ukuba imizuzu yenkonzo ebhukiweyo idlula iifestile zeshift ezidibenisiweyo.
“—” for occupancy means no scheduled ava.st: “—” bakeng sa ho tšoaea sebaka ho bolela ha ho na ho fumaneha ho hlophisitsoeng mola o joalo empa ho na le dibuking. Lipesente tse ka holimo ho 100% li bolela hore metsotso ea litšebeletso tse buileng li feta lifensetere tsa shift tse kopaneng.
“—” for occupancy means no scheduled ava.nso: “—” ya go tšhupetša sebaka go ra gore ga go na go hwetšagala go beakantšwego mola wo mme go na le dibukingo. Diphesente tše ka godimo ga 100% di ra gore metsotso ya ditirelo tše di builwego di feta mafensetere a shift ao a kopantšwego.
“—” for occupancy means no scheduled ava.tn: “—” ya go tshwara sebaka go ra gore ga go na go fitlhelelwa go rulagantsweng mola oo mme go na le dibukingo. Diphesente tse di fa godimo ga 100% di ra gore metsotso ya ditirelo tse di buiweng di feta mafensetere a shift a a kopantsweng.
“—” for occupancy means no scheduled ava.ts: “—” ya ku tevhela ndhawu swi vula leswaku a ku na ku kumeka loku hleleriwaka eka layini leri kambe ku ni na swibukelo. Tiphesente leti nga hlava ka 100% ti vula leswaku timinete ta vukorhokeri leti dzi bukiweke ti tlula mafasitela ya shift lama hlengeletiwaka.
“—” for occupancy means no scheduled ava.ve: “—” ya u shumisa fhindu i vula uri a hu na u wanala lwo lugiswaho muhala wono fhedzi zwi na zwi re na mbudziso. Phesente dzi fhiraho 100% dzi vula uri miminete ya tshumelo dzo buiwaho dzi fhedza mafasitela a shift ane a kuvhanganywa.
“—” for occupancy means no scheduled ava.ss: “—” yekubamba indzawo kusho kutsi akukho kutholakala lokuhleliwe kule ngumla kodwa kukhona kubhuka. Emaphesenti angaphezu kwe-100% asho kutsi imizuzu yemsebenti lebhukiwe idlula emafasitela eshift lehlanganisiwe.

Reports go to our trust & safety queue..zu: imibiko go to our trust & ukuphepha queue. Include who you're umbikoing and what happened. Urgent danger? shayela emergency izinsizakalo first, then use Xhumana trust & ukuphepha.

Staff can work assigned services. Manage.af: personeel can work assigned dienste. Bestuurders can hulp manage besprekings and span workflows dehangende on toestemmings. Eienaar should only be used for trusted Besigheid eienaars.
Staff can work assigned services. Manage.zu: abasebenzi can work assigned izinsizakalo. Umphathis can usizo manage ukubhuka and ithimba workflows dekulindile on imvumes. Umnikazi should only be used for trusted Ibhizinisi umnikazis.
Staff can work assigned services. Manage.xh: Abasebenzi bangasebenza izinsizakalo abazinikeziwe. Abaphathi bangasiza ukuphatha ukubhukha nokugeleza komsebenzi weqembu kuye ngezimvume. Umnikazi kufanele asetshenziselwe abanikazi bamabhizinisi abathembekile kuphela.
Staff can work assigned services. Manage.st: Basebetsi ba ka sebetsa litšebeletso tse fanoeng. Batsamaisi ba ka thusa ho laola lipehelo le tšebetso ea sehlopha ho latela tumello. Mong'a lona o lokela ho sebelisoa feela bakeng sa beng ba likhoebo ba tšepahalang.
Staff can work assigned services. Manage.nso: Bašomi ba ka šoma ditirelo tše di abetšwego. Balaodi ba ka thuša go laola dipeeletšo le ditshepedišo tša mošomo tša sehlopha go ya ka ditumelelo. Mong o swanetše go šomišwa fela go beng ba dikgwebo bao ba botegago.
Staff can work assigned services. Manage.tn: Basebetsi ba ka sebetsa ditshebeletso tse abetsweng. Batsamaisi ba ka thusa go laola dipeeletso le tsamaiso ya tiro ya setlhopha go ikaegile ka gore o na le ditetlelelo. Mong o tshwanetse go dirisiwa fela go beng ba dikgwebo ba ba ikanyegang.
Staff can work assigned services. Manage.ts: Vatirhi va nga tirha vukorhokeri lebyi averiweke. Vafambisi va nga pfuneta ku lawula ku bukuta na maendlelo ya ntirho wa xipano ku ya hi mpfumelelo. N’wini u fanele ku tirhisiwa ntsena eka vini va mabindzu lava tshembekaka.
Staff can work assigned services. Manage.ve: Vhashumi vha nga shuma tshumelo dzo avhelwaho. Vhalanguli vha nga thusa u langa u buka na u shuma ha tshigwada zwi tshi bva kha thendelo. Owner i fanela u shumiswa fhedzi kha vhaṋe vha mabindu vhane vha fulufhedzea.
Staff can work assigned services. Manage.ss: Tisebenti tingasebenta tinsita letabelwe. Baphatsi bangasita kulawula kubhukha kanye nekusebenta kwelicembu kuye ngetimvume. Umnikati kufanele asetjentiswe kuphela kubanikati bebhizinisi labatsembekile.

We'll notify you once your profile is ap.af: Ons sal jou in kennis stel sodra jou profiel goedgekeur en vir klante sigbaar is. Gebruik intussen die tyd om jou profiel te voltooi – 'n sterk profiel word vinniger goedgekeur.
We'll notify you once your profile is ap.zu: Sizokwazisa uma iphrofayela yakho isigunyaziwe futhi ibonakala kumakhasimende. Okwamanje, sebenzisa isikhathi ukuze uqedele iphrofayela yakho — iphrofayela eqinile ivunyelwa ngokushesha.
We'll notify you once your profile is ap.xh: Siza kukwazisa xa iprofayile yakho yamkelwe kwaye ibonakala kubathengi. Okwangoku, sebenzisa ixesha ukugqiba iprofayile yakho - iprofayile eyomeleleyo ivunywa ngokukhawuleza.
We'll notify you once your profile is ap.st: Re tla u tsebisa hang ha boemo ba hau bo amohetsoe 'me bo bonahala ho bareki. Ho sa le joalo, sebelisa nako ho phethela boemo ba hau - boemo bo matla bo amoheloa kapele.
We'll notify you once your profile is ap.nso: Re tla go tsebiša ge profaele ya gago e dumeletšwe ebile e bonagala go bareki. Mo nakong ye, šomiša nako go phetha profaele ya gago - profaele ye maatla e amogelwa ka lebelo.
We'll notify you once your profile is ap.tn: Re tla go itsise fa porofaele ya gago e amogetswe le go bonwa ke dikhasetomara. Fa re sa ntse re letile, dirisa nako go feleletsa porofaele ya gago — porofaele e e nonofileng e amogelwa ka bonako.
We'll notify you once your profile is ap.ts: Hi ta ku tivisa loko phurofayili ya wena yi amukeriwile naswona yi vonaka eka vaxavi. Hi nkarhi wolowo, tirhisa nkarhi ku hetisa phurofayili ya wena — phurofayili yo tiya yi amukeriwa hi ku hatlisa.
We'll notify you once your profile is ap.ve: Ri do vha divhadza musi profile yavho yo no tendelwa na u vhonala kha vharengi. Nga tshifhinga tshenetsho, shumisani tshifhinga u ḓadza phrofaili yaṋu — phrofaili yo khwaṱhaho i tendelwa nga u ṱavhanya.
We'll notify you once your profile is ap.ss: Sitakwatisa uma iphrofayili yakho seyivunyiwe futsi ibonakala kumakhasimende. Kusenjalo, sebentisa sikhatsi sekucedza iphrofayli yakho — iphrofayli lecinile ivunywa ngekushesha.

Sign in with the email that received thi.af: Meld aan met die e-pos wat hierdie uitnodiging ontvang het. Gebruik die stel wagwoord-skakel van jou uitnodiging-e-pos, of meld aan met e-pos OTP – jy het nie 'n bestaande wagwoord nodig nie.
Sign in with the email that received thi.zu: Ngena ngemvume nge-imeyili ethole lesi simemo. Sebenzisa isixhumanisi sokusetha iphasiwedi esivela ku-imeyili yakho yesimemo, noma ngena ngemvume nge-imeyili OTP — awudingi iphasiwedi ekhona.
Sign in with the email that received thi.xh: Sayina nge-imeyile efumene esi simemo. Sebenzisa ikhonkco lokumisela igama lokugqitha elisuka kwi-imeyile yesimemo sakho, okanye ungene nge-imeyile ye-OTP — awufuni igama eliyimfihlo elikhoyo.
Sign in with the email that received thi.st: Kena ka lengolo-tsoibila le fumaneng memo ena. Sebelisa sehokelo sa password se tsoang ho lengolo-tsoibila la memo, kapa kena ka lengolo-tsoibila OTP — ha u hloke phasewete e teng.
Sign in with the email that received thi.nso: Saena ka imeile yeo e amogetšego taletšo ye. Diriša kgokagano ya go beakanya phasewete go tšwa go imeile ya gago ya taletšo, goba o tsene ka OTP ya imeile — ga o hloke phasewete ye e lego gona.
Sign in with the email that received thi.tn: Saenela tsena ka imeile e e amogetseng taletso eno. Dirisa kgokagano ya set-password go tswa mo imeileng ya gago ya taletso, kgotsa saenela go tsena ka OTP ya imeile — ga o tlhoke nomoro ya sephiri e e leng teng.
Sign in with the email that received thi.ts: Nghena hi email leyi amukeleke xirhambo lexi. Tirhisa xihlanganisi xa set-password ku suka eka imeyili ya wena ya xirhambo, kumbe u nghena hi email OTP — a wu lavi phaswedi leyi nga kona.
Sign in with the email that received thi.ve: Kha vha saine nga imeiḽi ye vha ṱanganedza thambo iyi. Shumisani vhuṱumani set-password u bva kha imeiḽi yaṋu ya u ramba, kana ni dzhene nga OTP ya imeiḽi — a ni ṱoḓi phasiwede ine ya vha hone.
Sign in with the email that received thi.ss: Ngena ngemvume nge-imeyili letfole lesimemo. Sebentisa sixhumanisi se-set-password kusuka ku-imeyili yakho yesimemo, noma ungene nge-imeyili OTP — awudzingi iphasiwedi lekhona.

Set how you charge customers for travell.af: Stel hoe jy klante hef vir reis na by-huis afsprake. Hou die platform verstek om onmiddellik te begin verdien — jy kan dit enige tyd vanaf Settings verfyn.
Set how you charge customers for travell.zu: Setha ukuthi uwakhokhisa kanjani amakhasimende ngokuya ngama-aphoyintimenti wasekhaya. Gcina inkundla imisiwe ukuze uqale ukuzuza ngokushesha — ungalungisa lokhu noma nini kusuka ku-Settings.
Set how you charge customers for travell.xh: Seta ukuba ubahlawulisa njani abathengi ngokuhamba ukuya kwidinga ekhaya. Gcina iqonga lihlala lihleli ukuqalisa ukufumana ngoko nangoko — ungalungisa oku nangaliphi na ixesha ukusuka Settings.
Set how you charge customers for travell.st: Beha mokhoa oa ho lefisa bareki bakeng sa maeto a ho ea lapeng. Boloka sethala se le teng ho qala ho fumana chelete hang-hang - o ka lokisa sena nako efe kapa efe ho tloha Settings.
Set how you charge customers for travell.nso: Beakanya kamoo o lefišago bareki ka gona bakeng sa go ya go dipeelano tša ka gae. Boloka sefala sa go se fetoge go thoma go hwetša mogolo ka ponyo ya leihlo — o ka lokiša se gabotse nako efe goba efe go tloga go Settings.
Set how you charge customers for travell.tn: Seta kafa o duedisang bareki ka gone fa ba tsamaya go ya kwa dipeelanong tsa kwa gae. Boloka polatefomo e le thulaganyetsoruri go simolola go bona madi ka bonako — o ka baakanya seno nako nngwe le nngwe go tswa go Settings.
Set how you charge customers for travell.ts: Seta ndlela leyi u hakelaka vaxavi ha yona eka ku ya eka ti-appointment ta le kaya. Hlayisa pulatifomo yi ri default ku sungula ku hola hi xihatla — u nga lulamisa leswi kahle nkarhi wihi na wihi ku sukela hi Settings.
Set how you charge customers for travell.ve: Setha nḓila ine na badelisa ngayo vharengi kha lwendo lwa u ya kha u ṱangana ha hayani. Kha vha vhe na pulatifomo ya mvelele u itela u thoma u hola nga u ṱavhanya — vha nga khwinisa hezwi tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe u bva kha Settings.
Set how you charge customers for travell.ss: Setha kutsi uwakhokhisa njani emakhasimende ngekuhamba kuya kuma-appointment ekhaya. Gcina iplatifomu ikhona kute ucale kuhola ngaso leso sikhatsi — ungakucolisa loku noma nini kusuka ku Settings.

Tips will be allocated to the staff memb.af: Wenke sal toegeken word aan die personeellid wat die diens verrig het. Gevorderde verdeelmetodes (gelyke verdeling, pasgemaakte poel) kan per span in die verskafferportaal opgestel word.
Tips will be allocated to the staff memb.zu: Amathiphu azonikezwa umsebenzi owenze lo msebenzi. Izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuhlukanisa (ukuhlukanisa ngokulinganayo, iphuli yangokwezifiso) zingalungiselelwa iqembu ngalinye kuphothali yabahlinzeki.
Tips will be allocated to the staff memb.xh: Iingcebiso ziya kunikwa umsebenzi owenze le nkonzo. Iindlela zokwahlula okukwinqanaba eliphezulu (ukwahlula okulinganayo, ichibi eliqhelekileyo) kunokuqwalaselwa kwiqela ngalinye kwi-portal yomnikezeli.
Tips will be allocated to the staff memb.st: Malebela a tla abeloa mosebeletsi ea entseng litšebeletso. Mekhoa e tsoetseng pele ea karohano (karohano e lekanang, letamo la tloaelo) e ka hlophisoa ka sehlopha ka seng ho portal ea mofani.
Tips will be allocated to the staff memb.nso: Dikeletšo di tla abelwa leloko la bašomi leo le dirilego tirelo. Mekgwa ya karoganyo ya maemo a godimo (go arogana ka go lekana, letamo la tlwaelo) e ka beakanywa ka sehlopha ka kgorong ya moabi.
Tips will be allocated to the staff memb.tn: Dikeletso di tla abelwa leloko la badiri le le dirileng tirelo. Mekgwa e e tsweletseng ya go kgaoganya (go kgaoganya ka go lekana, letamo le le rulagantsweng) e ka rulaganngwa ka setlhopha sengwe le sengwe mo kgorong ya moabi.
Tips will be allocated to the staff memb.ts: Switsundzuxo swi ta averiwa xirho xa vatirhi lexi endleke vukorhokeri. Maendlelo ya ku avanyisa ya xiyimo xa le henhla (ku avanyisa loku ringanaka, xidziva xa ntolovelo) ya nga lulamisiwa hi xipano eka portal ya muphakeri.
Tips will be allocated to the staff memb.ve: Tips dzi ḓo ṋewa muraḓo wa mushumi we a ita tshumelo. Nḓila dza u fhandekanya dza mvelaphanḓa (u fhandekanya ho linganaho, phuḽu yo ḓoweleaho) dzi nga dzudzanywa nga thimu kha porthaḽa ya muṋetshedzi.
Tips will be allocated to the staff memb.ss: Emacebiso atawuniketwa lilunga letisebenti lelente lenkonzo. Tindlela tekuhlukanisa letisezingeni lelisetulu (kuhlukanisa lokulinganako, lidamu lelisiko) lingalungiswa ngelicembu ngalinye ku-portal yemhlinzeki.

Ask the customer to pay using this Payst.af: Vra die kliënt om met hierdie Paystack skakel te betaal. Paystack genereer die transaksieverwysing; hierdie uitverkoping word nie as betaal aangeteken totdat jy die web-gehookte betaling toeken nie.
Ask the customer to pay using this Payst.zu: Cela ikhasimende ukuthi likhokhe lisebenzisa lesi sixhumanisi Paystack. Paystack ikhiqiza ireferensi yetransekshini; lokhu kuthengiswa akurekhodwa njengokukhokhiwe uze unikeze inkokhelo yewebhu.
Ask the customer to pay using this Payst.xh: Cela umthengi ukuba ahlawule usebenzisa le Paystack link. Paystack yenza ireferensi yentengiselwano; le ntengiso ayibhalwanga njengoko ihlawulwe de ube unikezela ngentlawulo yewebhu.
Ask the customer to pay using this Payst.st: Kopa moreki ho lefa a sebelisa Paystack sehokelo sena. Paystack e hlahisa tšupiso ea transaction; thekiso ena ha e tlalehe joalo ka ha e lefshoa ho fihlela o fana ka tefo ea webhook.
Ask the customer to pay using this Payst.nso: Kgopela moreki go lefa a šomiša kgokagano ye ya Paystack. Paystack e tšweletša tšhupetšo ya kgwebišano; thekišo ye ga e ngwalwe bjalo ka yeo e lefilwego go fihlela o aba tefo ya webhooked.
Ask the customer to pay using this Payst.tn: Kopa moreki go duela a dirisa kgokagano eno ya Paystack. Paystack e tlhagisa tshupiso ya kgwebisano; thekiso eno ga e kwalwe jaaka e e duetsweng go fitlha o aba tuelo e e gokeletsweng mo webong.
Ask the customer to pay using this Payst.ts: Kombela khasimende ku hakela hi ku tirhisa xihlanganisi lexi Paystack. Paystack ku tumbuluxa xikombo xa ntirhisano; ku xavisiwa loku a ku rhekhodiwi tanihi loku hakeriweke ku kondza u avela hakelo leyi khomiweke hi webu.
Ask the customer to pay using this Payst.ve: Humbelani murengi uri a badele a tshi shumisa vhuṱumani uhu ha Paystack. Paystack i bveledza ṱhalutshedzo ya thengiselano; thengiso iyi a i rekhodiwi sa yo badelwaho u swikela ni tshi kovhela mbadelo yo webhooked.
Ask the customer to pay using this Payst.ss: Cela likhasimende kutsi libhadale lisebentisa lesixhumanisi Paystack. Paystack ikhicita ireferensi yekutsengiselana; lokutsengisa akubhalwa njengalokukhokhelwe uze wabele inkhokhelo le-webhooked.

Full safety and parental controls — incl.af: Volle veiligheids- en ouerkontroles – insluitend beperkte modus, voersigbaarheid, boodskapperke en geblokkeerde gebruikers – is beskikbaar nadat jy 'n rekening geskep het of aangemeld het.
Full safety and parental controls — incl.zu: Ukuphepha okugcwele nezilawuli zabazali — okuhlanganisa imodi ekhawulelwe, ukubonakala kokuphakelayo, imikhawulo yemiyalezo, nabasebenzisi abavinjiwe — kuyatholakala ngemva kokudala i-akhawunti noma ukungena ngemvume.
Full safety and parental controls — incl.xh: Ukhuseleko olupheleleyo kunye nolawulo lwabazali - kubandakanywa imodi ethintelweyo, ukubonakala kwesondlo, imida yokuthumela imiyalezo, kunye nabasebenzisi abavaliweyo - ziyafumaneka emva kokuba wenze i-akhawunti okanye ungene ngemvume.
Full safety and parental controls — incl.st: Tšireletseho e felletseng le litaolo tsa batsoali - ho kenyeletsoa mokhoa o thibetsoeng, ponahalo ea phepelo, meeli ea melaetsa, le basebelisi ba thibetsoeng - lia fumaneha ka mor'a hore u thehe ak'haonte kapa u kene.
Full safety and parental controls — incl.nso: Polokego ka botlalo le taolo ya batswadi — go akaretšwa mokgwa wo o thibetšwego, go bonagala ga phepo, mellwane ya melaetša, le badiriši bao ba thibetšwego — di hwetšagala ka morago ga ge o hlotše akhaonto goba o tsene.
Full safety and parental controls — incl.tn: Ditaolo tse di feletseng tsa pabalesego le tsa botsadi — go akaretsa le mokgwa o o thibetsweng, go bonala ga phepo, ditekanyetso tsa melaetsa, le badirisi ba ba thibetsweng — di teng fa o sena go tlhama akhaonto kgotsa go saenela go tsena.
Full safety and parental controls — incl.ts: Vuhlayiseki lebyi heleleke na vulawuri bya vatswari — ku katsa na movha lowu siveleriweke, ku vonaka ka swakudya, swipimelo swa marungula, na vatirhisi lava pfaleriweke — swa kumeka endzhaku ka loko u endle akhawunti kumbe u nghena.
Full safety and parental controls — incl.ve: Tsireledzo yo fhelelaho na ndaulo ya vhabebi — hu tshi katelwa moudu wo thivhelwaho, u vhonala ha zwiḽiwa, mikano ya milaedza, na vhashumisi vho thivhelwaho — zwi a wanala nga murahu ha musi no sika akhaunthu kana no dzhena.
Full safety and parental controls — incl.ss: Kuphepha lokuphelele kanye nekulawula kwebatali — kufaka ekhatsi imodi levinjelwe, kubonakala kwekuphakela, imikhawulo yemilayeto, kanye nebasebentisi labavinjelwe — kuyatfolakala ngemuva kwekutsi wente i-akhawunti nobe ungene ngemvume.

You can use the Partner app with parenta.af: Jy kan die Partner-toepassing gebruik met ouerkontroles by verstek geaktiveer. Sommige sosiale kenmerke kan beperk word, en 'n ouer of voog kan inhoud- en veiligheidsinstellings aanpas.
You can use the Partner app with parenta.zu: Ungasebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza lukazakwethu olunezilawuli zomzali ezinikwe amandla ngokuzenzakalela. Ezinye izici zomphakathi zingase zibe nomkhawulo, futhi umzali noma umnakekeli angalungisa okuqukethwe nezilungiselelo zokuphepha.
You can use the Partner app with parenta.xh: Ungasebenzisa i-app yeqabane elinolawulo lwabazali oluvulwe ngokungagqibekanga. Ezinye iifitsha zasekuhlaleni zinokuthintelwa, kwaye umzali okanye umgcini unokulungelelanisa umxholo kunye nesetingi zokhuseleko.
You can use the Partner app with parenta.st: U ka sebelisa app ea Partner e nang le taolo ea batsoali e lumelletsoeng ka mokhoa oa kamehla. Likarolo tse ling tsa sechaba li ka thibeloa, 'me motsoali kapa mohlokomeli a ka fetola litaba le litlhophiso tsa polokeho.
You can use the Partner app with parenta.nso: O ka šomiša tirišo ya Molekane ka ditaolo tša batswadi tšeo di kgontšhitšwego ka go ikemela. Dikarolo tše dingwe tša leago di ka thibelwa, gomme motswadi goba mohlokomedi a ka beakanya diteng & dipeakanyo tša polokego.
You can use the Partner app with parenta.tn: O ka dirisa tiriswa ya Molekane e e nang le ditaolo tsa botsadi tse di kgontshitsweng ka thulaganyetsoruri. Ditiriso dingwe tsa loago di ka nna tsa thibelwa, mme motsadi kgotsa motlhokomedi a ka fetola dipeakanyo tsa diteng le tsa pabalesego.
You can use the Partner app with parenta.ts: U nga tirhisa app ya Partner na vulawuri bya vatswari lebyi pfuriweke hi ku tiyimisela. Swihlawulekisi swin’wana swa ntshamisano swi nga ha siveriwa, naswona mutswari kumbe muhlayisi a nga lulamisa swilo leswi nga endzeni & swiyimo swa vuhlayiseki.
You can use the Partner app with parenta.ve: Ni nga shumisa app ya Mufarisani i re na ndaulo ya vhabebi yo vuleaho nga nḓila yo ḓoweleaho. Zwiṅwe zwithu zwa matshilisano zwi nga kha ḓi thivhelwa, nahone mubebi kana muṱhogomeli a nga dzudzanya zwi re ngomu & zwishumiswa zwa tsireledzo.
You can use the Partner app with parenta.ss: Ungasebentisa i-app yeMlingani lenekulawula kwebatali lokuvunyelwe ngekuzenzakalela. Letinye tintfo tetenhlalakahle tingavinjelwa, futsi umtali nobe umgadzi angalungisa lokucuketfwe & tilungiselelo tekuphepha.

Pick the plan that fits today. Free acti.af: Kies die plan wat vandag pas. Gratis aktiveer onmiddellik - betaalde planne neem jou na 'n veilige kaartbetaling nadat jy ingedien het. Jy kan enige tyd vanaf instellings opgradeer of afgradeer.
Pick the plan that fits today. Free acti.zu: Khetha uhlelo olufanele namuhla. Isebenza mahhala ngokushesha - izinhlelo ezikhokhelwayo zikuyisa enkokhelweni yekhadi evikelekile ngemuva kokuhambisa. Ungathuthukisa noma wehlise noma kunini kuzilungiselelo.
Pick the plan that fits today. Free acti.xh: Khetha isicwangciso esifanelekileyo namhlanje. Isebenza simahla ngoko nangoko - izicwangciso ezihlawulweyo zikusa kwintlawulo yekhadi ekhuselekileyo emva kokuba ungenise. Ungaphucula okanye uthobe nangaliphi na ixesha kwisetingi.
Pick the plan that fits today. Free acti.st: Khetha moralo o loketseng kajeno. E sebetsa hang-hang - merero e lefuoang e u isa tefong e sireletsehileng ea karete ka mor'a hore u fane ka eona. O ka ntlafatsa kapa oa theola nako efe kapa efe ho tsoa litlhophisong.
Pick the plan that fits today. Free acti.nso: Kgetha leano leo le swanetšego lehono. Free activates hang-hang - lefile merero isa ho u sireletsehileng karete tefo ka mor'a hore u romele. O ka kaonafatša goba wa theoša nako efe goba efe go tšwa go dipeakanyo.
Pick the plan that fits today. Free acti.tn: Tlhopha leano le le tshwanelang gompieno. Free activates hang-hang — merero e lefellwang e o isa ho tefo e sireletsehileng ya karete kamora ho romela. O ka tlhabolola kgotsa wa fokotsa nako nngwe le nngwe go tswa mo diseting.
Pick the plan that fits today. Free acti.ts: Hlawula pulani leyi faneleke namuntlha. Mahala ya tirha hi ku hatlisa — tipulani leti hakeriweke ti ku yisa eka hakelo ya khadi leyi sirhelelekeke endzhaku ka loko u rhumele. U nga ndlandlamuxa kumbe ku hunguta nkarhi wihi na wihi ku suka eka swiyimiso.
Pick the plan that fits today. Free acti.ve: Khethani pulane ine ya ni fanela ṋamusi. Mahala i shuma nga u ṱavhanya — pulane dzo badelwaho dzi ni isa kha mbadelo ya garaṱa yo tsireledzeaho nga murahu ha musi no ṋetshedza. U nga khwinisa kana u fhungudza tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe u bva kha zwishumiswa.
Pick the plan that fits today. Free acti.ss: Khetsa luhlelo loluhambisana nalamuhla. Mahhala kusebenta ngaso leso sikhatsi — tinhlelo letikhokhelwako tikuyisa ekukhokheleni kwelikhadi leliphephile ngemuva kwekutsi uhambise. Ungatfutfukisa nobe wehlise noma nini kusuka kumasethingi.

You're verifying your own identity as th.af: Jy verifieer tans jou eie identiteit as die eienaar of verteenwoordiger. As jou salon 'n geregistreerde besigheid is, kan jou uitbetalingsrekening in die besigheidsnaam wees - dit word verwag.
You're verifying your own identity as th.zu: Uqinisekisa ubuwena njengomnikazi noma ummeleli. Uma isaluni yakho iyibhizinisi elibhalisiwe, i-akhawunti yakho yenkokhelo ingaba segameni lebhizinisi — lokho kulindelekile.
You're verifying your own identity as th.xh: Uqinisekisa isazisi sakho njengomnini okanye ummeli. Ukuba isaluni yakho lishishini elibhalisiweyo, iakhawunti yakho yentlawulo inokuba segameni leshishini — kulindelekile oko.
You're verifying your own identity as th.st: U ntse u netefatsa boitsebiso ba hau joalo ka mong'a kapa moemeli. Haeba salon ea hau e le khoebo e ngolisitsoeng, ak'haonte ea hau ea tefo e ka ba lebitsong la khoebo - ho lebelletsoe.
You're verifying your own identity as th.nso: O netefatša boitšhupo bja gago bjalo ka mong goba moemedi. Ge e ba salon ya gago e le kgwebo ye e ngwadišitšwego, akhaonto ya gago ya tefo e ka ba ka leina la kgwebo — seo se letetšwe.
You're verifying your own identity as th.tn: O netefatsa boitshupo jwa gago jaaka mong kgotsa moemedi. Fa salon ya gago e le kgwebo e e kwadisitsweng, akhaonto ya gago ya tuelo e ka nna mo leineng la kgwebo — seo se solofetswe.
You're verifying your own identity as th.ts: U tiyisisa vutitivisi bya wena tani hi n’wini kumbe muyimeri. Loko salon ya wena yi ri bindzu leri tsarisiweke, akhawunti ya wena yo hakela yi nga va eka vito ra bindzu — sweswo swi languteriwile.
You're verifying your own identity as th.ve: U khwaṱhisedza vhuṋe hawe sa muṋe kana muimeleli. Arali salon yaṋu i bindu ḽo ṅwaliswaho, akhaunthu yaṋu ya u badela i nga vha kha dzina ḽa bindu — zwenezwo zwo lavhelelwa.
You're verifying your own identity as th.ss: Ucinisekisa bunjalo bakho njengemnikati noma ummeleli. Uma salon yakho ibhizinisi ebhalisiwe, i-akhawunti yakho yekukhokha ingaba egameni lebhizinisi — loko kulindzelekile.

Sponsored listings are not available in.af: Geborgde lyste is nog nie in jou mark beskikbaar nie. Wanneer advertensies beskikbaar is, sal jy jou profiel 'n hupstoot kan gee en sigbaarheid, bereik, klikke en besprekings hier kan naspoor.
Sponsored listings are not available in.zu: Ukufakwa kuhlu okuxhasiwe akutholakali emakethe yakho okwamanje. Uma izikhangiso zitholakala, uzokwazi ukuthuthukisa iphrofayela yakho futhi ulandelele ukubonakala, ukufinyelela, ukuchofoza, nokubhukha lapha.
Sponsored listings are not available in.xh: Uluhlu oluxhaswayo alukafumaneki kwimarike yakho okwangoku. Xa iintengiso zikhona, uya kukwazi ukonyusa iprofayile yakho kwaye ulandelele ukubonakala, ukufikelela, ukucofa, kunye nokubhukisha apha.
Sponsored listings are not available in.st: Lethathamo le tšehelitsoeng ha le so fumanehe 'marakeng oa hau. Ha lipapatso li le teng, u tla khona ho ntlafatsa boemo ba hau le ho bona ponahalo, ho fihlella, ho tobetsa, le ho beeletsa mona.
Sponsored listings are not available in.nso: Mananeo ao a thekgwago ka tšhelete ga a hwetšagale mmarakeng wa gago ga bjale. Ge dipapatšo di hwetšagala, o tla kgona go godiša profaele ya gago le go latela go bonagala, go fihlelela, go kgotla, le go beakanya mo.
Sponsored listings are not available in.tn: Ditlhopho tse di tshegediwang ga di ise di nne teng mo mmarakeng wa gago. Fa dipapatso di le teng, o tla kgona go oketsa porofaele ya gago le go latedisa go bonala, go fitlhelelwa, go tobediwa, le dipeeletso fano.
Sponsored listings are not available in.ts: Swixavisiwa leswi seketeriweke a swi kumeki emakete wa wena ku fikela sweswi. Loko swinavetiso swi kumeka, u ta kota ku tlakusa xivumbeko xa wena na ku landzelela ku vonaka, ku fikelela, ku tikhoma, na ku bukuta laha.
Sponsored listings are not available in.ve: Zwithu zwo tikedzwaho a zwi athu wanala kha makete waṋu. Musi khungedzelo dzi hone, ni ḓo kona u engedza phrofaili yaṋu na u tevhela u vhonala, u swikelela, u puṱedza, na u buka hafha.
Sponsored listings are not available in.ss: Kubhaliswa lokuxhaswe akukatfolakali emakethe yakho okwamanje. Uma tikhangiso titfolakala, utawukhona kukhulisa iphrofayili yakho futsi ulandzelele kubonakala, kufinyelela, kuchofota, kanye nekubhukha lapha.

These come from each service's resource.af: Dit kom van elke diens se hulpbronskakels in jou katalogus. Die skedule kontroleer kapasiteit wanneer jy voortgaan; opdragte wys op die bespreking en kan geredigeer word nadat dit gestoor is.
These come from each service's resource.zu: Lokhu kuvela kuzixhumanisi zensiza yesevisi ngayinye kukhathalogi yakho. Ishejuli ihlola umthamo uma uqhubeka; izabelo zibonakala ekubhukheni futhi zingahlelwa ngemva kokulondoloza.
These come from each service's resource.xh: Ezi ziphuma kwiikhonkco zenkonzo nganye kwikhathalogu yakho. Ishedyuli ijonga umthamo xa uqhubeka; izabelo zibonisa kubhukisho kwaye zinokuhlelwa emva kokugcina.
These come from each service's resource.st: Tsena li tsoa lihokelong tsa lisebelisoa tsa litšebeletso lethathamong la hau. Lenane le hlahloba bokhoni ha o tsoela pele; likabelo li bonts'a ho booking 'me li ka hlophisoa ka mor'a ho boloka.
These come from each service's resource.nso: Tše di tšwa go dikgokagano tša methopo ya tirelo ye nngwe le ye nngwe ka gare ga lelokelelo la gago. Lenaneo le hlahloba bokgoni ge o tšwela pele; dikabelo di bontšha ka go beakanya gomme di ka rulaganywa ka morago ga go boloka.
These come from each service's resource.tn: Tseno di tswa mo dikgolaganong tsa didirisiwa tsa tirelo nngwe le nngwe mo lenaaneng la dibuka tsa gago. Thulaganyo e tlhola bokgoni fa o tswelela; dikabelo di bontshiwa mo booking mme di ka rulaganngwa morago ga go boloka.
These come from each service's resource.ts: Leswi swi huma eka swihlanganisi swa switirhisiwa swa vukorhokeri byin’wana na byin’wana eka khathalogi ya wena. Xiyimiso xi kambela vuswikoti loko u ya emahlweni; swiavelo swi kombisiwa eka ku bukuta naswona swi nga hleriwa endzhaku ko hlayisa.
These come from each service's resource.ve: Izwi zwi bva kha vhuṱumani ha zwishumiswa zwa tshumelo iṅwe na iṅwe kha khathaḽokho yaṋu. Mbekanyamushumo i ṱola vhukoni musi u tshi bvela phanḓa; mishumo i sumbedza kha u buka nahone i nga dzudzanywa nga murahu ha u vhulunga.
These come from each service's resource.ss: Leti tivela etikhonjisweni tetinsita tenkonzo ngayinye kukhathalogu yakho. Luhlelo luhlola umthamo uma uchubeka; imisebenti ikhombisa ekubhukeni futsi ingahlelwa ngemuva kwekugcina.

Existing Beautonomi customer. Their plat.af: Bestaande Beautonomi kliënt. Hul platformprofiel bly klantbestuur, maar jy kan steeds vir hulle boodskappe stuur, afsprake bespreek, produkte verkoop en verskaffernotas en -etikette bestuur.
Existing Beautonomi customer. Their plat.zu: Beautonomi ikhasimende elikhona. Iphrofayela yabo yenkundla ihlala iphethwe amakhasimende, kodwa usengabathumelela imilayezo, ubhukhe ama-aphoyintimenti, uthengise imikhiqizo, futhi ulawule amanothi abahlinzeki nomaka.
Existing Beautonomi customer. Their plat.xh: Umthengi okhoyo Beautonomi. Iprofayile yabo yeqonga ihlala ilawulwa ngabathengi, kodwa usengabathumela imiyalezo, ukubhuka ukuqeshwa, ukuthengisa iimveliso, kwaye ulawule amanqaku ababoneleli kunye neethegi.
Existing Beautonomi customer. Their plat.st: Beautonomi moreki ea teng. Boemo ba bona ba sethala bo lula bo laoloa ke bareki, empa u ntse u ka ba romella melaetsa, ho beha nako ea ho ngola, ho rekisa lihlahisoa, le ho laola lintlha le li-tag tsa mofani.
Existing Beautonomi customer. Their plat.nso: Moreki yo a lego gona Beautonomi. Profaele ya bona ya sefala e dula e laolwa ke bareki, eupša o sa dutše o ka ba romela melaetša, wa beakanya dipeeletšo, wa rekiša ditšweletšwa, le go laola dintlha tša moabi le dithegi.
Existing Beautonomi customer. Their plat.tn: Moreki yo o leng teng Beautonomi. Porofaele ya bone ya polatefomo e nna e laolwa ke khasetomara, mme o sa ntse o ka ba romelela melaetsa, wa beeletsa dipeelanonako, wa rekisa dikumo, le go laola dintlha le ditheke tsa motlamedi.
Existing Beautonomi customer. Their plat.ts: Khasimende leyi nga kona Beautonomi. Phurofayili ya vona ya pulatifomo yi tshama yi lawuriwa hi vaxavi, kambe wa ha swi kota ku va rhumela marungula, u bukuta minhlangano, u xavisa swikumiwa, na ku lawula tinotsi na tithegi ta muphakeri.
Existing Beautonomi customer. Their plat.ve: Beautonomi khasiṱama i re hone. Phurofaili yavho ya pulatifomo i dzula i tshi langiwa nga vharengi, fhedzi ni nga kha ḓi vha rumela mulaedza, u ṅwalisa zwifhinga, u rengisa zwibveledzwa, na u langa notsi dza vhaṋetshedzi na thegi.
Existing Beautonomi customer. Their plat.ss: Likhasimende lelikhona Beautonomi. Iphrofayli yabo yepulatifomu ihlala ilawulwa ngemakhasimende, kepha ungababhalela umlayeto, ubhukhe ema-aphoyintimenti, utsengise imikhicito, futsi ulawule emanothi emhlinzeki kanye nemathegi.

This will sign you out everywhere — phon.af: Dit sal jou oral afmeld - telefoon, tablet, blaaiers - en vereis dat jy weer op elke toestel aanmeld. Gebruik dit as jy vermoed dat iemand anders dalk toegang tot jou rekening gehad het.
This will sign you out everywhere — phon.zu: Lokhu kuzokukhipha yonke indawo — ifoni, ithebulethi, iziphequluli — futhi kudinga ukuthi ungene ngemvume futhi kudivayisi ngayinye. Sebenzisa lokhu uma usola ukuthi omunye umuntu kungenzeka ukuthi ufinyelele i-akhawunti yakho.
This will sign you out everywhere — phon.xh: Oku kuya kukukhupha kuyo yonke indawo - ifowuni, ithebhulethi, iibhrawuza - kwaye ifuna ukuba ungene kwakhona kwisixhobo ngasinye. Sebenzisa oku ukuba ukrokrela ukuba kukho umntu ongene kwiakhawunti yakho.
This will sign you out everywhere — phon.st: Sena se tla u ntša hohle - mohala, tablet, porausara - 'me se hloka hore u kene hape sesebelisoa ka seng. Sebelisa sena haeba u belaela hore e ka 'na eaba ho na le motho ea kileng a kena akhaonteng ea hau.
This will sign you out everywhere — phon.nso: Se se tla go saena gohle — mogala, letlapa, diphensele — gomme sa nyaka gore o tsene gape go sedirišwa se sengwe le se sengwe. Diriša se ge o belaela gore motho yo mongwe a ka ba a tsene akhaontong ya gago.
This will sign you out everywhere — phon.tn: Seno se tla go ntsha gongwe le gongwe — mo founong, mo theboleteng, mo dibatling — mme se tla go tlhoka gore o tsene gape mo sedirisweng sengwe le sengwe. Dirisa seno fa o belaela gore mongwe o sele a ka tswa a tsene mo akhaontong ya gago.
This will sign you out everywhere — phon.ts: Leswi swi ta ku sayina hinkwako — riqingho, thebulete, swihlamusela-marito — naswona swi ta lava leswaku u nghena nakambe eka xitirhisiwa xin’wana na xin’wana. Tirhisa leswi loko u ehleketa leswaku munhu un’wana a nga ha va a nghene eka akhawunti ya wena.
This will sign you out everywhere — phon.ve: Hezwi zwi ḓo ita uri ni bve fhethu hoṱhe — kha founu, kha thebulethe, kha dzi- browser — nahone zwi ḓo ṱoḓa uri ni dovhe ni dzhene kha tshishumiswa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe. Shumisani hezwi arali ni tshi humbulela uri muṅwe muthu a nga vha o dzhena kha akhaunthu yaṋu.
This will sign you out everywhere — phon.ss: Loku kutakukhipha yonkhe indzawo — lucingo, ithebulethi, tiphequluli — futsi kutawudzinga kutsi uphindze ungene kudivayisi ngayinye. Sebentisa loku nangabe usola kutsi kungenteka kutsi lomunye umuntfu ufinyelele ku-akhawunti yakho.

Repeating schedules create visits automa.af: Herhaalde skedules skep besoeke outomaties wanneer dit betaalbaar is (daaglikse taak). Stel hulle op vanaf die kalender of hierdie skerm. Betaling is steeds per bespreking tensy die kliënt apart betaal.
Repeating schedules create visits automa.zu: Amashejuli aphindayo adala ukuvakasha ngokuzenzakalelayo uma kufanele (umsebenzi wansuku zonke). Zisethe kusukela kukhalenda noma kulesi sikrini. Inkokhelo isengokubhukha ngakunye ngaphandle uma iklayenti likhokha ngokuhlukana.
Repeating schedules create visits automa.xh: Ukuphindaphinda iishedyuli kudala utyelelo ngokuzenzekelayo xa kufanelekile (umsebenzi wemihla ngemihla). Zisete kwikhalenda okanye kwesi sikrini. Intlawulo isekho ngokubhukisha ngaphandle kokuba umxhasi uhlawula ngokwahlukeneyo.
Repeating schedules create visits automa.st: Mananeo a pheta-phetoang a etsa maeto ka bohona ha ho hlokahala (mosebetsi oa letsatsi le letsatsi). Li hlophise ho tsoa almanakeng kapa skrineng sena. Tefo e ntse e le teng ho latela kopo ntle le haeba moreki a lefa ka thoko.
Repeating schedules create visits automa.nso: Dipeelano tše di boeletšago di hlola diketelo ka go itiragalela ge nako e fihla (mošomo wa letšatši le letšatši). Di beakanya go tšwa go almanaka goba skrine se. Tefo e sa le ka go beakanya ntle le ge moreki a lefa ka thoko.
Repeating schedules create visits automa.tn: Dithulaganyo tse di boaboelediwang di tlhama diketelo ka go itirisa fa di tshwanetse (tiro ya letsatsi le letsatsi). Di sete go tswa mo khalentareng kgotsa mo sekirining seno. Tuelo e santse e le ka peeletso ntle le fa moreki a duela ka thoko.
Repeating schedules create visits automa.ts: Ku phindha-phindha swiyimiso swi tumbuluxa maendzo hi ku tisungulela loko ku fika nkarhi (ntirho wa siku na siku). Ti veke ku suka eka khalendara kumbe eka xikirini lexi. Ku hakela ka ha ri hi ku bukuta handle ka loko muxavi a hakela hi ku hambana.
Repeating schedules create visits automa.ve: U dovholola mbekanyamushumo zwi sika madalo nga vhuḓiitisi musi tshifhinga tsho swika (mushumo wa ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe). Dzi sethe u bva kha khalenda kana kha tshikirini itshi. Mbadelo i kha ḓi vha nga booking nga nnḓa ha musi client i tshi badela nga yoṱhe.
Repeating schedules create visits automa.ss: Kuphindzaphindza emashejuli kudala kuvakasha ngekuzenzakalela uma kufanele (umsebenti wansuku zonke). Tisethe kusuka ekhalendeni nobe kulesikrini. Inkhokhelo isakhona ngekubhukha ngaphandle nangabe iklayenti ikhokha ngekwehlukana.

This will end every active session acros.af: Dit sal elke aktiewe sessie oor al jou fone, tablette en blaaiers beëindig. Jy sal oral weer moet aanmeld. Gebruik dit as jy vermoed dat iemand anders toegang tot jou rekening gekry het.
This will end every active session acros.zu: Lokhu kuzoqeda yonke isikhathi esisebenzayo kuwo wonke amafoni akho, amaphilisi neziphequluli. Uzodinga ukungena ngemvume futhi yonke indawo. Sebenzisa lokhu uma usola ukuthi kukhona ofinyelele i-akhawunti yakho.
This will end every active session acros.xh: Oku kuya kuphelisa yonke iseshoni esebenzayo kuzo zonke iifowuni zakho, iitafile kunye nezikhangeli. Kuya kufuneka ungene kwakhona kuyo yonke indawo. Sebenzisa oku ukuba ukrokrela ukuba kukho umntu ongene kwiakhawunti yakho.
This will end every active session acros.st: Sena se tla felisa karolo e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e sebetsang ho mehala eohle ea hau, matlapa le libatli. U tla hloka ho kena hape hohle. Sebelisa sena haeba u belaela hore ho na le motho ea kileng a kena akhaonteng ea hau.
This will end every active session acros.nso: Se se tla fediša sešene ye nngwe le ye nngwe ye e šomago go ralala le megala ya gago ka moka, dithebolete le diphensele. O tla swanelwa ke go tsena gape gohle. Diriša se ge o belaela gore motho yo mongwe o tsene akhaontong ya gago.
This will end every active session acros.tn: Seno se tla fedisa thulaganyo nngwe le nngwe e e dirang mo difounong tsotlhe tsa gago, dithebolete le dibatli. O tla tlhoka go tsena gape gongwe le gongwe. Dirisa seno fa o belaela gore mongwe o sele o tsene mo akhaontong ya gago.
This will end every active session acros.ts: Leswi swi ta herisa xiyenge xin’wana na xin’wana lexi tirhaka eka tifoyini ta wena hinkwato, tithebulete na swihlamusela-marito. U ta fanela ku nghena nakambe hinkwako-nkwako. Tirhisa leswi loko u ehleketa leswaku munhu un’wana u nghene eka akhawunti ya wena.
This will end every active session acros.ve: Izwi zwi ḓo fhelisa sesheni iṅwe na iṅwe i shumaho kha founu dzaṋu dzoṱhe, thebulethe na dzibrowser. U do tea u dzhena hafhu fhethu hothe. Shumisani hezwi arali ni tshi humbulela uri muṅwe muthu o dzhena kha akhaunthu yaṋu.
This will end every active session acros.ss: Loku kutawucedza yonkhe iseshini lesebentako kuwo onkhe emafoni akho, emathebulethi kanye netiphequluli. Kutawudzingeka kutsi ungene futsi yonkhe indzawo. Sebentisa loku uma usola kutsi lomunye umuntfu ufinyelele ku-akhawunti yakho.

I understand and accept the cancellation.af: Ek verstaan ​​en aanvaar die kansellasiebeleid en enige fooie hierbo getoon. Ek erken dat kwalifiserende terugbetalings teen my Beautonomi-beursie gekrediteer word, nie die oorspronklike betaalmetode nie.
I understand and accept the cancellation.zu: Ngiyayiqonda futhi ngiyayamukela inqubomgomo yokukhansela kanye nanoma yiziphi izinkokhelo eziboniswe ngenhla. Ngiyavuma ukuthi ukubuyiselwa kwemali okufanelekile kufakwa esikhwameni sami Beautonomi, hhayi indlela yokukhokha yasekuqaleni.
I understand and accept the cancellation.xh: Ndiyawuqonda kwaye ndiyawamkela umgaqo-nkqubo wokurhoxisa kunye nazo naziphi na iintlawulo eziboniswe ngasentla. Ndiyavuma ukuba iimbuyiselo ezifanelekileyo zifakwa kwi-wallet yam Beautonomi, hayi indlela yokuhlawula yokuqala.
I understand and accept the cancellation.st: Ke utloisisa le ho amohela pholisi ea ho hlakoloa le litefiso tse bontšitsoeng ka holimo. Ke lumela hore litefello tse loketseng li kentsoe sepacheng sa ka sa Beautonomi, eseng mokhoa oa pele oa ho lefa.
I understand and accept the cancellation.nso: Ke kwešiša ebile ke amogela pholisi ya go phumola le ditefelo dife goba dife tšeo di bontšhitšwego ka mo godimo. Ke amogela gore dipušetšo tše di nago le maswanedi di tsenywa sepache sa ka sa Beautonomi, e sego mokgwa wa mathomo wa tefelo.
I understand and accept the cancellation.tn: Ke tlhaloganya le go amogela pholisi ya go khansela le dituediso dipe tse di bontshitsweng fa godimo. Ke dumela gore dipusetso tse di tshwanelegang di tsenngwa mo sepatšheng sa me sa Beautonomi, e seng mo mokgweng wa tuelo wa ntlhantlha.
I understand and accept the cancellation.ts: Ndzi twisisa no amukela pholisi yo khansela na tihakelo tihi na tihi leti kombisiweke laha henhla. Ndza pfumela leswaku ku tlheriseriwa mali loku faneleke ku nghenisiwa eka xipachi xa mina xa Beautonomi, ku nga ri ndlela yo hakela yo sungula.
I understand and accept the cancellation.ve: Ndi a pfesesa na u ṱanganedza mbekanyamaitele ya u khansela na mbadelo dziṅwe na dziṅwe dzo sumbedzwaho afho nṱha. Ndi a tenda uri mbuelo dzo teaho dzi dzheniswa kha tshipatshi tshanga tsha Beautonomi, hu si nḓila ya mbadelo ya u thoma.
I understand and accept the cancellation.ss: Ngiyayivisisa futsi ngiyayemukela umtsetfomgomo wekukhansela kanye nanobe ngutiphi timali letikhonjiswe ngenhla. Ngiyavuma kutsi kubuyiselwa kwemali lokufanele kubhadalwa esikhwameni sami sesikhwama semali se-Beautonomi, hhayi indlela yekukhokha yekucala.

Sign in with the email that received thi.af: Meld aan met die e-pos wat hierdie uitnodiging ontvang het ({{email}}). Gebruik die stel wagwoord-skakel van jou uitnodiging-e-pos, of meld aan met e-pos OTP – jy het nie 'n bestaande wagwoord nodig nie.
Sign in with the email that received thi.zu: Ngena ngemvume nge-imeyili ethole lesi simemo ({{email}}). Sebenzisa isixhumanisi sokusetha iphasiwedi esivela ku-imeyili yakho yesimemo, noma ngena ngemvume nge-imeyili OTP — awudingi iphasiwedi ekhona.
Sign in with the email that received thi.xh: Sayina nge-imeyile efumene esi simemo ({{email}}). Sebenzisa ikhonkco lokumisela igama lokugqitha elisuka kwi-imeyile yesimemo sakho, okanye ungene nge-imeyile ye-OTP — awufuni igama eliyimfihlo elikhoyo.
Sign in with the email that received thi.st: Kena ka lengolo-tsoibila le amohetseng memo ena ({{email}}). Sebelisa sehokelo sa password se tsoang ho lengolo-tsoibila la memo, kapa kena ka lengolo-tsoibila OTP — ha u hloke phasewete e teng.
Sign in with the email that received thi.nso: Saena ka imeile yeo e amogetšego taletšo ye ({{email}}). Diriša kgokagano ya go beakanya phasewete go tšwa go imeile ya gago ya taletšo, goba o tsene ka OTP ya imeile — ga o hloke phasewete ye e lego gona.
Sign in with the email that received thi.tn: Saenela tsena ka imeile e e amogetseng taletso eno ({{email}}). Dirisa kgokagano ya set-password go tswa mo imeileng ya gago ya taletso, kgotsa saenela go tsena ka OTP ya imeile — ga o tlhoke nomoro ya sephiri e e leng teng.
Sign in with the email that received thi.ts: Nghena hi email leyi amukeleke xirhambo lexi ({{email}}). Tirhisa xihlanganisi xa set-password ku suka eka imeyili ya wena ya xirhambo, kumbe u nghena hi email OTP — a wu lavi phaswedi leyi nga kona.
Sign in with the email that received thi.ve: Dzhenani nga imeiḽi ye ya ṱanganedza tshimemo itshi ({{email}}). Shumisani vhuṱumani set-password u bva kha imeiḽi yaṋu ya u ramba, kana ni dzhene nga OTP ya imeiḽi — a ni ṱoḓi phasiwede ine ya vha hone.
Sign in with the email that received thi.ss: Ngena ngemvume nge-imeyili letfole lesimemo ({{email}}). Sebentisa sixhumanisi se-set-password kusuka ku-imeyili yakho yesimemo, noma ungene nge-imeyili OTP — awudzingi iphasiwedi lekhona.

Yearly summaries appear here. Until a fi.af: Jaarlikse opsommings verskyn hier. Totdat 'n lêer gegenereer word, bly die ry onbeskikbaar; wanneer die API 'n URL verskaf, maak Aflaai dit oop (getekende URL's en relatiewe API-paaie word ondersteun).
Yearly summaries appear here. Until a fi.zu: Izifinyezo zonyaka zivela lapha. Kuze kube yilapho kukhiqizwa ifayela, umugqa uhlala ungatholakali; lapho i-API inikeza i-URL, Ukulanda kuyayivula (ama-URL asayiniwe kanye nezindlela ze-API ezihlobene ziyasekelwa).
Yearly summaries appear here. Until a fi.xh: Ushwankathelo lonyaka luvela apha. Ide ibe yenziwe ifayile, umqolo uhlala ungafumaneki; xa i-API ibonelela nge-URL, Ukukhuphela kuyivula (ii-URL ezisayiniweyo kunye neendlela ze-API ezihambelanayo zixhaswa).
Yearly summaries appear here. Until a fi.st: Kakaretso ea selemo e hlaha mona. Ho fihlela faele e hlahisoa, mola o lula o sa fumanehe; ha API e fana ka URL, Download e bula (li-URL tse saenneng le litsela tse amanang le API li tšehetsoa).
Yearly summaries appear here. Until a fi.nso: Dikakaretšo tša ngwaga le ngwaga di tšwelela mo. Go fihlela ge faele e tšweletšwa, mothalo o dula o sa hwetšagale; ge API e fana ka URL, Download e a e bula (di-URL tše di saennwego le ditsela tša API tša go lekana di a thekgwa).
Yearly summaries appear here. Until a fi.tn: Ditshobokanyo tsa ngwaga le ngwaga di tlhagelela fano. Go fitlha faele e tlhagisiwa, mola o nna o sa bonwe; fa API e naya URL, Laisolola e a e bula (di-URL tse di saenilweng le ditsela tsa API tse di amanang di a tshegediwa).
Yearly summaries appear here. Until a fi.ts: Switlhokovetselo swa lembe na lembe swi humelela laha. Ku kondza ku endliwa fayili, layini yi tshama yi nga kumeki; loko API yi nyika URL, Download yi yi pfula (ti-URL leti sayiniweke na tindlela ta API leti yelanaka swa seketeriwa).
Yearly summaries appear here. Until a fi.ve: Miṱoḓisiso ya ṅwaha i bvelela hafha. U swikela faela i tshi bveledzwa, row i dzula i siho; musi API i tshi ṋetshedza URL, Download i a i vula (URL dzo sainwaho na nḓila dza API dzi re na vhushaka dzi a tikedzwa).
Yearly summaries appear here. Until a fi.ss: Tifinyeto temnyaka tivela lapha. Kuze kube ngulapho kukhicitwa ifayela, umugca uhlala ungatfolakali; uma i-API iniketa i-URL, Layisha iyayivula (ema-URL lasayiniwe kanye netindlela te-API letihlobene tiyasekelwa).

We'll email the code straight to {{recip.af: Ons sal die kode direk na {{recipient}} e-pos na betaling, met eenvoudige stappe om dit te gebruik. As hulle reeds 'n Beautonomi rekening het, verskyn dit ook outomaties in hul beursie.
We'll email the code straight to {{recip.zu: Sizothumela ikhodi nge-imeyili ngokuqondile kokuthi {{recipient}} ngemva kokukhokha, nezinyathelo ezilula zokuyisebenzisa. Uma sebevele benayo i-akhawunti Beautonomi, iphinda ivele esikhwameni sabo ngokuzenzakalela.
We'll email the code straight to {{recip.xh: Siza kuyithumela nge-imeyile ikhowudi ngqo ku {{recipient}} emva kwentlawulo, kunye namanyathelo alula wokuyikhulula. Ukuba sele benayo i-akhawunti Beautonomi, ikwavela nakwi-wallet yabo ngokuzenzekelayo.
We'll email the code straight to {{recip.st: Re tla romella khoutu ka kotloloho ho {{recipient}} kamora ho lefa, ka mehato e bonolo ea ho e lopolla. Haeba ba se ba ntse ba e-na le Beautonomi akhaonto, e boetse e hlaha ka sepacheng sa bona ka bo eona.
We'll email the code straight to {{recip.nso: Re tla romela khoutu ka imeile thwii go {{recipient}} ka morago ga tefo, ka magato a bonolo a go e lopolla. Ge ba šetše ba na le akhaonto ya Beautonomi, le yona e tšwelela ka sekhwameng sa bona ka go itiragalela.
We'll email the code straight to {{recip.tn: Re tla romela khoutu ka imeile ka tlhamalalo kwa go {{recipient}} morago ga tuelo, ka dikgato tse di bonolo tsa go e dirisa. Fa ba setse ba na le akhaonto ya Beautonomi, le yone e tlhagelela mo sepatšheng sa bone ka go itirisa.
We'll email the code straight to {{recip.ts: Hi ta rhumela khodi hi email hi ku kongoma eka {{recipient}} endzhaku ko hakela, hi magoza yo olova yo yi kutsula. Loko se va ri na Beautonomi akhawunti, na yona yi humelela eka xipachi xa vona hi ku tisungulela.
We'll email the code straight to {{recip.ve: Ri ḓo rumela khoudu nga imeiḽi thwii kha {{recipient}} nga murahu ha mbadelo, na maga o leluwaho a u i rengulula. Arali vha na akhaunthu ya Beautonomi, i dovha ya bvelela kha tshipatshi tshavho nga vhuḓiitisi.
We'll email the code straight to {{recip.ss: Sitawutfumela ikhodi nge-imeyili ngco ku {{recipient}} ngemuva kwekukhokha, ngetinyatselo letilula tekuyisebentisa. Uma vele bane-akhawunti Beautonomi, iphindze ivele esikhwameni sabo semali ngekuzenzakalela.

Request permanent deletion of your accou.af: Versoek permanente verwydering van jou rekening. Wanneer die grasietydperk geaktiveer is, word uitvee vir 30 dae geskeduleer – jou rekening is gesluit en jy kan kanselleer via die e-posskakel of ondersteuning.
Request permanent deletion of your accou.zu: Cela ukususwa unomphela kwe-akhawunti yakho. Uma isikhathi somusa sinikwe amandla, ukususwa kuhlelelwe izinsuku ezingu-30 — i-akhawunti yakho ikhiyiwe futhi ungakhansela ngesixhumanisi se-imeyili noma ngokusekela.
Request permanent deletion of your accou.xh: Cela ukucinywa ngokusisigxina kweakhawunti yakho. Xa ixesha loxolelo livuliwe, ucimo lucwangciselwe iintsuku ezingama-30 — iakhawunti yakho itshixiwe kwaye unokurhoxisa ngekhonkco le-imeyile okanye inkxaso.
Request permanent deletion of your accou.st: Kopa hore ak'haonte ea hau e hlakoloe ruri. Ha nako ea mohau e lumelletsoe, ho hlakoloa ho reriloe matsatsi a 30 - ak'haonte ea hau e notletsoe 'me u ka hlakola ka sehokelo sa lengolo-tsoibila kapa tšehetso.
Request permanent deletion of your accou.nso: Kgopela go phumolwa ga akhaonto ya gago sa ruri. Ge nako ya mogau e kgontšhitšwe, go phumolwa go rulagantšwe matšatši a 30 — akhaonto ya gago e notletšwe gomme o ka phumola ka kgokagano ya imeile goba thekgo.
Request permanent deletion of your accou.tn: Kopa gore akhaonto ya gago e phimolwe ruri. Fa paka ya tshegofatso e kgontshitswe, go phimola go rulaganyeditswe malatsi a le 30 — akhaonto ya gago e notletswe mme o ka khansela ka kgokagano ya imeile kgotsa tshegetso.
Request permanent deletion of your accou.ts: Kombela ku susiwa ka akhawunti ya wena hi laha ku nga heriki. Loko nkarhi wa tintswalo wu tirhisiwile, ku susiwa ku hleriwile masiku ya 30 — akhawunti ya wena yi lotleriwile naswona u nga khansela hi ku tirhisa xihlanganisi xa imeyili kumbe nseketelo.
Request permanent deletion of your accou.ve: Humbelani u phumulwa ha akhaunthu yaṋu lwa tshoṱhe. Musi tshifhinga tsha pfarelo tsho vulea, u phumula zwo dzudzanywa lwa maḓuvha a 30 — akhaunthu yaṋu yo khiiwa nahone ni nga khansela nga kha vhuṱumani ha imeiḽi kana thikhedzo.
Request permanent deletion of your accou.ss: Cela kutsi i-akhawunti yakho isuswe unomphela. Uma sikhatsi semusa sinikwe emandla, kucishwa kuhlelelwe emalanga lange-30 — i-akhawunti yakho ikhiyiwe futsi ungakhansela ngesixhumanisi se-imeyili noma kusekelwa.

Browse the Learning Centre for guides an.af: Blaai deur die Learning Centre vir gidse en algemene antwoorde. Vir rekening- of besprekingspesifieke hulp, maak 'n kaartjie oop met jou besonderhede en skermkiekies waar moontlik. Volg antwoorde in My kaartjies.
Browse the Learning Centre for guides an.zu: Phequlula Learning Centre ukuthola imihlahlandlela nezimpendulo ezijwayelekile. Ngosizo olukhethekile lwe-akhawunti noma lokubhuka, vula ithikithi elinemininingwane yakho nezithombe-skrini lapho kunokwenzeka khona. Landelela izimpendulo kokuthi Amathikithi Ami.
Browse the Learning Centre for guides an.xh: Jonga i Learning Centre ukufumana izikhokelo kunye neempendulo eziqhelekileyo. Ngeakhawunti okanye uncedo olukhethekileyo lokubhukisha, vula itikiti elineenkcukacha zakho kunye nemifanekiso-skrini apho kunokwenzeka. Khangela iimpendulo kumatikiti am.
Browse the Learning Centre for guides an.st: Batla Learning Centre ho fumana litataiso le likarabo tse tloaelehileng. Bakeng sa thuso e khethehileng ea ak'haonte kapa ea ho boloka, bula tekete e nang le lintlha tsa hau le linepe tsa hau moo ho khonehang. Latela likarabo ho litekete tsa ka.
Browse the Learning Centre for guides an.nso: Lekola Learning Centre bakeng sa dihlahli le dikarabo tše di tlwaelegilego. Bakeng sa thušo ye e itšego ya akhaonto goba ya go beakanya, bula thekethe yeo e nago le dintlha tša gago le diswantšho tša skrine moo go kgonegago. Track dikarabo ka Dithekethe tša Ka.
Browse the Learning Centre for guides an.tn: Batla mo Learning Centre go bona dikaelo le dikarabo tse di tlwaelegileng. Go bona thuso e e rileng ya akhaonto kgotsa ya go buka, bula thekete e e nang le dintlha tsa gago le dinepe tsa sekerini fa go kgonega. Latedisa dikarabo mo ditekete tsa Me.
Browse the Learning Centre for guides an.ts: Languta Learning Centre ku kuma swiletelo na tinhlamulo leti tolovelekeke. Ku kuma mpfuneto lowu kongomeke eka akhawunti kumbe ku bukuta, pfula thikithi leri nga na vuxokoxoko bya wena na swifaniso swa xikirini laha swi kotekaka. Track tinhlamulo eka Mathikithi ya Mina.
Browse the Learning Centre for guides an.ve: Kha vha sedze Learning Centre u itela vhulivhisi na phindulo dzo ḓoweleaho. U itela thuso ya akhaunthu kana ya u buka, vulani thikhithi i re na zwidodombedzwa zwaṋu na zwifanyiso zwa tshikirini hune zwa konadzea. Track phindulo kha thikhithi dzanga.
Browse the Learning Centre for guides an.ss: Dlulisa emehlo ku Learning Centre kute utfole ticondziso netimphendvulo letivamile. Kute utfole lusito lwe-akhawunti nobe lwekubhuka, vula lithikithi lelinemininingwane yakho kanye netitfombe tesikrini lapho kungenteka khona. Landzela timphendvulo ku Emathikithi Ami.

Bookings and online product orders use t.af: Besprekings en aanlyn produkbestellings gebruik die finansiële grootboek wanneer dit deur die platform vereffen word. Inloop-kleinhandelbestellings verskyn volgens betaaldatum selfs sonder grootboekrye. Verouderde POS-rye wys bruto as netto.
Bookings and online product orders use t.zu: Ukubhuka nama-oda wemikhiqizo eku-inthanethi kusebenzisa incwadi yezimali lapho kuxazululwe yinkundla. Ama-oda okuthengisa avela ngedethi ekhokhelwe ngisho nangaphandle kwemigqa yeleja. Imigqa ye-POS yefa ibonisa isamba njengenetha.
Bookings and online product orders use t.xh: Ukubhukisha kunye neeodolo zeemveliso ezikwi-Intanethi zisebenzisa incwadi yezemali xa zilungiswe liqonga. Iiodolo ze-Walk-in retails zivela ngomhla ohlawulelweyo nokuba zingekho iirowu zeleja. Imiqolo ye-POS yelifa ibonisa i-gross as net.
Bookings and online product orders use t.st: Lipehelo le li-odara tsa lihlahisoa tsa inthaneteng li sebelisa bukana ea lichelete ha e rarolloa ke sethala. Liodara tsa Walk-in retails li hlaha ka letsatsi le lefshoang ntle le mela ea ledja. Mela ea lefa la POS e bonts'a chelete e felletseng.
Bookings and online product orders use t.nso: Dipeeletšo le ditaelo tša ditšweletšwa tša inthaneteng di šomiša ledger ya ditšhelete ge e rarollwa ke sefala. Ditaelo tša mabenkele tša go sepela ka maoto di tšwelela ka letšatšikgwedi leo le lefilwego le ge e se na mela ya ledger. Lefa POS mela bontša palo yohle e le net.
Bookings and online product orders use t.tn: Dipeeletso le ditaelo tsa dihlahiswa tsa inthanete di sebedisa buka ya ditjhelete ha di lefellwa ke sethala. Diotara tsa thekiso tse di tsenang di tlhagelela ka letlha le le duetsweng le fa go sena mela ya buka ya madi. Mela ya POS ya bogologolo e bontsha palogotlhe jaaka nete.
Bookings and online product orders use t.ts: Ku bukuta na tioda ta swikumiwa swa inthanete swi tirhisa buku ya timali loko swi hakeriwa hi pulatifomo. Tioda ta vuxavisi leti nghenaka hi milenge ti humelela hi siku leri hakeriweke hambi ku ri handle ka tilayini ta ledger. Tilayini ta POS ta ndzhaka ti kombisa gross tani hi net.
Bookings and online product orders use t.ve: U buka na u oda zwibveledzwa kha inthanethe zwi shumisa bugu ya masheleni musi zwo dzudzanywa nga pulatifomo. Oda dza u rengisa dzi bvelela nga ḓuvha ḽo badelwaho naho hu si na miduba ya bugu khulwane. Row dza POS dza kale dzi sumbedza gross sa net.
Bookings and online product orders use t.ss: Kubhukha kanye nema-oda emkhicito ku-inthanethi kusebentisa incwadzi yetimali uma kuhlaliswa yipulatifomu. Ema-oda ekutsengisa lahambako avela ngelusuku lolukhokhelwe ngisho noma kute imigca ye-ledger. Imigca ye-POS yelifa ikhombisa i-gross njenge-net.

Before you sign in or create an account,.af: Voordat jy aanmeld of 'n rekening skep, hersien en aanvaar ons EULA. Dit dek gemeenskapstandaarde, verslagdoening, blokkering, ouerkontroles en ons verbintenis om binne 24 uur op te tree op verslae.
Before you sign in or create an account,.zu: Ngaphambi kokuthi ungene ngemvume noma udale i-akhawunti, buyekeza futhi wamukele i-EULA yethu. Ihlanganisa izindinganiso zomphakathi, ukubika, ukuvimbela, izilawuli zabazali, nokuzibophezela kwethu ukuthatha isinyathelo ngemibiko phakathi namahora angu-24.
Before you sign in or create an account,.xh: Phambi kokuba ungene okanye wenze i-akhawunti, jonga kwaye wamkele i-EULA yethu. Ibandakanya imigangatho yoluntu, ukunika ingxelo, ukuthintela, ulawulo lwabazali, kunye nokuzinikela kwethu ekwenzeni ingxelo kwiiyure ezingama-24.
Before you sign in or create an account,.st: Pele o kena kapa o theha ak'haonte, hlahloba le ho amohela EULA ea rona. E akaretsa maemo a sechaba, ho tlaleha, thibelo, taolo ea batsoali, le boitlamo ba rona ba ho sebetsa litlalehong nakong ea lihora tse 24.
Before you sign in or create an account,.nso: Pele o tsena goba o hlama akhaonto, hlahloba le go amogela EULA ya rena. E akaretša maemo a setšhaba, go bega, go thibela, taolo ya batswadi, le boikgafo bja rena bja go gata mogato ka dipego mo diiri tše 24.
Before you sign in or create an account,.tn: Pele ga o saenela kgotsa o tlhama akhaonto, sekaseka le go amogela EULA ya rona. E akaretsa maemo a baagi, go bega, go thibela, ditaolo tsa botsadi, le boineelo jwa rona jwa go tsaya kgato ka dipegelo mo diureng di le 24.
Before you sign in or create an account,.ts: Loko u nga si nghena kumbe ku endla akhawunti, kambisisa no amukela EULA ya hina. Yi katsa swiyimo swa vaaki, ku vika, ku sivela, vulawuri bya vatswari, na ku tinyiketela ka hina ku teka goza eka swiviko ku nga si hela tiawara ta 24.
Before you sign in or create an account,.ve: Musi ni sa athu dzhena kana u sika akhaunthu, ṱolisisani na u ṱanganedza EULA yashu. I katela zwilinganyo zwa tshitshavha, u vhiga, u thivhela, ndaulo ya vhabebi, na u ḓikumedzela hashu u dzhia vhukando kha mivhigo hu sa athu fhela awara dza 24.
Before you sign in or create an account,.ss: Ngaphambi kwekutsi ungene ngemvume nobe wente i-akhawunti, buketa futsi wemukele i-EULA yetfu. Ifaka ekhatsi emazinga emmango, kubika, kuvimba, kulawula kwebatali, kanye nekutinikela kwetfu kutsi sitsatse sinyatselo ngemibiko kungakapheli emahora lange-24.

When real PDFs or files exist in storage.af: Wanneer regte PDF's of lêers in berging bestaan, moet die API download_url (absolute URL of 'n pad soos /api/…) en/of document_url terugstuur — die Aflaai-knoppie aktiveer outomaties vir daardie ry.
When real PDFs or files exist in storage.zu: Uma ama-0 angempela noma amafayela ekhona endaweni yokubeka, i-API kufanele ibuyise download_url (i-URL ephelele noma indlela efana ne-/api/…) kanye/noma i-document_url — inkinobho yokudawuniloda yenza ngokuzenzakalelayo kulowo mugqa.
When real PDFs or files exist in storage.xh: Xa ii-real 0s okanye iifayile zikhona kwindawo yokugcina, i-API kufuneka ibuyisele i-download_url (i-URL epheleleyo okanye indlela efana ne-/api/…) kunye/okanye i-document_url — iqhosha lokukhuphela livumela ngokuzenzekelayo loo mqolo.
When real PDFs or files exist in storage.st: Ha li-file kapa lifaele tsa 'nete li le teng polokelong, API e lokela ho khutlisa download_url (URL e felletseng kapa tsela e kang /api/…) le/kapa document_url - konopo ea Khoasolla e tla khona ho tsamaisa mola oo ka bo eona.
When real PDFs or files exist in storage.nso: Ge di PDF tša nnete goba difaele di le gona ka polokelong, API e swanetše go bušetša download_url (URL ye e feletšego goba tsela ya go swana le /api/...) le/goba document_url — konope ya Download e kgontšha ka go itiragalela bakeng sa mothalo woo.
When real PDFs or files exist in storage.tn: Fa di-PDF tsa mmatota kgotsa difaele di le teng mo polokelong, API e tshwanetse go busetsa download_url (URL e e feletseng kgotsa tsela e e tshwanang le /api/...) le/kgotsa document_url — konopo ya Laisolola e kgontsha ka go itirisa mo moleng oo.
When real PDFs or files exist in storage.ts: Loko ti PDF ta xiviri kumbe tifayela ti ri kona eka vuhlayiselo, API yi fanele ku vuyisa download_url (URL leyi heleleke kumbe ndlela yo fana na /api/...) na/kumbe document_url — buti ya Download yi pfumelela hi ku tisungulela eka layini yoleyo.
When real PDFs or files exist in storage.ve: Loko ti PDF ta xiviri kumbe tifayela ti ri kona eka vuhlayiselo, API yi fanele ku vuyisa download_url (URL leyi heleleke kumbe ndlela yo fana na /api/...) na/kumbe document_url — buti ya Download yi pfumelela hi ku tisungulela eka layini yoleyo.
