Deleting permanently removes your provid.af: As u dit uitvee, word u verskafferprofiel, dienste en gekoppelde besigheidsdata permanent verwyder. Spanlede kan dalk toegang tot hierdie besigheid verloor. Om eerder 'n breek te neem, gebruik Deaktiveer rekening in Settings.
Deleting permanently removes your provid.zu: Ukususa kususa unomphela iphrofayela yakho yomhlinzeki, amasevisi, nedatha yebhizinisi exhunyiwe. Amalungu eqembu angase alahlekelwe ukufinyelela kuleli bhizinisi. Ukuze uthathe ikhefu esikhundleni salokho, sebenzisa i-akhawunti ethi Vala ukusebenza ku-Settings.
Deleting permanently removes your provid.xh: Ukucima ngokusisigxina kususa iprofayile yakho yomboneleli, iinkonzo, kunye nedatha yeshishini edibeneyo. Amalungu eqela angaphulukana nokufikelela kweli shishini. Ukuthatha ikhefu endaweni yoko, sebenzisa Vala iakhawunti ku Settings.
Deleting permanently removes your provid.st: Ho phumula ho tlosa profaele ea mofani oa litšebeletso, lits'ebeletso, le lintlha tsa khoebo tse hokahaneng. Litho tsa sehlopha li ka lahleheloa ke mokhoa oa ho sebelisa khoebo ena. Ho nka khefu, sebelisa Deactivate account ho Settings.
Deleting permanently removes your provid.nso: Go phumola go tloša sa ruri profaele ya gago ya moabi, ditirelo, le datha ya kgwebo ye e kgokagantšwego. Maloko a sehlopha a ka lahlegelwa ke phihlelelo ya kgwebo ye. Go tšea nako ya go khutša go e na le moo, šomiša Deactivate account go Settings.
Deleting permanently removes your provid.tn: Go phimola go tlosetsa ruri porofaele ya motlamedi wa gago, ditirelo, le tshedimosetso ya kgwebo e e golagantsweng. Maloko a setlhopha a ka nna a latlhegelwa ke phitlhelelo ya kgwebo eno. Go ikhutsa boemong jwa seo, dirisa Tima akhaonto mo Settings.
Deleting permanently removes your provid.ts: Ku susa hi laha ku nga heriki swi susa phurofayili ya wena ya muphakeri, vukorhokeri, na datha ya bindzu leyi hlanganisiweke. Swirho swa xipano swi nga ha lahlekeriwa hi mfikelelo eka bindzu leri. Ku teka nkarhi wo wisa ematshan’wini ya sweswo, tirhisa Deactivate account eka Settings.
Deleting permanently removes your provid.ve: U phumula zwi bvisa tshoṱhe phrofaili ya muṋetshedzi waṋu, tshumelo, na data ya bindu yo ṱumanaho. Miraḓo ya tshigwada i nga xelelwa nga tswikelelo kha bindu iḽi. U dzhia tshifhinga tsha u awela nṱhani hazwo, shumisani Deactivate akhaunthu kha Settings.
Deleting permanently removes your provid.ss: Kususa unomphela kususa iphrofayili yemhlinzeki wakho, tinsita, kanye nemininingwane yebhizinisi lehlanganisiwe. Emalunga elicembu angalahlekelwa kufinyelela kulebhizinisi. Kuze utsatse likhefu esikhundleni saloko, sebentisa Cisha i-akhawunti ku Settings.

New visits are created once per day by t.af: Nuwe besoeke word een keer per dag deur die stelsel geskep wanneer 'n gleuf betaalbaar is. Kliënte word nie outomaties gehef vir daardie besoeke nie – betaling werk soos jou ander besprekings (betaal in app, by die lokaal, ens.).
New visits are created once per day by t.zu: Ukuvakashelwa okusha kudalwa kanye ngosuku yisistimu lapho kufanele kube ne-slot. Amaklayenti awakhokhiswa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngalokho kuvakasha—inkokhelo isebenza njengokunye kwakho ukubhukha (khokha ngohlelo lokusebenza, endaweni, njll.).
New visits are created once per day by t.xh: Utyelelo olutsha lwenziwa kanye ngosuku yinkqubo xa slot ngenxa. Abathengi abahlawuliswa ngokuzenzekelayo ngolo tyelelo-intlawulo isebenza njengolunye ubhukisho lwakho (hlawula kwi-app, kwindawo, njl.).
New visits are created once per day by t.st: Maeto a macha a etsoa hanngoe ka letsatsi ke sistimi ha slot e le teng. Bareki ha ba lefisoe ka bobona bakeng sa maeto ao - tefo e sebetsa joalo ka lipehelo tsa hau tse ling (lefa ka app, sebakeng sa kopano, joalo-joalo).
New visits are created once per day by t.nso: Diketelo tše mpsha di hlolwa gatee ka letšatši ke tshepedišo ge sekotwana se swanetše go fiwa. Bareki ga ba lefišwe ka go itiragalela bakeng sa diketelo tšeo—tefo e šoma go swana le dipeeletšo tša gago tše dingwe (lefa ka tirišong, lefelong la kopano, bjalobjalo).
New visits are created once per day by t.tn: Diketelo tse dišwa di tlhamiwa gangwe ka letsatsi ke tsamaiso fa go tshwanetse ga nna le sebaka. Ditlelaente ga di duedisiwe ka go itirisa ka maeto ao—tuelo e dira fela jaaka dipeeletso tsa gago tse dingwe (duela mo app, kwa lefelong la thulaganyo, jalo le jalo).
New visits are created once per day by t.ts: Maendzo lamantshwa ya endliwa kan’we hi siku hi sisiteme loko nkarhi wu fanele ku fika. Tikhasimende a ti hakeriwi hi ku tisungulela eka maendzo wolawo—ku hakela swi tirha ku fana ni tibuku ta wena tin’wana (pay in app, endhawini ya ntlangu, ni swin’wana).
New visits are created once per day by t.ve: Madalo maswa a sikiwa luthihi nga ḓuvha nga sisiṱeme musi tshifhinga tshi tshi fanela u vha hone. Vharengi a vha badelisi nga u tou ḓiitela kha madalo eneo—mbadelo i shuma u fana na dziṅwe buka dzaṋu (badelani kha app, fhethu ha vhuṱambo, na zwiṅwe-vho).
New visits are created once per day by t.ss: Kuvakashelwa lokusha kudalwa kanye ngelilanga luhlelo uma kufanele kube nesikhala. Emakhasimende akakhokhiswa ngekuzenzakalela ngaloko kuvakasha—kukhokha kusebenta njengaletinye tindzawo takho tekubhuka (khokha ku-app, endzaweni yekuhlangana, njll.).

When a date is due, we try to book the s.af: Wanneer 'n datum verval, probeer ons om dieselfde personeel en tyd te bespreek. As daardie gleuf geneem word, kan die hardloop daardie dag oorslaan - gaan Besprekings na of kontak die salon. Pouse stop nuwe besoeke; kanselleer eindig die hele reeks.
When a date is due, we try to book the s.zu: Uma usuku kufanele, sizama ukubhuka abasebenzi efanayo nesikhathi. Uma leso sikhala sithathwa, ukugijima kungase kweqe ngalolo suku—hlola Ukubhuka noma uxhumane nesaluni. Ukumisa isikhashana kumisa ukuvakasha okusha; ukukhansela kuqeda lonke uchungechunge.
When a date is due, we try to book the s.xh: Xa umhla ufanelekile, sizama ukubhukisha abasebenzi kunye nexesha elifanayo. Ukuba eso sithuba sithathiwe, ukubaleka kunokutsiba ngaloo mini-jonga i-Bookings okanye uqhagamshelane ne-salon. Ukunqumama kumisa utyelelo olutsha; Ukurhoxisa kuphelisa lonke uthotho.
When a date is due, we try to book the s.st: Ha letsatsi le le teng, re leka ho behela basebetsi le nako e tšoanang. Haeba sekotjana seo se nkuoa, ho matha ho ka tlola letsatsi leo — sheba Bookings kapa ikopanye le salon. Ho khefutsa ho emisa maeto a macha; cancel e felisa letoto lohle.
When a date is due, we try to book the s.nso: Ge letšatši le swanetše go fihla, re leka go beakanya bašomi le nako tše di swanago. Ge e ba sebaka seo se tšewa, go kitima go ka tlola letšatšing leo—hlahloba Dipeeletšo goba ikgokaganye le salon. Go khutša go emiša diketelo tše difsa; hlakola e fela letoto ka moka.
When a date is due, we try to book the s.tn: Fa letlha le tshwanetse go bewa, re leka go beeletsa badiri le nako e e tshwanang. Fa sebaka seo se tsewa, go taboga go ka nna ga tlola letsatsi leo—tlhola Bookings kgotsa ikgolaganye le salon. Go ema go sekae go emisa maeto a masha; khansela e fedisa motseletsele otlhe.
When a date is due, we try to book the s.ts: Loko siku ri fanele ku fika, hi ringeta ku bukuta vatirhi ni nkarhi lowu fanaka. Loko slot yoleyo yi tekiwa, ku tsutsuma ku nga ha tlula siku rero—languta Bookings kutani u tihlanganisa na salon. Ku yimanyana swi yimisa maendzo lamantshwa; cancel yi hela nongonoko hinkwawo.
When a date is due, we try to book the s.ve: Musi ḓuvha ḽi tshi swika, ri lingedza u ṅwalisa vhashumi vha fanaho na tshifhinga tshi fanaho. Arali tshenetsho tshikhala tsha dzhiiwa, u gidima hu nga fhira nga ḽeneḽo ḓuvha—ṱolani Bookings kana ni kwame salon. U fhumula zwi imisa madalo maswa; cancel i fhelisa mutevhe wothe.
When a date is due, we try to book the s.ss: Nangabe sekufike lilanga, setama kubhukha tisebenti nesikhatsi lesifanako. Nangabe leso slot sitsatfwa, kugijima kungase kweqe ngalelo langa—hlola Bookings nobe utsintse i-salon. Kuma kancane kumisa kuvakasha lokusha; khansela kucedza lonkhe loluchungechunge.

Automated ID checks are not available on.af: Outomatiese ID-kontroles is nog nie op hierdie gebou beskikbaar nie. Gebruik handmatige oplaai hieronder - foto's moet duidelik en ongesny wees. Ons hersien gewoonlik binne 1–2 werksdae en jy sal statusopdaterings hier sien.
Automated ID checks are not available on.zu: Ukuhlolwa kwe-ID okuzenzakalelayo akutholakali kulesi sakhiwo okwamanje. Sebenzisa ukulayisha mathupha ngezansi — izithombe kufanele zicace futhi zinganqanyuliwe. Ngokuvamile sibuyekeza phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-1–2 zebhizinisi futhi uzobona izibuyekezo zesimo lapha.
Automated ID checks are not available on.xh: Iitshekhi ze-ID ezizenzekelayo azikafumaneki kolu lwakhiwo okwangoku. Sebenzisa ukulayisha ngesandla ngezantsi - iifoto kufuneka zicace kwaye zinganqanyulwa. Sidla ngokuphonononga kwiintsuku ezi-1 ukuya kwezi-2 zomsebenzi kwaye uya kubona uhlaziyo lwesimo apha.
Automated ID checks are not available on.st: Litlhahlobo tsa ID ha li so fumanehe moahong ona. Sebelisa ho kenya ka letsoho ka tlase - linepe li tlameha ho hlaka le ho sa lengoa. Re atisa ho hlahloba ka hare ho matsatsi a 1-2 a khoebo, 'me u tla bona lintlha tse mabapi le boemo mona.
Automated ID checks are not available on.nso: Ditšheke tša ID tša go itiriša ga di hwetšagale go go aga mo ga bjale. Sebelisa pukwanana upload ka tlase - difoto lokela ho hlakileng le uncropped. Gantši re hlahloba ka gare ga matšatši a 1-2 a kgwebo gomme o tla bona diapdeite tša maemo mo.
Automated ID checks are not available on.tn: Ditshekatsheko tsa ID tse di itirisang ga di ise di nne teng mo kagong eno. Dirisa go laisa ka diatla fa tlase — dinepe di tshwanetse go bonala sentle e bile di sa kgaolwa. Gantsi re sekaseka mo malatsing a le 1–2 a kgwebo mme o tla bona dintšhwafatso tsa seemo fano.
Automated ID checks are not available on.ts: Ticheke ta ID ta xiothomethi a ti kumeki eka ku aka loku ku fikela sweswi. Tirhisa manual upload laha hansi — swifaniso swi fanele ku va erivaleni naswona swi nga tsemiwanga. Hi ntolovelo hi kambisisa ku nga si hela masiku ya ntirho ya 1–2 naswona u ta vona ku pfuxetiwa ka xiyimo laha.
Automated ID checks are not available on.ve: U ṱola ID nga vhuḓiitisi a zwi athu wanala kha u fhaṱa uhu. Shumisani u dzhenisa nga zwanḓa afho fhasi — zwinepe zwi fanela u vha khagala nahone zwi songo fhungudzwa. Kanzhi ri sedzulusa hu sa athu fhela maḓuvha a mushumo a 1–2 nahone ni ḓo vhona mvelaphanḓa ya tshiimo hafha.
Automated ID checks are not available on.ss: Kuhlolwa kwema-ID lokuzenzakalelayo akukatfolakali kulokwakha. Sebentisa kulayisha ngesandla ngezansi — titfombe kufanele ticace futsi tingajutjwa. Sivame kubuyeketa kungakapheli emalanga emsebenti langu-1–2 futsi utawubona tibuyeketo tesimo lapha.

The card machine took a different amount.af: Die kaartmasjien het 'n ander bedrag as die verskuldigde saldo geneem, dus is dit nie outomaties op hierdie heffing toegepas nie. Dit is gemerk vir hersiening - die saldo wys steeds as verskuldig totdat dit opgelos is.
The card machine took a different amount.zu: Umshini wekhadi uthathe inani elihlukile kunebhalansi okufanele uyikhokhe, ngakho-ke ayizange isetshenziswe kule nkokhelo ngokuzenzakalelayo. Imakiwe ukuze ibuyekezwe - ibhalansi isabonakala njengekweletwa kuze kube yilapho isixazululiwe.
The card machine took a different amount.xh: Umatshini wekhadi uthathe imali eyahlukileyo kunemali eseleyo, ngoko ayizange isetyenziswe kule ntlawulo ngokuzenzekelayo. Ichongiwe ukuba iqwalaselwe - ibhalansi isabonakala njengetyala de ibe isonjululwe.
The card machine took a different amount.st: Mochini oa karete o nkile chelete e fapaneng ho feta chelete e setseng, kahoo ha oa ka oa sebelisoa tefisong ena ka bohona. E tšoailoe hore e hlahlojoe - chelete e ntse e bonahala e le molato ho fihlela e rarolloa.
The card machine took a different amount.nso: Motšhene wa karata o ile wa tšea tšhelete e fapanego le yeo e šetšego yeo e swanetšego go lefša, ka gona ga se wa dirišwa tefo ye ka go itiragalela. E folaga bakeng sa tshekatsheko — tekatekano e ntse e bontša e le kolota ho fihlela e rarolloa.
The card machine took a different amount.tn: Motšhini wa karata o ne wa tsaya madi a a farologaneng le a a setseng a a tshwanetseng go duelwa, ka jalo o ne o sa dirisiwe mo tefisong eno ka go itirisa. E tshwailwe go sekasekwa — tekatekano e santse e bontsha jaaka e e kolotang go fitlha e rarabololwa.
The card machine took a different amount.ts: Muchini wa khadi wu teke mali leyi hambaneke ni leyi saleke leyi a yi fanele yi hakeriwa, hikwalaho a wu tirhisiwanga eka xibalo lexi hi ku tisungulela. Yi funghiwile leswaku yita kamberiwa — balance ya ha kombisa tani hi leyi kolotiwaka kufikela loko yi lulamisiwa.
The card machine took a different amount.ve: Mutshini wa khadi wo vha u tshi dzhia tshelede yo fhambanaho na ye ya vha i tshi fanela u badelwa, nga zwenezwo, a wo ngo shumiswa kha yeneyi mbadelo nga u tou ḓiitela. Yo vhewa fuḽaga uri i sedzuluswe — tshikalo tshi kha ḓi sumbedza sa tshine tsha kolodwa u swikela tshi tshi tandululwa.
The card machine took a different amount.ss: Umshini welikhadi watsatsa imali lehlukile kunebhalansi lebeyifanele, ngako-ke bewungasetjentiswa kulelicala ngekuzenzakalela. Kubekwe umjeka kutsi kubuyeketwe — ibhalansi isakhombisa kutsi ikweleta kuze kube ngulapho seyilungisiwe.

Revenue earned is ledger-based (platform.af: Inkomste verdien is grootboekgebaseer (platformvereffende betalings). Kontant- en Yoco diensbetalings wat jy ingevorder het, is nie ingesluit nie. Verdienste gebruik die dag waarop jy betaal is. Afsprake gebruik die dag waarop hulle geskeduleer is.
Revenue earned is ledger-based (platform.zu: Imali engenayo isuselwa kubhukwana (izinkokhelo ezixazululiwe). Imali kanye Yoco Izinkokhelo zesevisi oziqoqile azifakiwe. Umholo usebenzisa usuku owakhokhelwa ngalo. Ama-aphoyintimenti asebenzisa usuku oluhleliwe.
Revenue earned is ledger-based (platform.xh: Ingeniso efunyenweyo isekelwe kwileja (iintlawulo ezihlawulwe kwiqonga). Imali kunye Yoco iintlawulo zenkonzo oziqokeleleyo aziqukwanga. Umvuzo usebenzisa usuku ohlawule ngalo. Ukuqeshwa kusebenzisa usuku olucwangcisiweyo.
Revenue earned is ledger-based (platform.st: Chelete e fumanoeng e ipapisitse le ledger (litefo tse lokiselitsoeng sethaleng). Chelete le Yoco litefo tsa litšebeletso tseo u li bokeletseng ha li kenyelelitsoe. Moputso o sebelisa letsatsi leo u lefiloeng ka lona. Likhetho li sebelisa letsatsi leo li reriloeng ka lona.
Revenue earned is ledger-based (platform.nso: Letseno leo le hweditšwego le theilwe godimo ga ledger (ditefelo tše di rarollwago ka sefala). Tšhelete le Yoco ditefelo tša tirelo tšeo o di kgobokeditšego ga di akaretšwe. Meputso e šomiša letšatši leo o lefilwego ka lona. Dipeeletšo di diriša letšatši leo di rulagantšwego ka lona.
Revenue earned is ledger-based (platform.tn: Lotseno lo lo amogetsweng lo theilwe mo bukeng ya madi (dituelo tse di duelelwang mo polatefomong). Dituelo tsa madi a a seatleng le Yoco tsa tirelo tse o di kokoantseng ga di a akarediwa. Dituelo di dirisa letsatsi le o duetsweng ka lone. Dipeelanonako di dirisa letsatsi le di rulagantsweng ka lone.
Revenue earned is ledger-based (platform.ts: Mali leyi nghenaka leyi kumiweke yi seketeriwa hi ledger (tihakelo leti hakeriwaka hi pulatifomo). Returns must be requested within 14 days.zu: Ukubuyisela kufanele kucelwe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14 zokulethwa. Izinto kufanele zibe sesimweni sazo sangempela. Returns must be requested within 14 days.st: Lipoelo li tlameha ho kopuoa nakong ea matsatsi a 14 ka mor'a ho tlisoa. Lintho li tlameha ho ba maemong a tsona a pele. Returns must be requested within 14 days.nso: Dipušetšo di swanetše go kgopelwa mo matšatšing a 14 a go romelwa. Dilo di swanetše go ba maemong a tšona a mathomo. Moabi o tla sekaseka kgopelo ya gago gomme a araba mo matšatšing a 2 a kgwebo. Ge kgopelo ya gago e gannwe, o ka oketša go sehlopha sa rena sa thekgo.
Returns must be requested within 14 days.tn: Dipoelo di tshwanetse go kopiwa mo malatsing a le 14 morago ga thomelo. Dilwana di tshwanetse go nna mo seemong sa tsone sa ntlha. Motlamedi o tla sekaseka kopo ya gago mme a arabe mo malatsing a le 2 a tiro. Fa kopo ya gago e ganwa, o ka ya kwa setlhopheng sa rona sa kemonokeng.
Returns must be requested within 14 days.ts: Ku vuyiseriwa ku fanele ku komberiwa ku nga si hela masiku ya 14 ku sukela loko ku rhumeriwile. Swilo swi fanele swi va eka xiyimo xa swona xo sungula. Muphakeri u ta kambisisa xikombelo xa wena no hlamula ku nga si hela masiku ya 2 ya ntirho. Loko xikombelo xa wena xi ariwile, u nga ha tlakuka eka ntlawa wa hina wa nseketelo.

Muṋetshedzi u ḓo sedzulusa khumbelo yavho na u fhindula hu sa athu fhela maḓuvha mavhili a mushumo. Arali khumbelo yavho ya hanedzwa, vha nga fhirisela kha tshigwada tshashu tsha thikhedzo.
Returns must be requested within 14 days.ss: Kubuyiselwa kumele kucelwe kungakapheli emalanga langu-14 ngemuva kwekuletsa. Tintfo kumele tibe sesimeni sato sekucala. You travel to the client. Flow: confirm.zu: Uhambela iklayenti. Ukugeleza: qinisekisa ukubhukha, bese Qala uhambo lapho uhamba, u-Mark wafika, bese uqinisekisa nge-PIN kanye/noma i-QR yabo (ngokwezilungiselelo zakho), bese ucindezela Qala isevisi ekhadini Lohambo (kufana nezenzo Zokubhuka → Kuyaqhubeka).
You travel to the client. Flow: confirm.xh: Uhamba uye kumxhasi. Qhuba: qinisekisa ukubhukisha, emva koko Qala uhambo xa uhamba, uMarko ufike, emva koko uqinisekise nge PIN kunye/okanye ne-QR yabo (ngokwesetingi zakho), uze ucofe Qala inkonzo kwikhadi lohambo (kufana neentshukumo zokuBhukisha → Iyaqhubeka).
You travel to the client. Flow: confirm.st: U etela moreki. Phalla: netefatsa pehelo, ebe Qala leeto ha u tsamaea, Mark o fihlile, ebe o netefatsa ka PIN le/kapa QR ea bona (ho ea ka litlhophiso tsa hau), ebe o tlanya Qala tšebeletso kareteng ea Leeto (ho tšoana le liketso tsa Booking → E ntse e tsoela pele).
You travel to the client. Flow: confirm.nso: O sepela go ya go moreki. Phallo: netefatša peeletšo, ke moka Thoma leeto ge o tloga, Mark o fihlile, ke moka o netefatše ka PIN ya bona le/goba QR (ka dipeakanyo tša gago), ke moka o klike Thoma tirelo ka karateng ya Leeto (go swana le Ditiro tša go Beakanya → E tšwela pele).
You travel to the client. Flow: confirm.tn: O tsaya loeto go ya kwa tlelaenteng. Kelelo: netefatsa go buka, o bo o Simolola loeto fa o tsamaya, Mark o gorogile, o bo o netefatsa ka PIN le/kgotsa QR ya bone (go ya ka diseting tsa gago), o bo o tobetsa Simolola tirelo mo karateng ya Leeto (e e tshwanang le Ditiro tsa go Peeletsa → E tsweletse).
You travel to the client. Flow: confirm.ts: U famba u ya eka muxavi. Ku khuluka: tiyisisa ku bukuta, kutani Sungula riendzo loko u suka, Mark u fikile, kutani u tiyisisa hi PIN ya vona na/kumbe QR (hi ku ya hi swiyimiso swa wena), kutani u khoma Sungula vukorhokeri eka khadi ra Riendzo (swi fana na Swiendlo swa ku Bukula → Swi le ku endliweni).
You travel to the client. Flow: confirm.ve: U tshimbila u ya kha client. Flow: khwaṱhisedzani u buka, nga murahu ni Thome lwendo musi ni tshi ṱuwa, Mark o swika, nga murahu ni khwaṱhisedze nga PIN na/kana QR yavho (nga zwishumiswa zwaṋu), nga murahu ni ṱoḓe Thomani tshumelo kha garaṱa ya Lwendo (zwi fana na nyito dza u Buka → I khou bvela phanḓa).
You travel to the client. Flow: confirm.ss: Uhamba uye eklayenti. Kugeleta: cinisekisa kubhuka, bese Cala luhambo nawuhamba, Mark ufikile, bese ucinisekisa nge PIN yabo kanye/noma i-QR (ngetilungiselelo takho), bese uthepha Cala insizakalo ekhadini leLuhambo (kufana netento tekubhuka → Kuyachubeka).

. I understand Beautonomi may use cookie.af: . Ek verstaan ​​Beautonomi mag koekies en soortgelyke tegnologieë gebruik, data verwerk soos beskryf in die Privaatheidsbeleid en Koekiebeleid, en (terwyl jy aangemeld is) produkanalise gebruik. Ek kan analitiese voorkeure in my rekening se privaatheidinstellings opdateer.
. I understand Beautonomi may use cookie.zu: . Ngiyaqonda ukuthi Beautonomi ingase isebenzise amakhukhi nobuchwepheshe obufanayo, icubungule idatha njengoba ichazwe Kunqubomgomo Yobumfihlo kanye Nenqubomgomo Yekhukhi, futhi (ngenkathi isayinwe ngemvume) isebenzise izibalo zomkhiqizo. Ngingakwazi ukubuyekeza izintandokazi zezibalo kuzilungiselelo zobumfihlo ze-akhawunti yami.
. I understand Beautonomi may use cookie.xh: . Ndiyaqonda Beautonomi inokusebenzisa iikuki kunye nobuchwephesha obufanayo, iqhube idatha njengoko ichaziwe kuMgaqo-nkqubo waBucala kunye nePolisi yeCookie, kwaye (ngelixa ungenile) usebenzise uhlalutyo lwemveliso. Ndiyakwazi ukuhlaziya izinto ezikhethwayo kwiakhawunti yam yabucala.
. I understand Beautonomi may use cookie.st: . Kea utloisisa hore Beautonomi e ka sebelisa li-cookies le theknoloji e ts'oanang le eona, ho sebetsana le data joalo ka ha ho hlalositsoe ho Leano la Lekunutu le Leano la Cookie, le (ha u saenetse) ho sebelisa analytics ea lihlahisoa. Nka ntlafatsa likhetho tsa analytics ho litlhophiso tsa lekunutu tsa akhaonto ea ka.
. I understand Beautonomi may use cookie.nso: . Ke kwešiša gore Beautonomi a ka šomiša dikhukhi le theknolotši ye e swanago, a šoma datha bjalo ka ge e hlalošitšwe ka go Pholisi ya Sephiri le Pholisi ya Dikhukhi, gomme (ge a sa tsene) a šomiša ditshekatsheko tša setšweletšwa. Nka mpshafatša dikgetho tša ditshekatsheko ka go dipeakanyo tša sephiri tša akhaonto ya ka.
. I understand Beautonomi may use cookie.tn: . Ke a tlhaloganya gore Beautonomi e ka nna ya dirisa dikhuki le dithekenoloji tse di tshwanang, ya dira tshedimosetso jaaka e tlhalositswe mo Pholising ya Polokodiphiri le Pholisi ya Dikhuki, le (fa e saenetse) ya dirisa ditshekatsheko tsa dikumo. Ke kgona go tlhabolola ditlhopho tsa tshekatsheko mo diseting tsa me tsa polokodiphiri tsa akhaonto.
. I understand Beautonomi may use cookie.ts: . Ndza swi twisisa Beautonomi a nga ha tirhisa tikhukhi na thekinoloji yo fana na yona, a tirhisa datha tanihilaha swi hlamuseriweke hakona eka Pholisi ya Vuhlayiseki na Pholisi ya Tikhukhi, na (loko u nghene) a tirhisa vuxopaxopi bya swikumiwa. Ndzi nga pfuxeta swihlawulekisi swa vuxopaxopi eka swiletelo swa vuhlayiseki bya akhawunti ya mina.
. I understand Beautonomi may use cookie.ve: . Ndi a pfesesa uri Beautonomi i nga shumisa zwidodombedzwa na thekinoḽodzhi dzi fanaho, ya shuma datha sa zwe zwa ṱaluswa zwone kha Mbekanyamaitele ya Tshiphiri na Mbekanyamaitele ya Zwidodombedzwa, na (musi yo dzhena) u shumisa tsenguluso ya zwibveledzwa. Ndi nga khwinisa zwine na zwi takalela zwa analytics kha zwishumiswa zwanga zwa tshiphiri zwa akhaunthu.
. I understand Beautonomi may use cookie.ss: . Ngiyavisisa kutsi Beautonomi ingasebentisa emakhukhisi kanye nebuchwepheshe lobufanako, icubungule idatha njengobe ichaziwe kuNchubomgomo Yetimfihlo kanye neNchubomgomo Yemakhukhisi, futsi (ngesikhatsi ungene ngemvume) isebentise kuhlatiya umkhicito. Ngingabuyeketa lokukhetsako kwekuhlatiya kumasethingi ebumfihlo be-akhawunti yami.

Each visit is created by our daily sched.af: Elke besoek word geskep deur ons daaglikse skedule wanneer 'n gleuf betaalbaar is. Jy betaal per bespreking (kaart, beursie of kontant soos gewoonlik)—hierdie herhalingsplan hef nooit outomaties jou kaart nie. As die tyd nie meer vry is nie, kan daardie besoek oorgeslaan word totdat jy met die salon herskeduleer.
Each visit is created by our daily sched.zu: Ukuvakasha ngakunye kudalwa uhlelo lwethu lwansuku zonke lapho kufanele kube ne-slot. Ukhokha ngokubhukha ngakunye (ikhadi, isikhwama semali, noma ukheshi njengokujwayelekile)—lolu hlelo oluphindayo alulikhokhisi ikhadi lakho ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma isikhathi singasamahhala, lokho kuvakasha kungase kweqiwe uze uhlele kabusha nesaluni.
Each visit is created by our daily sched.xh: Utyelelo ngalunye lwenziwa yishedyuli yethu yemihla ngemihla xa i-slot ifanelekile. Uhlawula ngokubhukisha (ikhadi, isipaji, okanye imali njengesiqhelo)—esi sicwangciso sokuphinda sihlawule ngokuzenzekelayo ikhadi lakho. Ukuba ixesha alisekho simahla, olo tyelelo lunokutsitywa de uhlengahlengise i-salon.
Each visit is created by our daily sched.st: Ketelo e 'ngoe le e' ngoe e etsoa ke kemiso ea rona ea letsatsi le letsatsi ha slot e le teng. U lefa ha u behile (karete, sepache, kapa chelete joalo ka tloaelo)—leano lena la ho pheta-pheta ha ho mohla le lefisang karete ea hau. Haeba nako e se e sa lokoloha, ketelo eo e kanna ea tlotsoa ho fihlela u hlophisa nako ea salon.
Each visit is created by our daily sched.nso: Ketelo ye nngwe le ye nngwe e hlolwa ke lenaneo la rena la letšatši le letšatši ge sebaka se swanetše go fiwa. O lefa ka go beakanya (karata, sepache goba tšhelete bjalo ka mehleng)—leano le la go boeletša le ka mohla ga le lefiše karata ya gago ka go itiragalela. Ge e ba nako e se sa le ya mahala, ketelo yeo e ka tlolwa go fihlela o rulaganya lefsa le salon.
Each visit is created by our daily sched.tn: Ketelo nngwe le nngwe e tlhamiwa ke thulaganyo ya rona ya letsatsi le letsatsi fa go tshwanetse ga nna le nako. O duela ka peeletso (karata, sepatšhe, kgotsa madi jaaka gale)—thulaganyo eno ya go boeletsa ga e ke e duedisa karata ya gago ka go itirisa. Fa nako e sa tlhole e le mahala, ketelo eo e ka nna ya tlolwa go fitlha o rulaganya gape le salon.
Each visit is created by our daily sched.ts: Riendzo rin’wana na rin’wana ri tumbuluxiwa hi xiyimiso xa hina xa siku na siku loko nkarhi wu fanele ku fika. U hakela hi ku bukuta (khadi, xipachi kumbe mali tanihi ntolovelo)—pulani leyi yo phindha-phindha a yi si tshama yi hakela khadi ra wena hi yoxe. Loko nkarhi wu nga ha ri wa mahala, riendzo rero ri nga ha tluriwa ku kondza u hlela nakambe ni salon.
Each visit is created by our daily sched.ve: Madalo maṅwe na maṅwe a sikwa nga mbekanyamushumo yashu ya ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe musi hu tshi fanela u vha na tshikhala. U badela nga u buka (garaṱa, tshipatshi, kana tshelede sa nga misi)—heyi pulane ya u dovholola a i vhuyi ya badelisa khadi yaṋu nga vhuḓiitisi. Arali tshifhinga tshi si tsha vha tsha mahala, u dalela honoho hu nga kha ḓi pfukwa u swikela ni tshi dzudzanya hafhu na salon.
Each visit is created by our daily sched.ss: Kuvakashela ngamunye kudalwa luhlelo lwetfu lwamalanga onkhe lapho slot kufanele. Ukhokha ngekubhukha (likhadi, sikhwama semali, nobe imali njengenjwayelo)—loluhlelo lwekuphindzaphindza aluze lukhokhise likhadi lakho ngekuzenzakalela. Nangabe sikhatsi singasasebenti, loko kuvakasha kungase kweqiwe uze uhlele kabusha ne- salon.

Die teenoorgestelde kan gebeur wanneer grootboek aktiwiteit herken voordat betaling in die toepassing gemerk is - gebruik Einde van die dag vir eendag-inbetaling.

Okuhlukile kungenzeka uma ileja ibona umsebenzi ngaphambi kokuthi inkokhelo imakwe ngaphakathi nohlelo — sebenzisa Ukuphela kosuku ukuthola imali yosuku olulodwa.

Okuchaseneyo kuyenzeka xa ileja ibona umsebenzi phambi kokuba intlawulo imakishwe kwi-app - sebenzisa Ukuphela kosuku ukwenza imali yosuku olunye.

Se fapaneng se ka etsahala ha ledja e lemoha tšebetso pele tefo e tšoauoa ka har'a app - sebelisa Qetellong ea letsatsi bakeng sa ho etsa chelete ka letsatsi le le leng.

Se se fapaaneng se ka diragala fa buka ya ditshenyegelo e lemoga tiro pele ga tuelo e tshwaiwa mo tirisong — dirisa End of day go bona madi a letsatsi le le lengwe.

Leswi hambaneke swi nga humelela loko ledger yi lemuka ntirho loko hakelo yi nga si funghiwa eka app — tirhisa End of day for single-day cash-up.
Ledger net can be lower than recorded ta.ve: Ledger net i nga vha fhasi ha u dzhiwa ho rekhodiwaho musi vharengi vha tshi badela kheshe kana theminala in-salon hu si na uri tshelede yeneyo i dzudzanywe nga kha Paystack. Zwo fhambanaho na zwenezwo zwi nga itea musi ledger i tshi ṱhogomela mushumo phanḓa ha musi mbadelo i tshi swaiwa kha app — shumisani End of day kha u ṱanganya tshelede ya ḓuvha ḽithihi.

These sources (e.g. Instagram, Friend).af: Hierdie bronne (bv. Instagram, Vriend) spoor waar jou kliënte vandaan kom. Skei van die platformverwysingsprogram (nooi vriende → beursiebeloning), wat in Admin → Settings → Verwysings is. Wys 'n bron op 'n bespreking toe om die "Verwysing ontvang"-outomatisering te aktiveer.
These sources (e.g. Instagram, Friend).zu: Le mithombo (isb. Instagram, Friend) ilandelela ukuthi amakhasimende akho avelaphi. Hlukana nohlelo lokudlulisela lwenkundla (mema abangani → umvuzo wesikhwama), oku Admin → Settings → Ukudluliselwa. Nikeza umthombo ekubhukheni ukuze uqalise "Ukudluliswa kwamukelwe" okuzenzakalelayo.
These sources (e.g. Instagram, Friend).xh: Le mithombo (isb. Instagram, Friend) ilandelela ukuthi amakhasimende akho avelaphi. Hlukana nohlelo lokudlulisela lwenkundla (mema abangani → umvuzo wesikhwama), oku Admin → Settings → Ukudluliselwa. Nikeza umthombo ekubhukheni ukuze uqalise "Ukudluliswa kwamukelwe" okuzenzakalelayo.
These sources (e.g. Instagram, Friend).st: Mehloli ena (mohlala, Instagram, Motsoalle) e tseba hore na bareki ba hau ba tsoa hokae. Arohane le lenaneo la phetisetso ea sethala (mema metsoalle → moputso oa sepache), e leng ho Tsamaiso → Settings → Lipehelo. Abela mohloli mabapi le peeletso ho qala "Referral amoheloe" othomathike.
These sources (e.g. Instagram, Friend).nso: Methopo ye (e.g. Instagram, Mogwera) e latela moo bareki ba gago ba tšwago gona. Arogana le lenaneo la go fetišetša sefala (mema bagwera → moputso wa sepache), leo le lego go Admin → Settings → Ditšhupetšo. Abela mothopo go peeletšo go hlohleletša go itiriša ga "Tšhupetšo e amogetšwe".
These sources (e.g. Instagram, Friend).tn: Metswedi eno (ka sekai, Instagram, Tsala) e latedisa gore ditlelaente tsa gago di tswa kae. Kgaogana le lenaneo la go romela la polatefomo (laletsa ditsala → tuelo ya sepatšhe), le le mo go Motsamaisi → Settings → Diphetiso. Abela motswedi mo peeletso go tlhotlheletsa go itirisa ga "Thomelo e amogetswe".
These sources (e.g. Instagram, Friend).ts: Swihlovo leswi (e.g. Instagram, Munghana) swi landzelela laha tiklayenti ta wena ti humaka kona. Ku hambana na nongonoko wa ku hundzisela eka pulatifomo (rhamba vanghana → hakelo ya xipachi), leyi nga eka Admin → Settings → Ku hundzisela. Avela xihlovo eka buku ku hlohlotela ku otomatiki ka "Referral received".
These sources (e.g. Instagram, Friend).ve: Zwiko izwi (tsumbo, Instagram, Khonani) zwi tevhela hune vharengi vhaṋu vha bva hone. Fhambana na mbekanyamushumo ya u rumela kha pulatifomo (ramba khonani → pfufho ya tshipatshi), ine ya vha kha Admin → Settings → U rumela. U ṋea tshisima kha u buka u itela u thoma "U rumelwa ho ṱanganedzwa" nga vhuḓiitisi.
These sources (e.g. Instagram, Friend).ss: Lemitfombo (sib. Instagram, Umngani) ilandzelela kutsi emakhasimende akho avelaphi. Hluka neluhlelo lwekudlulisela lwepulatifomu (mema bangani → umvuzo wesikhwama semali), lokuku-Admin → Settings → Kudluliselwa. Yabela umtfombo ekubhukeni kuvusa "Kudluliselwa lokutfoliwe" lokuzenzakalelayo.

Die wysiging van belastingnommers, VAT ID en adres – en die bestuur van faktuurinstellings – word vir eers op die webwerf gedoen (web-eerste deur ontwerp). Volledig inheemse vorms sal 'n opvolg wees as jy pariteit wil hê sonder om die webwerf oop te maak.
This screen shows a read-only summary of.zu: Lesi sikrini sibonisa isifinyezo sokufunda kuphela semininingwane yomkhokhintela esinayo efayelini nanoma yiziphi izifinyezo zonyaka ezithinta izinkinga zenkundla. Ukuhlela izinombolo zentela, VAT ID, nekheli — nokuphatha izilungiselelo ze-invoyisi — kwenziwa kuwebhusayithi okwamanje (iwebhu-kuqala ngokuklama). Amafomu omdabu ngokugcwele angaba ukulandelela uma ufuna ukulingana ngaphandle kokuvula isayithi.
This screen shows a read-only summary of.xh: Esi sikrini sibonisa isishwankathelo sokufunda kuphela seenkcukacha zomhlawuli werhafu esinazo kwifayile kunye naziphi na izishwankathelo zonyaka kwimiba yeqonga. Ukuhlela iinombolo zerhafu, VAT ID, kunye nedilesi — nokulawula iisetingi ze-invoyisi — kwenziwa kwiwebhusayithi okwangoku (iwebhu-kuqala ngoyilo). Iifom zemveli ngokupheleleyo ziya kuba lulandelelo ukuba ufuna ukulingana ngaphandle kokuvula indawo.
This screen shows a read-only summary of.st: Skrine sena se bonts'a kakaretso e baloang feela ea lintlha tsa balefa lekhetho tseo re nang le tsona faeleng le likakaretso life kapa life tsa selemo mabapi le litaba tsa sethala. Ho lokisa linomoro tsa lekhetho, VAT ID, le aterese — le ho laola litlhophiso tsa invoice — ho etsoa webosaeteng hajoale (web-first by design). Liforomo tsa matsoalloa ka botlalo e ka ba tatellano haeba u batla ho lekana ntle le ho bula sebaka.
This screen shows a read-only summary of.nso: Skrine se se bontšha kakaretšo yeo e balwago fela ya dintlha tša balefela motšhelo tšeo re nago le tšona faeleng le dikakaretšo dife goba dife tša ngwaga le ngwaga tšeo sefala se di ntšhago. Go rulaganya dinomoro tša motšhelo, VAT ID, le aterese — le go laola dipeakanyo tša invoice — go dirwa mo wepsaeteng ga bjale (web-first ka tlhamo). Diforomo tša setlogo ka botlalo e tla ba go latela ge o nyaka parity ntle le go bula sebaka.
This screen shows a read-only summary of.tn: Sekerini sena se bontsha tshoboko e balehang feela ya dintlha tsa balefalekgetho tseo re nang le tsona faeleng le ditshobokanyo dife kapa dife tsa selemo le selemo tseo polatefomo e di ntshang. Go tseleganya dinomoro tsa lekgetho, 0 ID, le aterese — le go laola dipeakanyo tsa lenanetheko — go dirwa mo webosaeteng gone jaanong (web-first by design). Diforomo tsa naga ka botlalo e tla nna tatediso fa o batla tekatekano ntle le go bula saete.
This screen shows a read-only summary of.ts: Xikirini lexi xi kombisa nkatsakanyo lowu hlayiwaka ntsena wa vuxokoxoko bya vahlawuli va xibalo lebyi hi nga na byona eka fayili na nkatsakanyo wihi kumbe wihi wa lembe na lembe lowu pulatifomo yi wu humesaka. Ku hlela tinomboro ta xibalo, VAT ID, na adirese — na ku lawula swiletelo swa invoyisi — swi endliwa eka webusayiti sweswi (web-first hi dizayini). Tifomo ta ntumbuluko hi ku helela ti ta va ku landzelerisa loko u lava parity handle ko pfula sayiti.
This screen shows a read-only summary of.ve: Tshikirini itshi tshi sumbedza ṱhalutshedzo ya u vhala fhedzi ya zwidodombedzwa zwa vhatheli zwine ra vha nazwo kha faila na ṱhalutshedzo dziṅwe na dziṅwe dza ṅwaha dzine pulatifomo ya dzi bvisa. U dzudzanya nomboro dza muthelo, 0 ID, na ḓiresi — na u langa zwishumiswa zwa invoice — zwi itwa kha webusaithi zwa zwino (web-first nga nḓila ye ya ḓivhadzwa ngayo). Fomo dza mvelele dzo fhelelaho dzi ḓo vha u tevhela arali ni tshi ṱoḓa parity ni sa athu vula saithi.
This screen shows a read-only summary of.ss: Lesikrini sikhombisa sifinyeto lesifundvwako kuphela semininingwane yemkhokhi wentela lesinayo kufayela kanye nanobe ngutiphi tifinyeto temnyaka letikhishwa yiplatifomu. Kuhlela tinombolo temtselo, 0 ID, nelikheli — kanye nekulawula emasethingi e-inivoyisi — kwentiwa kuwebhusayithi kwanyalo (web-first by design). Emafomu emdzabu ngalokuphelele bekungaba kulandzelela uma ufuna parity ngaphandle kwekuvula isayithi.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The.af: Betaling word teen jou Apple ID gehef. Die intekening hernu outomaties tensy jy ten minste 24 uur voor die einde van die huidige tydperk kanselleer. Bestuur, kanselleer of aanvaar enige tyd 'n prysverandering in Apple ID → Intekeninge. Enige bekendstellingsaanbod op hierdie plan word outomaties toegepas wanneer jy inteken. Gebruik 'n promosie- of terugwenaanbodkode met Gebruik App Store-aanbiedingskode. Enige ongebruikte gedeelte van 'n gratis proeftydperk, indien dit aangebied word, word verbeur wanneer u aankoop.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The.zu: Inkokhelo ikhokhiswa ku-ID yakho Apple. Ukubhalisa kuvuselela ngokuzenzakalelayo ngaphandle uma ukhansela okungenani amahora angu-24 ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi samanje. Phatha, khansela, noma yamukela ukushintshwa kwentengo noma nini kokuthi Apple ID → Okubhaliselwe. Noma yikuphi okunikezwayo okuyisethulo kulolu hlelo kusebenza ngokuzenzakalelayo lapho ubhalisa. Sebenzisa ikhodi yokuphromotha noma yokuwina-back ngekhodi yokunikeza ye-Redeem App Store. Noma iyiphi ingxenye engasetshenzisiwe yesilingo samahhala, uma inikezwa, iyalahleka uma uthenga.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The.xh: Inkokhelo ikhokhiswa ku-ID yakho Apple. Phatha, khansela, noma yamukela ukushintshwa kwentengo noma nini kokuthi Apple ID → Okubhaliselwe. Noma yikuphi okunikezwayo okuyisethulo kulolu hlelo kusebenza ngokuzenzakalelayo lapho ubhalisa.
